english: Korientzé is a village in the Mopti country of Mali. It serves as the seat of Korombana commune, linking the settlement's name with the surrounding rural district.
simp_chinese: 科林泽是马里莫普提地区的一座村落。它是科龙巴纳乡的治所，聚落与周围乡村辖区在行政上紧密相连。

english: Madagascar's western waters form the eastern side of the Mozambique Channel. The long Indian Ocean passage separates the island from Africa and carries warm water southward.
simp_chinese: 马达加斯加西部水域构成莫桑比克海峡东侧。漫长的印度洋通道将岛屿与非洲分隔，并把暖水向南输送。

english: Korit is a village in the Tabas region of Iran’s South Khorasan province. It serves as the centre of Nakhlestan Rural District and was its most populous village in the 2016 census.
simp_chinese: 科里特是伊朗南呼罗珊省塔巴斯地区的一座村庄。这里是纳赫勒斯坦乡的中心，2016年人口普查时也是该乡人口最多的村落。

english: Korkina Sloboda was founded as a village in 1670. Peter the Great authorized its Nikolskaya fair in 1721, and the twice-yearly market became one of Siberia’s important trading gatherings. In 1782 Catherine II granted town status and renamed it Ishim.
simp_chinese: 科尔基纳自由村始建于1670年。彼得大帝于1721年准许举办尼科尔斯卡亚集市，每年两次的市场发展为西伯利亚重要贸易集会之一。1782年，叶卡捷琳娜二世授予城镇地位，并改名伊希姆。

english: Körmend lies in Vas County in western Hungary, where the castle of the Batthyány family became the town's most distinctive monument. The family's prominence among the Hungarian aristocracy gives this residence a significance beyond the surrounding settlement. A later chapter added a different use to the noble household: the ophthalmologist Ladislaus Batthyány-Strattmann, who lived from 1870 to 1931, spent nearly a decade here with his family. He converted a wing of the castle into an eye clinic and treated poor patients without charge. That medical work belongs to the modern history of a residence remembered for both aristocratic ownership and charitable care.
simp_chinese: 克尔门德位于匈牙利西部的沃什州，巴蒂亚尼家族的城堡是城镇最鲜明的建筑。这个家族在匈牙利贵族中的显赫地位，使其居所的意义超出了周围的聚落。更晚的历史赋予贵族宅邸另一种用途：生于1870年、卒于1931年的眼科医生拉迪斯劳斯·巴蒂亚尼-施特拉特曼，曾与家人在这里生活近十年。他将城堡的一翼改为眼科诊所，为贫困患者免费诊治。这项医疗事业属于城堡的近现代篇章，使这座居所同时因贵族家族与慈善医疗而为人所知。

english: Korneuburg occupies the left bank of the Danube northwest of Vienna, opposite Klosterneuburg, with which it once shared a common history under the name Nivenburg. Recorded as a market town in 1136, it gained the right to separate from its neighbour in 1298. In the early fifteenth century, walls, a moat and four gates enclosed the settlement; a watchtower built around 1455 gave warning of fires and approaching soldiers. Such precautions reflected an exposed position on the approach to Vienna, and the town suffered during the wars between Matthias Corvinus and Frederick III, as well as later campaigns. A fourteenth-century synagogue recalls a different part of its medieval society. It lost its religious function after the expulsion of Jews from Habsburg lands in 1421 and was subsequently put to other uses, including a horse-powered mill.
simp_chinese: 科尔新堡位于维也纳西北的多瑙河左岸，与克洛斯特新堡隔河相望，两地曾以尼芬堡之名共享一段历史。1136年的记录将其列为集镇，1298年又获得与对岸邻城正式分离的权利。十五世纪初，城墙、护城河与四座城门围护聚落，约1455年建成的瞭望塔则用于警戒火灾和来袭军队。这些措施反映了当地作为维也纳门户的易受攻击处境；马加什·科尔维努斯与腓特烈三世交战期间及其后的战争都曾波及此城。一座十四世纪犹太会堂则记录了中古社会的另一面。1421年哈布斯堡领地驱逐犹太人后，会堂失去宗教用途，后来曾改作包括畜力磨坊在内的其他设施。

english: Koro belongs to the wider Upper Guinean country of West Africa. In its broad ecological sense, this region comprises tropical forests stretching through Liberia and Côte d’Ivoire towards southwestern Ghana.
simp_chinese: 科罗属于西非更广阔的上几内亚地区。按较广的生态范围，这片地区包含经利比里亚与科特迪瓦延伸至加纳西南部的热带森林。

english: Koro is a volcanic island in Fiji's Lomaiviti group, with a chain of basaltic cinder cones running along its crest from north to south. Its name means “village” in Fijian, and the surrounding Koro Sea takes its own name from the island. Before Europeans arrived, settlements stood inland rather than along the shore. William Bligh passed between Koro and Makogai in early May 1789. Kava cultivation and copra later became major village livelihoods, supported by the island's fertile soils and tropical vegetation.
simp_chinese: 科罗是斐济洛迈维蒂群岛中的一座火山岛，一列玄武质火山渣锥沿岛脊由北向南延伸。它的名称在斐济语中意为“村庄”，周围的科罗海也因岛得名。欧洲人到来之前，聚落位于内陆，远离海岸。1789年5月初，威廉·布莱从科罗与马科盖两岛之间经过。此后，卡瓦种植和椰干生产成为村民的主要生计，岛上肥沃的土壤与热带植被为之提供了条件。

english: The Koro Sea lies within Fiji’s island world, taking its name from the volcanic island of Koro in its northwestern waters. Between the larger islands and the Lau group to the east, its open reaches conceal a complicated seafloor of basalt, reefs, rocks and sandbars. These obstacles confine safe passage through parts of the sea to narrow channels, making knowledge of the waters as valuable as a favourable wind. The northern and western seabed is generally shallower than the eastern portion. Trade winds prevail over this tropical sea, while the warm season brings the danger of cyclones. The Nanuku Passage links its waters to the approaches beyond the archipelago.
simp_chinese: 科罗海位于斐济诸岛之间，名称来自海域西北部的火山岛科罗岛。在较大的岛屿与东面的劳群岛之间，开阔海面下藏着由玄武岩海床、珊瑚礁、岩石和沙洲组成的复杂地形。这些障碍使部分海域的安全通航只能依赖狭窄水道，熟悉海路因而与顺风同样重要。北部和西部的海底通常比东部更浅。信风常年影响这片热带海域，暖季则带来气旋威胁。纳努库水道将这里的海水与群岛之外的航路相连。

english: The Koroa inhabited the Mississippi Valley and the basin of the Yazoo before French colonization. Their communities occupied both banks of the great river when French travellers encountered them in the late seventeenth century. In 1682 La Salle called twice at a Koroa settlement on the western bank; his party feasted there and found their Quinipissa allies living in the same village. Missionaries later worked among the Koroa and their Yazoo and Tunica neighbours. Their language remains uncertain: it is often associated with Tunica, although French observers distinguished the two. European diseases devastated the population, and surviving Koroa were adopted into Tunica, Chickasaw and Natchez communities, carrying their people’s history beyond the loss of a separate nation.
simp_chinese: 法国殖民以前，科罗亚人居住在密西西比河谷及亚祖河流域。十七世纪末法国旅行者到来时，他们的社群分布在大河两岸。1682年，拉萨尔两次造访西岸的一座科罗亚聚落；随行者在那里赴宴，并见到他们的奎尼皮萨盟友同住一村。传教士后来在科罗亚人及其亚祖、图尼卡邻人之间活动。他们语言的归属仍不确定：通常被认为与图尼卡语有关，法国观察者却曾区分两者。欧洲传来的疾病重创当地人口，幸存者被图尼卡、奇克索和纳奇兹社群接纳，使这个民族的历史在独立群体消散后仍得以延续。

english: Koroc belongs to Nunavik, the Inuit homeland occupying northern Quebec. The wider region lies north of the fifty-fifth parallel, and its Inuktitut name means great land.
simp_chinese: 科罗克属于魁北克北部因纽特人的家园努纳维克。更广阔的地区位于北纬五十五度以北，其因纽特语名称意为大地。

english: Korocha stands on the right bank of the river of the same name, a tributary of the Seversky Donets northeast of Belgorod. The town's documented beginnings belong to 1638, when a small Russian fortress was built here on the tsardom's southern frontier. It formed part of the defensive line intended to resist Crimean Tatar attacks, linking the country around Belgorod with fortifications farther east. Its original name, Krasny gorod na Koroche, was shortened to Korocha. Town status followed in 1708. For a long period it remained a leading settlement of the surrounding district, although that regional prominence diminished by the early twentieth century. Its origins preserve the story of a frontier transformed through the building of fortified towns.
simp_chinese: 科罗恰位于别尔哥罗德东北方，同名河流的右岸，这条河属于北顿涅茨河水系。城镇有记录的开端是在1638年，当时俄罗斯在沙皇国南部边境修建了一座小型堡垒。它是抵御克里米亚鞑靼人袭击的防线一部分，将别尔哥罗德一带与更东面的要塞连接起来。最初的名称“科罗恰河畔红城”后来缩短为科罗恰，1708年获得城市地位。它长期是周围地区的重要聚落，直到二十世纪初才逐渐失去区域优势。其起源保留了边疆通过修筑设防城镇而发生变化的历史。

english: The Köroğlu Mountains rise north of Ankara between the Sakarya and Kızılırmak rivers. The range follows the northern Anatolian fault country and extends through the districts of Bolu, Çankırı and Çorum.
simp_chinese: 科罗卢山脉位于安卡拉以北、萨卡里亚河与克泽勒河之间。山脉沿安纳托利亚北部断层地带延伸，横跨博卢、昌克勒及乔鲁姆地区。

english: The Köroğlu Mountains rise north of Ankara along the North Anatolian Fault. Their range extends between the Sakarya and Kızılırmak rivers, reaching nearly 2,500 metres south of Bolu.
simp_chinese: 克勒奥卢山脉沿北安纳托利亚断层在安卡拉以北隆起。山地延伸于萨卡里亚河与克孜勒河之间，博卢南部的峰顶接近2500米。

english: Iskorosten stands on the Uzh River and was the chief town of the Drevlians, a Slavic people drawn into the power of Kyiv. Prince Igor died here while collecting tribute in 945. The Primary Chronicle made his widow Olga's revenge famous, telling how birds carrying burning material returned to their nests and set the town alight; this striking episode belongs to the chronicle's narrative tradition. The town later passed under Lithuanian rule and then into the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Sigismund III granted it a charter in 1589, but Cossack forces captured it during the Khmelnytsky Uprising in 1649 and destroyed its fortifications. The Third Partition of Poland brought Iskorosten into the Russian Empire in 1795.
simp_chinese: 伊斯科罗斯坚坐落于乌日河畔，曾是德列夫利安人的主要城镇；这个斯拉夫族群后来被纳入基辅的势力范围。945年，伊戈尔大公在此征收贡赋时遇害。《往年纪事》使其遗孀奥尔加的复仇故事广为流传，记述携带燃烧物的鸟儿飞回巢穴，点燃了整座城镇；这一鲜明情节属于编年史的叙事传统。此城后来归于立陶宛统治，继而进入波兰立陶宛联邦。齐格蒙特三世于1589年授予城市特许状，但哥萨克军队在1649年的赫梅利尼茨基起义中攻占此地，摧毁了防御工事。1795年第三次瓜分波兰后，伊斯科罗斯坚归入俄罗斯帝国。

english: Korostyshiv appears in written records in 1499 as a village in the Kyiv lands of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Its earlier beginnings are less securely documented, with local tradition connecting the settlement to the Drevlians. For much of its later history it was an estate town: the influential Kmita family held it before Filon Kmita sold it to the Olizars in 1565. Forests formed the greater part of the manor's lands. In 1779 the town received Magdeburg privileges and a coat of arms drawn from the Olizar family's Radwan emblem, a golden church banner and cross upon red. The Second Partition of Poland brought Korostyshiv into the Russian Empire in 1793, but the Olizars retained ownership well into the nineteenth century. Its history joins the changing sovereignty of Right-bank Ukraine with the long continuity of a noble estate.
simp_chinese: 1499年的文献已将科罗斯特希夫记作立陶宛大公国基辅地区的一座村庄。更早的起源缺少同样确实的记录，当地传统则把它与德雷夫利安人联系起来。在此后很长的历史中，它是一座庄园城镇：有影响力的克米塔家族先据有此地，菲隆·克米塔于1565年将它售予奥利扎尔家族。庄园土地大多为森林。1779年，城镇获得马格德堡城市特权，采用源自奥利扎尔家族拉德万纹章的市徽，即红底上的金色教会旗帜与十字。1793年第二次瓜分波兰使科罗斯特希夫并入俄罗斯帝国，但奥利扎尔家族的所有权仍延续至十九世纪后期。它的历史将右岸乌克兰主权的更迭与一处贵族庄园的长期延续连接起来。

english: Korpilombo belongs to the northern Scandinavian world of Torne Lappmark. The wider northern region has long, cold winters, contrasting with the more temperate and populous south.
simp_chinese: 科皮隆博属于托尔讷拉普马克一带的北部斯堪的纳维亚地区。更广阔的北方地区冬季漫长寒冷，与气候较温和、人口较密集的南部形成差异。

english: Korra belongs to the lower Doab country. In the wider north Indian plains, fertile low floodplains called khadir contrast with higher bangar lands that flood less often but are generally less fertile.
simp_chinese: 扩达属于下河间地。在更广阔的北印度平原，称为卡迪尔的肥沃低地洪泛平原与较高的班格尔地相对，后者较少被洪水淹没，但通常也较不肥沃。

english: Korsholm's rural coast and scattered islands face the Gulf of Bothnia. The parish of Mustasaari first appears in a royal letter concerning freedom of commerce in 1348, and Saint Mary's Church was built on Korsholm island around the middle of that century. Korsholma Castle subsequently served for hundreds of years as the seat from which Ostrobothnia was governed. The landscape itself has changed: land uplift has carried the place once called Mustasaari, ‘Black Island’, inland. Vaasa was founded within the old parish in 1606, while the castle and church ruins now lie in its old town. Beyond the river mouths stretches the broken archipelago of Replot, Björkö and neighbouring islands.
simp_chinese: 科斯霍尔姆的乡野海岸与零散岛屿面向波的尼亚湾。穆斯塔萨里教区于1348年首次见于一封涉及贸易自由的王室信函，圣玛利亚教堂则于同世纪中叶建于科斯霍尔姆岛上。此后数百年，科斯霍尔马城堡一直是治理博滕地区的中心。这里的地貌也在变化：陆地抬升使曾被称为穆斯塔萨里、意为“黑岛”的地方变成了内陆。瓦萨于1606年在旧教区境内建立，如今城堡与教堂遗址都位于瓦萨老城。河口之外，雷普洛特、比约克与邻近岛屿组成破碎交错的群岛。

english: Korsun stands on the Ros River. Yaroslav the Wise founded a fortress here in 1032 to shield Kyiv from steppe nomads. The Mongols destroyed it in 1240, and the surrounding territory later entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania.
simp_chinese: 科尔孙位于罗斯河畔。智者雅罗斯拉夫于1032年在此筑堡，保护基辅免受草原游牧势力侵袭。蒙古人于1240年毁坏堡垒，周边土地后来归入立陶宛大公国。

english: Korti stands on the southern bank of the Nile, where Wadi Muqaddam reaches the river, in the country associated with the Shaiqiya. In 1820 it was the scene of a battle between the Shaiqiya and the invading forces of Muhammad Ali Pasha. Its position between river and desert routes remained strategically useful long afterward. During the later Nile Expedition of 1884–1885, British troops assembled here and built a fort opposite the town, allowing columns to advance both along the Nile and across the Bayuda Desert.
simp_chinese: 科尔提位于尼罗河南岸、穆卡达姆旱谷抵达河流的地方，周围是与沙伊基亚人紧密相关的土地。1820年，沙伊基亚人与穆罕默德·阿里帕夏的入侵军队在此交战。此后很久，它介于河道与沙漠路线之间的位置仍具有战略价值。到了1884至1885年晚近的尼罗河远征中，英军在这里集结，并在城镇对岸修建堡垒，使部队可以分别沿尼罗河与穿越拜尤达沙漠推进。

english: Kortkeros lies in the Komi country of northeastern European Russia. The rural settlement serves as the center of the surrounding Kortkerossky administrative district.
simp_chinese: 科尔特克罗斯位于俄罗斯欧洲部分东北的科米地区。这处乡村聚落是周边同名行政区的中心。

english: Kortrijk grew beside the Leie, where Roman roads met at the Gallo-Roman settlement of Cortoriacum. The Counts of Flanders fortified the town against northern raiders, and Philip of Flanders granted it a city charter in 1190. Its medieval wealth rested on weaving and the trade in flax and wool with France and England. After thirteenth-century destruction, Countess Joan encouraged recovery by exempting new settlers from property tax, helping the town become an important centre of linen production. Its most celebrated encounter came on the nearby fields of Groeninge in 1302, when Flemish forces defeated the knights of Philip the Fair. The Battle of the Golden Spurs gave Kortrijk a lasting place in Flemish memory. Prosperity under the Burgundian dukes was followed by renewed war with France and the religious conflicts of the sixteenth century, repeatedly testing a town whose workshops made it worth possessing.
simp_chinese: 科特赖克兴起于莱厄河畔，罗马道路在此交会，形成高卢—罗马聚落科尔托里亚库姆。佛兰德伯爵为抵御北方袭扰者加固城防，佛兰德的腓力又于1190年授予城市特许状。中世纪的财富建立在织造以及与法国、英格兰之间的亚麻和羊毛贸易上。城镇在13世纪遭到破坏后，女伯爵让娜免除新移民的地产税，促进复兴，也帮助这里成为重要的亚麻布生产中心。最著名的一战发生于1302年附近的赫勒宁厄原野：佛兰德军队击败了美男子腓力的骑士。金马刺战役使科特赖克在佛兰德人的历史记忆中占据长久地位。勃艮第公爵治下的繁荣之后，又有与法国的战争及16世纪的宗教冲突；作坊带来的财富，也使这座城镇屡次成为争夺对象。

english: Kortuz belongs to the wider Yenisei country of central Siberia. The great river divides the West Siberian Plain from the Central Siberian Plateau, then carries waters north through the Krasnoyarsk region to the Kara Sea; its basin also includes the distant waters of Lake Baikal.
simp_chinese: 科尔图兹属于西伯利亚中部广义的叶尼塞河地区。这条大河分隔西西伯利亚平原与中西伯利亚高原，经克拉斯诺亚尔斯克地区向北流入喀拉海；其广大流域也包含远方的贝加尔湖水系。

english: These forests are the homeland of the Korup people along the Cameroon–Nigeria border region. The nearby national park takes their name, and Korup villages stand both within and around its rainforest landscape.
simp_chinese: 这片森林是喀麦隆与尼日利亚边境地区科鲁普人的故土。附近国家公园以其族名命名，科鲁普村庄分布在公园雨林之中及周边。

english: Korusi belongs to the Nomlaki country of northern California. River and Hill Nomlaki occupied different parts of the Sacramento Valley and adjoining Coast Range; oak groves supplied several varieties of acorns, alongside pine nuts, seeds and tubers gathered for food.
simp_chinese: 科鲁西属于加利福尼亚北部的诺姆拉基人地区。河地与山地诺姆拉基人分别居住于萨克拉门托谷及邻近海岸山地；橡树林提供多种橡实，松子、种子与块根也被采集为食。

english: Korutla lies in the Deccan country of Telangana, west of Jagtial. Its older religious landscape includes the Mahadevaswamy temple, where images of Jain Tirthankaras stand within a shrine dedicated to Shiva. Local accounts associate the town's early history with Jain communities and the Chalukya and Rashtrakuta dynasties. A stone-built stepwell, with pillars and a chamber for changing clothes, survives within the former palace precinct. The palace was once protected by six watchtowers linked by a broad wall and an adjoining water-filled channel. These remains preserve the outlines of a fortified settlement alongside the town's layered sacred traditions.
simp_chinese: 科鲁特拉坐落在特伦甘纳的德干地区、贾格蒂亚尔以西。当地古老的宗教景观包括摩诃提婆斯瓦米神庙，耆那教祖师像安置在供奉湿婆的神殿之中。地方记述将城镇早期历史与耆那教群体、遮娄其及罗湿陀罗拘陀诸王朝联系起来。旧宫殿范围内保留着石砌阶井，设有柱廊和更衣空间。宫殿原由六座瞭望塔守护，塔间以宽阔城墙连接，墙外另有注水渠道。这些遗迹保存了设防聚落的轮廓，也体现出城镇多层次的宗教传统。

english: Korvala belongs to the Kemi river country of northern Finland. The Kemijoki flows south through Kemijärvi and Rovaniemi to the Gulf of Bothnia. At Rovaniemi it receives the Ounasjoki, joining waters from a broad northern basin.
simp_chinese: 科尔瓦拉属于芬兰北部凯米河地域。凯米河向南经凯米耶尔维与罗瓦涅米流入波的尼亚湾，在罗瓦涅米接纳奥纳斯河，汇聚广大北方流域的来水。

english: The Koryak Uplands spread across the Russian Far East south of the Anadyr River. Their ranges extend into Chukotka and Kamchatka, with a small part in Magadan; the broader system contains extensive glaciers and reaches 2,562 metres at Mount Ledyanaya.
simp_chinese: 科里亚克高地横亘于俄罗斯远东的阿纳德尔河以南。其诸山脉延伸至楚科奇与堪察加，少部分位于马加丹；整个山系拥有大片冰川，列佳纳亚山海拔达二千五百六十二米。

english: The Koryak Uplands rise south of the Anadyr River and northeast of Kamchatka. Numerous glaciers and ice fields occupy parts of this extensive mountain system.
simp_chinese: 科里亚克高地隆起于阿纳德尔河以南、堪察加东北部。这片广大山系的部分区域分布着众多冰川与冰原。

english: The Koryak Uplands rise south of the Anadyr and northeast of Kamchatka. This extensive mountain system contains numerous glaciers and ice fields. Its highest point is Mount Ledyanaya in the Ukelayat Range, reaching 2,562 metres.
simp_chinese: 科里亚克高地耸立于阿纳德尔河以南、堪察加东北部。这片广阔山系包含众多冰川与冰原，最高点为乌克拉亚特山脉海拔二千五百六十二米的列佳纳亚山。

english: The Koryak uplands rise south of the Anadyr and northeast of Kamchatka. Their many ranges contain glaciers and ice fields, forming one of the major glacial mountain systems of the northern Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 科里亚克高地位于阿纳德尔河以南、堪察加东北。众多山岭中分布冰川与冰原，形成俄罗斯远东北部重要的冰川山地系统。

english: These Koryak Uplands belong to the broader Koryak country of the Russian Far East. The later Koryak Autonomous Okrug encompassed a vast, sparsely populated territory including part of northern Kamchatka. Palana served as its administrative centre.
simp_chinese: 这片科里亚克高地属于俄罗斯远东广义科里亚克地区。后来的科里亚克自治区包含堪察加北部一部分在内的辽阔稀疏人口地域，以帕拉纳为行政中心。

english: Koryazhma stands where the Bolshaya Koryazhemka enters the Vychegda, on the latter river's navigable left bank. Its historical centre grew around the Koryazhemsky Nikolaevsky Monastery, founded at the tributary's mouth in 1535. Stone buildings later marked the monastery's importance: an Annunciation cathedral dated from 1665, and the Church of the Holy Mandylion from 1746. The cathedral was demolished in 1933, while the later industrial settlement developed around a paper mill begun in the 1950s. The modern town therefore overlays a much older monastic site beside the northern waterways.
simp_chinese: 科里亚日马坐落于大科里亚热姆卡河汇入维切格达河之处，位于后者可通航河段的左岸。其历史中心围绕1535年在支流河口建立的科里亚日马圣尼古拉修道院发展。后来兴建的石构建筑体现了修道院的地位：圣母领报主教座堂建于1665年，圣像教堂则建于1746年。主教座堂于1933年被拆除，而较晚的工业聚落围绕二十世纪五十年代开工的造纸厂形成。因此，现代城镇覆盖在北方水道旁一处更古老的修道院遗址之上。

english: Kos is one of the Dodecanese islands in the southeastern Aegean. Its name is already attested in the Iliad and has remained in use, while the principal town shares the island’s name.
simp_chinese: 科斯是爱琴海东南部多德卡尼斯群岛的一座岛屿。其名称已见于《伊利亚特》并沿用至今，岛上主要城镇也使用同一名称。

english: Kosa belongs to Kordofan in central Sudan. The wider region is an undulating plain with the Nuba Mountains in its southeastern quarter, becoming fertile in the rains and markedly dry outside that season.
simp_chinese: 科萨属于苏丹中部的科尔多凡。更广阔的地区以起伏平原为主，东南部为努巴山脉，雨季土地肥沃，其他季节则明显干旱。

english: Kosa is a local centre in the Komi-Permyak country of northwestern Perm. The surrounding district is crossed by the Kosa River, a tributary of the Kama; Komi-Permyak communities form the majority of its modern population, alongside Russian residents.
simp_chinese: 科萨是彼尔姆西北部科米—彼尔米亚克地区的地方中心。周边地区有卡马河支流科萨河流经；现代居民以科米—彼尔米亚克人为多数，也有俄罗斯人居住。

english: Kosalu belongs to the Congaree country of South Carolina. The wider region faces the Atlantic and is separated from Georgia by the Savannah River along its western and southern sides.
simp_chinese: 科萨鲁属于南卡罗来纳的康加里地区。更广阔的区域面向大西洋，西部与南部沿萨凡纳河与佐治亚相隔。

english: Kościan grew within medieval Greater Poland and received town rights in the later thirteenth century. A royal town from 1332, it became a county seat and a major centre of clothmaking. In the fifteenth century its cloth won a distinguishing mark from Casimir IV Jagiellon, remembered as Poland's first industrial trademark; Kościan then ranked second only to Poznań among Greater Poland's towns. War disrupted this prosperity. Swedish troops took the town in 1655, before partisans under Krzysztof Żegocki recovered it. Annexation by Prussia in 1793 was followed by the uprising of 1794; the town briefly joined the Duchy of Warsaw after 1806 before returning to Prussian rule in 1815.
simp_chinese: 科希强在中世纪大波兰地区发展起来，于十三世纪后半叶取得城镇权。自1332年起，它成为波兰王室城镇，后来兼具县治与重要制呢中心的地位。十五世纪，卡齐米日四世为当地呢绒授予专用标记，被视为波兰最早的工业商标；当时，科希强在大波兰诸城中仅次于波兹南。战争打断了这番繁荣。瑞典军队于1655年占领城镇，随后克日什托夫·热戈茨基率领的游击队将其夺回。1793年普鲁士吞并此地，次年这里便爆发起义；1806年后，城镇一度归入华沙公国，又于1815年重返普鲁士统治。

english: Kościerzyna lies in Kashubia, southwest of Gdańsk, and takes its name from an old Polish word for a thicket. First mentioned in 1284, it passed to the Teutonic Order in 1310 and developed as a small town of traders, craftsmen and farmers. The Second Peace of Thorn returned it to the Polish crown in 1466, when it became a seat of royal starosts in Pomerania. Repeated fires marked its history, including destruction during the Thirteen Years' War and the Polish–Swedish war of 1626–1629. Prussia annexed the town in the First Partition of Poland in 1772.
simp_chinese: 科希切日纳位于格但斯克西南方的卡舒比地区，名称源自意为“灌木丛”的古波兰语。它最早见于1284年的记载，1310年转归条顿骑士团，发展为一座居民以贸易、手工业和耕作为生的小镇。1466年《第二次托伦和约》使其重归波兰王室，成为波美拉尼亚的王室地方官驻地。大火屡次打断城镇生活，包括十三年战争期间，以及1626至1629年的波瑞战争期间的毁坏。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，普鲁士吞并了这座城镇。

english: Kosciusko Bank lies in the wider Polynesian ocean world of the central and southern Pacific. More than a thousand islands are scattered across this immense region. Their Indigenous communities share linguistic relationships and many cultural traditions despite the distances between them.
simp_chinese: 科修斯科浅滩位于太平洋中南部广阔波利尼西亚海洋世界。一千多座岛屿散布这片庞大地区。尽管相隔遥远，原住民社群仍共享语言关系与诸多文化传统。

english: Tuvalu’s reef islands lie south of Kiribati and north of Fiji. The low island chain extends through the tropical waters of western Polynesia.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢礁岛位于基里巴斯以南、斐济以北。低矮岛链延伸于波利尼西亚西部的热带水域。

english: Tuvalu’s coastal waters surround three reef islands and six atolls in the tropical Pacific. The island chain lies north of Fiji and south of Kiribati, and its Polynesian settlers formed part of the wider migrations through the Pacific island world.
simp_chinese: 图瓦卢沿海水域环绕着热带太平洋中的三座礁岛和六座环礁。群岛位于斐济以北、基里巴斯以南，其波利尼西亚居民属于横跨太平洋群岛的大规模迁徙的一部分。

english: Mount Kosciuszko rises to 2,228 metres on the Main Range of Australia's Snowy Mountains. The peak, known in Ngarigo as Kunama Namadgi, is the highest on the Australian mainland.
simp_chinese: 科西阿斯科山位于澳大利亚雪山主脉，海拔二千二百二十八米。山峰在恩加里戈语中称Kunama Namadgi，是澳大利亚大陆最高峰。

english: The Köse Mountains belong to the high country around Sivas. In the wider region, the Kızılırmak valley supports cereal farming and routes linking central Anatolia with Iraq and Iran. Sivas became a meeting point for north–south and east–west trade, while iron deposits at Divriği added mineral wealth.
simp_chinese: 克塞山属于锡瓦斯周围的高地。在更广阔的区域，克孜勒河谷支撑谷物种植，并连接安纳托利亚中部与伊拉克、伊朗的道路。锡瓦斯成为南北与东西贸易的交汇点，迪夫里伊铁矿则增添了矿产财富。

english: These uplands surround Köse in the Gümüşhane region of northeastern Anatolia. The town itself stands more than fifteen hundred metres above sea level, within the mountainous country behind the Black Sea coast.
simp_chinese: 这片高地环绕安纳托利亚东北部居米什哈内地区的克塞。城镇本身海拔超过一千五百米，位于黑海海岸后方的山地。

english: Koshi belongs to Echigo on Honshu’s northwestern side. The wider Hokurikudō division began with Wakasa and the old Koshi province, before Koshi was divided into Echizen, Etchū and Echigo.
simp_chinese: 古志属于本州西北侧的越后。广义北陆道起初包含若狭与古越国，随后古越国分为越前、越中和越后。

english: Off the western shore of Kyushu, the Koshiki Islands rise from the East China Sea about thirty-eight kilometres west of Ichikikushikino. The three principal islands—Kami-Koshiki, Naka-Koshiki and Shimo-Koshiki—are accompanied by small islets and isolated coastal rocks. Their villages belonged to the world of Satsuma; later Meiji-period records describe fourteen villages before their consolidation in 1889. The islands also shelter distinctive bird life, including Japanese wood pigeons and Pleske's grasshopper warblers. The surrounding waters thus enclose both settled islands and the much smaller rocky outliers of the chain.
simp_chinese: 甑岛列岛从九州西岸外的东海中升起，位于市来串木野以西约三十八公里。上甑岛、中甑岛与下甑岛构成三座主岛，周围散布小岛与孤立的岸边岩礁。岛上村落属于萨摩的地域世界；较晚的明治时期记载，在1889年合并以前，这里共有十四个村落。列岛还为日本黑林鸽与斯氏蝗莺等鸟类提供栖息地。环绕列岛的海水中，既有居民聚居的大岛，也有体量小得多的岩质外岛。

english: Koshikishima belongs to Saikaidō, the old Western Sea Circuit of Japan. The wider region comprised Kyushu’s nine provinces together with the islands of Tsushima and Iki.
simp_chinese: 甑岛属于日本古代西海道。更广阔的西海道包含九州九国，以及对马与壹岐两岛。

english: Koshira was first recorded in 1356 beside the river now called Kashirka. Its old site stood on the left bank of the Oka. After devastating Crimean Tatar attacks in 1592 and 1596, the settlement was rebuilt on the opposite bank in 1619.
simp_chinese: 科希拉于一三五六年首次见于记载，得名于如今称为卡希尔卡河的水道。旧城位于奥卡河左岸，一五九二及一五九六年遭克里米亚鞑靼人重创后，于一六一九年在对岸重建。

english: Koshkar Ata lies near a salt-rich seasonal lake in Mangystau, below sea level and close to the Caspian coast. The surrounding land was unsuitable for farming. Twentieth-century uranium processing transformed the lake into a waste repository, leaving a severe environmental legacy.
simp_chinese: 科什卡尔阿塔位于曼吉斯套一座富盐季节湖附近，低于海平面，靠近里海海岸。周围土地不适于农业。二十世纪的铀加工使湖泊成为废物堆放地，留下严重的环境遗产。

english: Koshkarkol Lake belongs to the broader Jetisu setting of Central Asia. The region’s Kazakh name means “seven rivers” and evokes abundant water, with rivers descending toward Lake Balkhash from the southeast.
simp_chinese: 科什卡尔湖属于中亚广义的七河地区。该地区哈萨克语名称意为“七条河流”，体现水源丰沛之意，多条河流由东南流向巴尔喀什湖。

english: Koshki is a rural settlement in the Samara region of Russia. It belongs to the modern district of Koshkinsky, among the settlements of the country northeast of Samara.
simp_chinese: 科什基是俄罗斯萨马拉地区的一处乡村聚落。现代行政上它属于科什金区，构成萨马拉东北方地区的聚落之一。

english: Koshkonong belongs to the broader Wisconsin country of the Great Lakes. The region faces Lake Michigan to the east and Lake Superior to the north, combining northern forests with varied inland hills.
simp_chinese: 科什科农属于五大湖更广阔的威斯康星地区。这里东临密歇根湖、北接苏必利尔湖，兼有北方森林与多样的内陆丘陵。

english: Koshoy Korgon is a ruined fortress in the At-Bashy country, immediately southeast of Kara-Suu and west of At-Bashy village. Earthen walls enclose a broad area, giving material form to the name korgon, or fortress. Its construction date remains uncertain. Tradition connects the site with Qoshoy baatyr, a general of the epic hero Manas, after whom the fortress is named; that association belongs to the world of heroic memory rather than a secure building chronology. The surviving walls nevertheless mark a substantial fortified place in this mountain region of what is now Kyrgyzstan.
simp_chinese: 科绍伊科尔贡是阿特巴什地区的一处城堡遗址，紧邻卡拉苏村东南，位于阿特巴什村以西。土墙环抱着宽阔的内部空间，与意为“堡垒”的科尔贡之名相呼应。其确切建造年代仍无定论。传统将遗址与史诗英雄玛纳斯麾下的将领科绍伊巴特尔相联系，城堡也因此得名；这种联系属于英雄传说的记忆，尚不能确立可靠的营建年代。留存的城墙仍表明，在今吉尔吉斯斯坦的这片山区，曾存在一处规模可观的设防据点。

english: Kosi belongs to the Purnia country of Mithila. The wider Mithila region became a major political and cultural centre in the late Vedic period, associated with the kingdom of Videha.
simp_chinese: 戈西属于弥萨罗的布尔尼亚地区。更广的弥萨罗在吠陀晚期成为重要政治文化中心，与毗提诃王国相关。

english:
Košice, also known as Kassa and Kaschau, grew beside the Hornád on a trading route between central Hungary and Poland. First recorded as Villa Cassa in 1230, it received German settlers after the Mongol invasion of 1241. Two settlements merged around the long, lens-shaped space that became its main street. Royal privileges encouraged commerce, crafts and fortification; guild regulations recorded in 1307 were the earliest known in the Hungarian kingdom.

The town supported the crown at the battle of Rozgony in 1312 and later ranked among Hungary’s foremost free royal towns. Louis I granted its coat of arms in 1369, while the rebuilding of Saint Elizabeth’s church expressed the wealth of its merchants. In the early modern centuries, Košice became both an administrative centre of Upper Hungary and a prize in struggles involving the Habsburgs, Transylvanian princes and insurgent armies. The same position that enriched it through trade repeatedly drew it into war.
simp_chinese:
科希策又称考绍或卡绍，位于霍尔纳德河畔，扼守匈牙利中部与波兰之间的商路。1230年的文献以Villa Cassa之名记载此地；1241年蒙古入侵后，德国移民迁来定居。两个聚落围绕一片狭长、两端收束的空间合并，这里后来成为城市主街。王室特许推动贸易、手工业与城防建设，1307年记录的行会规章是匈牙利王国已知最早的同类文献。

城镇在1312年罗兹戈尼战役中支持王权，后来跻身匈牙利最重要的王室自由城市之列。1369年，拉约什一世赐予城市纹章，圣伊丽莎白教堂的重建则彰显商人的财富。近代早期，科希策既是上匈牙利的行政中心，也是哈布斯堡王朝、特兰西瓦尼亚诸王公和起义军争夺的目标。使它凭贸易致富的地理位置，也屡次将它卷入战争。

english: Kosichkoj belongs to the Novgorod country of northwestern Russia. Across the wider region, lowlands around Lake Ilmen contrast with the Valdai uplands to the east. Veliky Novgorod and Staraya Russa rank among the oldest Russian towns in this lake-and-river landscape.
simp_chinese: 科西奇科伊属于俄罗斯西北部的诺夫哥罗德地区。从更广阔区域看，伊尔门湖周围的低地与东部瓦尔代高地形成对照。大诺夫哥罗德与旧鲁萨是这片湖河地带中俄罗斯历史最悠久的城镇之一。

english:
Kosiv grew beside the Rybnytsia River in the Hutsul country of the Carpathian foothills. A settlement bearing its name appears in a charter of the Lithuanian duke Švitrigaila in 1424; that earlier village became known as Old Kosiv. In 1565 a new town called Rukiv was founded nearby. After destruction and rebuilding, it took the name Kosiv, carrying the older name to a new urban site.

Polish rule lasted until the first partition of Poland in 1772, when the town passed into Habsburg Galicia. Local craft traditions gave this small settlement an identity beyond its changes of ruler. Its distinctive painted ceramics developed in the eighteenth century and became a lasting expression of Hutsul history and culture.
simp_chinese:
科西夫在喀尔巴阡山麓胡楚尔人的土地上，沿雷布尼察河发展起来。1424年，立陶宛公爵斯维特里盖拉的一份文书已提到这个名字；早期村庄后来被称为旧科西夫。1565年，附近新建了一座名为鲁基夫的城镇。它在毁坏后重建，继而采用科西夫之名，让旧名称延续于新的城镇地点。

波兰的统治持续到1772年第一次瓜分波兰，此后城镇归入哈布斯堡的加利西亚。除了统治者的更替，当地工艺传统也赋予这座小城鲜明面貌。独特的彩绘陶器在十八世纪发展起来，成为胡楚尔历史与文化绵延至今的表达。

english: Koskoak lies by northern Quebec’s Koksoak, formed where the Melezes and Caniapiscau rivers meet. It flows northeast into Ungava Bay; its name is associated with the Inuktitut Kuujjuaq, meaning Great River.
simp_chinese: 科斯科阿克位于魁北克北部科克索克河畔，河流由梅莱兹河与卡尼亚皮斯考河汇合而成，向东北流入昂加瓦湾，名称与意为“大河”的因纽特语Kuujjuaq相关。

english: Koskuduk belongs to the lower Emba country of the wider Kipchak steppe. Medieval Islamic writers called that broad grassland Dasht-i Qipchaq, while Latin writers used Cumania for the Cuman–Kipchak confederation of the western Eurasian steppe.
simp_chinese: 科斯库杜克属于钦察草原的下恩巴地区。中世纪伊斯兰作者称这一广阔草原为Dasht-i Qipchaq；拉丁文作者则以Cumania称呼欧亚草原西部的库曼—钦察联盟。

english: Kosoge belongs to Ethiopia’s Simien mountain country. The wider highlands consist of plateaus divided by valleys and pinnacles and support distinctive animals including geladas and walia ibex.
simp_chinese: 科索格属于埃塞俄比亚的瑟门山区。更广阔的高地由谷地与尖峰分隔的高原构成，养育着狮尾狒和瓦利亚野山羊等独特动物。

english: Koson lies in Uzbekistan’s historical Sogdian region. Its fortified settlement grew after the decline of Yerkurgan, and caravan trade helped sustain a city with castle remains dating to the fourth and fifth centuries.
simp_chinese: 科松位于乌兹别克斯坦历史上的粟特地区。设防聚落在叶尔库尔干衰落后发展，商队贸易支撑着城市，留存城堡遗迹可追溯至4至5世纪。

english: Kosozhichi belongs to the Kursk country of the eastern European borderlands. Kursk developed as a fortified settlement and became a stronghold of the Kievan princes on their southeastern frontier.
simp_chinese: 科索日奇属于东欧边地的库尔斯克地区。库尔斯克从设防聚落发展而来，成为基辅诸王公东南边境上的据点。

english:
Kosrae is a volcanic high island at the eastern end of the Carolines, ringed by coral reefs and smaller coastal islets. Its traditional name Ualung means the high island. On nearby Lelu, a substantial settlement flourished from about 1250, covering some twenty-seven hectares at its height and containing pyramidal tombs for the nobility.

By the early nineteenth century, Kosraean society was organised through matrilineal clans and sharply distinguished ranks. Nobles controlled land cultivated by commoners, while related families gathered around shared cook houses. Breadfruit was a staple, stored in leaf-lined pits against scarcity; lagoon fish, taro and other crops supplemented it. Saavedra recorded a sighting in 1529, but Spain's later claim did not bring immediate occupation. When the French corvette La Coquille anchored at Okat in June 1824, members of its crew crossed the island and visited Lelu, encountering an island society with its own longstanding institutions.
simp_chinese:
科斯雷是加罗林群岛东端的一座火山高岛，四周环绕珊瑚礁与近岸小岛。其传统名称乌阿隆意为“高岛”。邻近的莱卢岛自约1250年起兴起了一处规模可观的聚落，鼎盛时占地约27公顷，并建有贵族的金字塔形陵墓。

到19世纪初，科斯雷社会依母系氏族组织起来，等级区分鲜明。贵族控制土地，由平民耕种；有亲缘关系的家庭则共用炊事屋。面包果是主要食物，人们将其保存在铺有树叶的坑中，以备短缺之时；潟湖鱼类、芋头与其他作物补充着日常膳食。萨韦德拉在1529年留下了目击这座岛屿的记录，但西班牙后来提出的主权声索并未立即带来实际占领。1824年6月，法国轻型军舰“拉科基耶”号停泊奥卡特，其船员穿越主岛并访问莱卢，接触到一个早有自身制度的岛屿社会。

english: Kosrae's coastal waters surround a high island in the Caroline archipelago. The island was settled by the early first millennium CE, and the later town of Leluh included monumental burial structures for its nobility.
simp_chinese: 科斯雷沿岸水域环绕加罗林群岛的一座高岛。该岛至迟于公元一千纪初已有定居，后来的莱卢城还拥有供贵族使用的大型墓葬建筑。

english: The high seas off Kosrae form part of the wider Micronesian ocean world. Across this tropical maritime region, scattered island chains share cultural connections with Polynesia, Melanesia and maritime Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 科斯雷远海属于广阔的密克罗尼西亚海洋地区。在这片热带海洋区域，零散岛链与波利尼西亚、美拉尼西亚及海洋东南亚保持文化联系。

english: The Kosrae High Sea faces the eastern end of the Caroline island chain. On nearby Kosrae, construction of the great Leluh complex began around 1200, part of a wider Micronesian tradition of monumental building.
simp_chinese: 科斯雷远海面向加罗林群岛链的东端。邻近科斯雷岛上的大型莱卢建筑群约在1200年开始修建，属于更广阔的密克罗尼西亚纪念性建筑传统。

english: These waters lie near Kosrae in the wider Micronesian Pacific. Across this tropical maritime region, small islands share cultural connections with Maritime Southeast Asia, Melanesia and Polynesia.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于科斯雷附近的密克罗尼西亚太平洋地区。整个热带海洋区域的小岛，与海洋东南亚、美拉尼西亚及波利尼西亚共享文化联系。

english: The Kosrae High Sea lies within the broad Micronesian oceanic region. Across this expanse, small islands and archipelagos share a tropical marine climate and cultural relationships within the wider Austronesian world.
simp_chinese: 科斯雷远海位于广阔的密克罗尼西亚海洋地区。在这片空间中，小岛与群岛处于热带海洋气候下，并与更广泛的南岛语族世界具有文化关联。

english: Kostenets occupies a valley at the foot of Bulgaria’s Rila and Sredna Gora ranges. Abundant mineral springs distinguish the district and underpin the spa settlement of Momin Prohod nearby.
simp_chinese: 科斯泰内茨位于保加利亚里拉山与中山山脉脚下的谷地。丰富矿泉是这一地区的显著特点，也成为附近莫明普罗霍德温泉聚落的基础。

english:
On the Zamchysko River in Volhynia, Kostopil began as a village associated with a local iron mine. Registers of 1648–1658 mention it among the possessions of Prince Władysław Dominik Zasławski. Its early character thus belonged to a landscape of landed estates and small-scale extraction rather than to the industrial town of later centuries.

In 1792 the landowner Leonard Wortzel secured town privileges, including an annual fair, from Stanisław August Poniatowski, the last king of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. Wortzel also gave the settlement the name Kostopol. The partitions soon brought Volhynia under Russian rule, and German settlers established numerous villages in the surrounding region. The town's later industrial expansion followed the opening of a railway station in the late nineteenth century, adding mills, timber works and factories to the older mining settlement.
simp_chinese:
科斯托皮尔位于沃里尼亚的扎姆奇斯科河畔，最初是一座依托当地铁矿的村庄。1648至1658年的登记册将它列在瓦迪斯瓦夫·多米尼克·扎斯瓦夫斯基亲王的领地之中。因此，它早期的面貌属于庄园与小规模开采构成的乡土世界，尚未成为后来数世纪的工业城镇。

1792年，地主莱昂纳德·沃策尔从波兰立陶宛联邦末代国王斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基手中取得城镇特权，其中包括举办年度集市的权利。沃策尔也将聚落改名为科斯托波尔。瓜分波兰之后，沃里尼亚很快转入俄罗斯统治，德国移民在周围地区建立了许多村庄。直到十九世纪晚期火车站开通，城镇才进入后来的工业扩张阶段，各类磨坊、木材加工厂与工厂为古老矿村增添了新的产业。

english: At the meeting of the Kostroma and Volga rivers, Kostroma occupied a northern position within the lands that came under Moscow's rule. Its traditional foundation is attributed to Yury Dolgoruky in 1152. Mongol troops sacked the town in 1238; it subsequently formed a small principality before Ivan I of Moscow acquired it. Its relative distance from Moscow made it a refuge for grand princes during attacks on their capital, although Novgorodian river raiders plundered Kostroma itself in 1375. Connections with English and Dutch merchants through Archangel helped its sixteenth-century trade. The stone monasteries rebuilt under Boris Godunov, particularly the Ipatiev monastery associated with Mikhail Romanov, tied the town to dynastic history. A great fire in 1773 brought another transformation: reconstruction laid out streets radiating from a centre near the river, with arcaded markets and neoclassical public buildings.
simp_chinese: 科斯特罗马位于科斯特罗马河与伏尔加河交汇处，在后来归属莫斯科的领土中处于偏北的位置。传统将其建立归于1152年的尤里·多尔戈鲁基。蒙古军队于1238年洗劫此城；此后这里成为一个小公国，最终由莫斯科的伊凡一世购得。它远离莫斯科，曾在首都遭受攻击时为大公提供避难之所，尽管科斯特罗马本身也于1375年遭诺夫哥罗德的河上劫掠者洗劫。经由阿尔汉格尔斯克同英格兰及荷兰商人建立的联系，促进了这里16世纪的贸易。鲍里斯·戈杜诺夫时期以石材重建的修道院，尤其是与米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫有关的伊帕季耶夫修道院，将城镇同王朝历史相联。1773年的大火又带来一次转变：重建以河畔的一处中心向外辐射街道，配以带拱廊的市场和新古典主义公共建筑。

english: Koszalin, known in German as Köslin, stands inland from the Baltic beside the Dzierżęcinka River. Its medieval fortunes were shaped by the bishops of Cammin: Bishop Hermann von Gleichen granted the settlement Lübeck law in 1266, and it became a centre of diocesan administration. Acquisitions around Lake Jamno gave the town access to the sea, allowing it to enter the Hanseatic League in 1386. Maritime commerce brought rivalry with Kołobrzeg and Darłowo rather than untroubled prosperity. In 1475, a quarrel with Duke Bogislaw X went so far that the townspeople kidnapped and briefly imprisoned him. The early fourteenth-century church of St Mary remains a monument to a community whose merchants and magistrates could challenge both neighbouring ports and their own prince.
simp_chinese: 科沙林，德语称克斯林，位于波罗的海岸内陆、杰日琴卡河畔。它的中世纪命运与卡明主教密切相关：赫尔曼·冯·格莱兴主教于1266年授予聚落吕贝克法，这里随后成为教区行政中心。在亚姆诺湖周围获得的土地，让城镇取得出海通路，并于1386年加入汉萨同盟。海上贸易也带来与科沃布热格及达尔沃沃的竞争。1475年，城镇与博吉斯瓦夫十世公爵的冲突，竟发展到市民绑架并短暂囚禁公爵的地步。十四世纪初的圣母教堂，至今见证着这个商人与官吏既能挑战邻近港口、也敢对抗自身领主的城市社群。

english: Kot Addu stands just east of the Indus on the flat alluvial country of southern Punjab, within reach of Multan. River water is central to this landscape: cultivated plains and orchards support mangoes, citrus and other fruit, alongside fields of wheat, cotton and sugarcane. Growers can send cane to sugar mills or turn it into jaggery, linking the harvest to local processing and cottage industry. The dry climate brings very hot summers and dust storms, while the river can also bring destructive monsoon floods. In the modern landscape, canals supplied from the Indus and the nearby Tonsa Barrage regulate irrigation, continuing the dependence of settlement and cultivation on the great river.
simp_chinese: 科特阿杜坐落在印度河以东、旁遮普南部平坦的冲积平原上，与木尔坦相距不远。河水是这片土地的命脉：农田与果园出产芒果、柑橘等水果，也种植小麦、棉花和甘蔗。种植者可以把甘蔗送往糖厂，或将其熬成粗糖，使收获与本地加工及家庭手工业相连。干旱气候带来酷热夏季与沙尘暴，河流也会在季风期间造成破坏性洪水。在现代景观中，印度河供水的运河与附近的陶萨拦河坝调节灌溉，延续着聚落和耕作对这条大河的依赖。

english: Kot Lalu lies in northern Sindh near Khairpur. Fertile fields alternate with patches of sand dunes around the town. An old earthen fort preserves a trace of its defensive past, while Sindhi remains the main language of the local population.
simp_chinese: 科特拉鲁位于信德北部海尔布尔附近，城镇周围肥沃田地与局部沙丘交错。一座古老土堡保留了防御历史的痕迹，信德语仍是当地人口的主要语言。

english: Kot Marot belongs to the Cholistan desert country of Punjab. The wider desert supported caravan trade, and medieval forts were built to protect its routes, with Derawar among the best-preserved examples.
simp_chinese: 科特马罗特处于旁遮普的乔利斯坦沙漠地区。整个沙漠曾支持商队贸易，中世纪修建堡垒保护路线，德拉瓦堡是其中保存较好的实例。

english: Kota belongs to Hadoti, the southeastern Rajasthani country named after the Hada Rajputs. The region’s identity took shape with the capture of Bundi in 1241 and Kota in 1264, amid river valleys watered by the Chambal and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 科塔属于因哈达拉杰普特人得名的拉贾斯坦东南部哈多蒂地区。1241年本迪与1264年科塔的征服塑造了地区身份，昌巴尔河及支流滋养其河谷。

english: Kota Kapur on the western coast of Bangka is remembered for an Old Malay inscription written in Pallava script. Dated to 686, it invokes punishment for treason against Srivijaya and refers to preparations for an expedition against Java. This stone links the village with the maritime kingdom’s authority across the straits off southern Sumatra.
simp_chinese: 邦加西岸的哥打卡普尔以一方用帕拉瓦文字书写的古马来语碑铭闻名。碑铭纪年为686年，诅咒背叛室利佛逝者，并提及向爪哇出征的准备。这块石碑将村庄与这一海上王国跨越苏门答腊南部海峡的权力联系起来。

english: Kota Marudu lies near the northern tip of Borneo, in the country behind Marudu Bay. The name appears as Marudo on maps associated with Benjamin Wright in 1601 and Johannes Cloppenburgh around 1632, while other old charts use Malloodoo. Bandau is another name attached to the locality; a Rungus tradition connects it with Mondou, the leader of all beasts. The present name recalls a fort built at the bay by Sharif Usman. Heavy rainfall sustains the surrounding agricultural country, where maize has become sufficiently important to be honoured with an annual festival.
simp_chinese: 哥打马鲁杜位于婆罗洲北端附近，处在马鲁杜湾后方的地域。其名称以Marudo的形式见于本杰明·赖特1601年和约翰内斯·克洛彭堡约1632年的地图，另一些旧海图则写作Malloodoo。班道也是当地的旧称；龙古斯人的传统将它与“万兽之首”Mondou联系起来。今天的名称纪念谢里夫·乌斯曼在海湾修建的一座堡垒。丰沛降雨滋养周边农耕地区，玉米更成为重要作物，当地每年专门举行节庆纪念它。

english: Kotapinang is a town of northern Sumatra. It became the administrative seat of South Labuhan Batu regency when that district was separated from Labuhanbatu in 2008.
simp_chinese: 哥打槟榔是苏门答腊北部的一座城镇。2008年南拉布汉巴都从拉布汉巴都分设后，它成为新行政区的治所。

english: Kota Rentang belongs to the broader Deli country on Sumatra’s eastern coast. The later Sultanate of Deli arose during Aceh’s seventeenth-century expansion, when commander Gocah Pahlawan conquered the area under Iskandar Muda.
simp_chinese: 哥打兰樟属于苏门答腊东岸更广阔的碟里地区。后来的碟里苏丹国兴起于亚齐十七世纪扩张期间，伊斯坎达尔·穆达统治下的将领戈查·巴拉宛征服了这里。

english: Kotabumi is the chief administrative town of North Lampung in southern Sumatra. Its modern district covers just over eighty square kilometers and counted roughly fifty-eight thousand people in 2024.
simp_chinese: 哥打布米是苏门答腊南部北楠榜的主要行政城镇。现代辖区面积略超80平方公里，2024年人口约五万八千。

english: Kotagad belongs to the wider Odisha country of eastern India. The region stretches toward the Bay of Bengal and is also remembered by the historical name Utkala, preserving a distinct regional identity.
simp_chinese: 科塔加德属于印度东部更广阔的奥里萨地区。该地区延伸至孟加拉湾方向，也以历史名称乌特卡拉为人所知，保留着独特的区域身份。

english: Kotalipara belongs to the country of Gopalganj in Bengal, between the neighbouring districts of Madaripur, Barisal and Pirojpur. Its foundation is associated with Chandravarman of the Pushkarna dynasty of Vanga, giving the place a history reaching back to the older kingdoms of Bengal. The name now covers both a town and a much larger surrounding subdivision, whose numerous villages should not be confused with a single great city. Even in the twenty-first century, most inhabitants of this wider Kotalipara country lived outside its urban areas.
simp_chinese: 科塔利帕拉位于孟加拉的戈帕尔甘杰地区，邻近马达里布尔、巴里萨尔与皮罗杰布尔诸县。其创建与万伽地区普什卡尔纳王朝的旃陀罗跋摩相联系，使这里的历史可追溯至孟加拉的古老王国。如今这一名称既指城镇，也指范围大得多的周边行政区，散布其间的众多村落不应被当作一座大城。即使到了21世纪，这片广义科塔利帕拉地区的大多数居民仍生活在城镇以外。

english: Kotano Muna belongs to Muna Island southeast of Sulawesi. The wider island lies west of Buton and is known for ancient cave art.
simp_chinese: 科塔诺穆纳属于苏拉威西东南的穆纳岛。整座岛位于布敦以西，以古老洞穴艺术著称。

english: Kotawaringin Bay opens from the Borneo coast into the Indonesian seas. The wider archipelago joined local island communities with long-distance trade well before European colonial expansion.
simp_chinese: 哥打瓦林因湾从婆罗洲海岸通向印度尼西亚诸海。在欧洲殖民扩张之前，更广泛群岛早已将地方岛民社群接入远距离贸易。

english: Kotawaringin Lama was the historic capital of the Kotawaringin Sultanate on southern Borneo. The town stood on the eastern bank of the Lamandau River, northwest of Pangkalan Bun.
simp_chinese: 旧哥打瓦林因是婆罗洲南部哥打瓦林因苏丹国的历史首府。城镇位于兰曼道河东岸、庞卡兰布恩西北。

english: Kotelva grew beside the river of the same name, a tributary of the Vorskla, on the wooded edge of the Ukrainian steppe. The settlement emerged in the sixteenth century and appears in written records in 1582. Its inhabitants joined the Cossack struggles against Polish authority, including the uprising led by Bohdan Khmelnytsky. Through the later seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, a fortress here guarded against Crimean and Nogai attacks. Kotelva subsequently belonged to the Okhtyrka regiment of Sloboda Ukraine; its castle was rebuilt in 1718, while the Holy Trinity Church followed in 1812. These successive works marked the transformation of a frontier stronghold into an established country town.
simp_chinese: 科捷利瓦沿同名河流发展起来；这条河是沃尔斯克拉河的支流，流经乌克兰草原边缘的林地。聚落形成于十六世纪，并于1582年见诸文字记载。居民参与了反抗波兰当局的哥萨克斗争，其中包括博赫丹·赫梅利尼茨基领导的起义。十七世纪后半叶至十八世纪前半叶，当地堡垒抵御着克里米亚与诺盖军队的袭击。科捷利瓦后来归属斯洛博达乌克兰的阿赫特尔卡团；城堡于1718年重建，圣三一教堂则建于1812年。这些先后兴建的建筑，留下了边疆要塞逐渐转变为稳定乡镇的印记。

english: Kothagudem lies in the low country of Telangana, at an elevation of about eighty-nine metres. Under the Nizam it formed part of the extensive estate known as Husanabad Shankaragiri, or the Palvancha Zamindari. The holder of Palvancha was also the zamindar of Bhadrachalam, connecting these places through the authority of a shared landed lord. The town's municipal organization belongs to a much later period, beginning in 1971; its earlier history is bound to the estate and the Nizam's dominions. The region is also marked by fierce summer heat, with temperatures sometimes exceeding forty-eight degrees.
simp_chinese: 科塔古登位于特伦甘纳的低地，海拔约八十九米。在尼扎姆统治时期，此地属于名为侯赛纳巴德尚卡拉吉里、又称帕尔万查柴明达尔领的大庄园。帕尔万查的领主同时也是巴德拉查拉姆的柴明达尔，两地因此通过同一地主的权威相联系。城镇的市政建制直到1971年才出现；更早的历史则与这片庄园及尼扎姆领地相连。当地还以酷烈的夏季高温为特征，气温有时超过摄氏四十八度。

english: Kotonkoro belongs to the wider Sahelian setting between Sahara and Sudanian savanna. The region’s Arabic-derived name evokes a shore, reflecting the idea of a habitable fringe along the southern edge of the desert.
simp_chinese: 科通科罗处于撒哈拉与苏丹稀树草原之间广义的萨赫勒区域。地区名称源于阿拉伯语海岸一词，反映沙漠南缘宜居地带如岸线延伸的意象。

english: At the secluded head of a deeply indented Adriatic bay, Kotor grew between the water and steep limestone heights. Under the Nemanjić rulers of Serbia it retained substantial privileges and republican institutions, and its fourteenth-century commerce rivaled that of Ragusa. The cathedral of Saint Tryphon, completed in 1166, belonged to a city whose maritime connections reached beyond its shifting political allegiances. After a period of independence, Kotor accepted Venetian suzerainty in 1420 as Ottoman power approached. Venetian rule lasted until 1797 and left a formidable circuit of defenses climbing toward Saint Ivan. Sieges, plague and earthquakes repeatedly tested the port, yet its streets and institutions continued to bind the Balkan interior to the Adriatic trading world.
simp_chinese: 科托尔位于亚得里亚海一道曲折海湾的幽深尽头，城镇在水面与陡峭的石灰岩山岭之间成长。在塞尔维亚尼曼雅王朝统治下，它保留了可观的特权与共和制度，14世纪的商业足以与拉古萨竞争。1166年落成的圣特里丰主教座堂，属于一座海上联系远超政治归属变迁的城市。经历一段独立时期后，科托尔在奥斯曼势力逼近之际，于1420年接受威尼斯宗主权。威尼斯统治延续至1797年，留下了沿山攀向圣伊万高处的坚固防御体系。围城、瘟疫与地震反复考验港口，其街道和制度仍将巴尔干内陆与亚得里亚海贸易世界联结起来。

english: Near Huánuco, Kotosh preserves the buildings of communities that flourished long before the Inca. Its earliest identified phase, called Mito, belongs to the age before pottery and includes the Temple of the Crossed Hands, named for the paired arms that became a characteristic image of the sanctuary. The later Wairajirca phase introduced polished brown and black ceramics, decorated with incisions and paint applied after firing. Subsequent levels contain evidence of maize cultivation and pottery with affinities to Chavín traditions. The structures and deposits record successive periods of activity rather than a single founding moment. Kotosh thus reveals an Andean past built through changes in ritual, farming and craft, far older than the imperial settlements of later centuries.
simp_chinese: 在瓦努科附近，科托什保存着远早于印加帝国的社群建筑。当地最早辨认出的文化阶段称为米托，属于尚未使用陶器的时代，其中包括交叉双手神庙；成对交叉的手臂构成了这座圣所的典型图像。后来的瓦伊拉希尔卡阶段出现了磨光的褐色与黑色陶器，并用刻纹和烧后施彩加以装饰。再往后的地层显示出玉米种植的证据，以及与查文传统相近的陶器。这里的建筑和堆积记录了前后相继的活动阶段，难以归结为一次单独的建城。科托什因而展现出由仪式、农耕与工艺变迁逐步构成的安第斯往事，远比后世帝国聚落更加古老。

english: Kotovo lies in the Don drainage country north of Volgograd. Founded in the 1710s, the settlement eventually became the centre of its surrounding district and received town status in 1966.
simp_chinese: 科托沃位于伏尔加格勒以北的顿河流域地区。聚落建立于十八世纪一〇年代，后来成为周围行政区的中心，并于1966年取得城市地位。

english: Kotpad lies in the Koraput country of Odisha, where the town's identity is closely tied to the loom. Weavers of the Mirgan community make the vegetable-dyed cloth known as Kotpad handloom, and the settlement is renowned for saris and other woven goods. Its local past also survives in the name Damayantinagar, by which the area was formerly known. Near the Shiva temple lies Damayanti Sagar, a place associated with this older identity. Together, the remembered name and the continuing craft tradition give this inland settlement a character rooted in both sacred places and skilled household production.
simp_chinese: 科特帕德位于奥里萨的科拉普特地区，城镇的身份与织机紧密相连。米尔甘社区的织工以植物染料制作称为科特帕德手织布的织物，聚落也以纱丽和其他织品著称。当地往昔还保存在达玛扬蒂纳加尔这一旧称之中。湿婆神庙附近的达玛扬蒂萨加尔，与这段较早的地方记忆相联系。流传下来的地名与延续至今的手艺，使这座内陆聚落的特色同时扎根于宗教场所和熟练的家庭生产。

english: Lake Kotra belongs to the Changtang, the high lake-and-upland country of western and northern Tibet. This wider region is home to Changpa nomads and experiences short summers and bitter winters at great altitude.
simp_chinese: 科特拉错属于西藏西部与北部高地湖泊相间的羌塘地区。更广阔的羌塘是昌巴游牧民的家园，高海拔环境中夏季短促、冬季严寒。

english: Kotri stands on the right bank of the Indus in lower Sindh. Its name is a diminutive of kot, the word for a fort, giving the settlement the modest title of little fort. The riverbank location remains central to its identity, and fishing is among the activities for which the town is known. In later times textile production also became an important local industry. The present city serves as the headquarters of its surrounding taluka in the Jamshoro district, preserving a small-fort name amid the much larger settlement that has developed beside the Indus.
simp_chinese: 科特里位于下信德的印度河右岸。其名称是意为堡垒的kot一词的指小形式，因而带有‘小堡’之意。河岸位置始终是此地身份的重要部分，渔业也是城镇为人所知的产业之一。较晚时期，纺织生产成为当地另一项重要工业。现今城市是贾姆肖罗县下属同名塔卢卡的行政中心；印度河畔聚落规模已大为扩展，名称中仍保留着那座‘小堡’的印记。

english: Kottarakkara lies inland from Kollam in southern Kerala, and its name combines the words for palace and land. Known historically as Elayadathu Swarupam, it was the seat of a principality governed by a branch of the Travancore royal house. Its strongest cultural association is with the origins of Kathakali. In the seventeenth century Prince Kottarakkara Thampuran developed Ramanattam, a dance-drama tradition that helped give rise to this celebrated art. The town's palace remains closely linked with that theatrical inheritance, while the Mahaganapathy temple is known for offerings of unniyappam, small sweet cakes distributed as sacred food.
simp_chinese: 科塔拉卡拉位于喀拉拉南部奎隆的内陆，其地名由“宫殿”与“土地”两词组成。历史上此地称埃拉亚达图·斯瓦鲁帕姆，是由特拉凡哥尔王族支系统治的一处小邦驻地。当地最鲜明的文化联系是卡塔卡利舞剧的起源。十七世纪，科塔拉卡拉·坦普兰王子发展出拉玛纳塔姆舞剧传统，推动了这一著名艺术的形成。镇上的宫殿与这份戏剧遗产密切相关，摩诃迦那帕提神庙则以供奉乌尼亚帕姆小甜饼闻名，甜饼作为圣食分发。

english: Kotte began as a fortress built by Alakesvara in the late fourteenth century to resist attacks along Sri Lanka’s western coast. Protected by extensive swamps, it became the capital of a Sinhalese kingdom that flourished during the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 科特最初是阿拉克斯瓦拉在14世纪后期修建的堡垒，用以抵御沿斯里兰卡西海岸而来的进攻。广阔沼泽为它提供天然保护，后来这里成为15世纪繁荣的僧伽罗王国都城。

english: Kotto follows a tributary of the Ubangi in the Central African Republic. Rising south of the Bongo Massif, the river flows past Bria and through rapids before joining the Ubangi east of Mobaye.
simp_chinese: 科托沿中非共和国乌班吉河的一条支流展开。河流发源于邦戈山地南侧，经过布里亚与多处急流，在莫巴伊以东汇入乌班吉河。

english: Kouandé lies in the Atakora country of northern Benin and is home to Bariba communities. Its local monarchy has existed since at least the eighteenth century and was once part of the Borgu federation. The survival of that kingship alongside later systems of administration preserves an older political identity within the town. In modern times the name Kouandé designates both the settlement and a much wider commune covering some 4,500 square kilometres.
simp_chinese: 宽代位于贝宁北部的阿塔科拉地区，有巴里巴社群居住。当地王权至少自十八世纪起便已存在，曾经属于博尔古联邦。王权与后来的行政制度并存，使城镇保留了较早的政治认同。在现代，宽代一名既指这处聚落，也指面积约4500平方公里、范围更广的市镇。

english: Kouate belongs to the wider St Lawrence country around Stadacona. The Iroquoian village near the future Quebec City helped give Canada its name, from a word meaning town. Its precise site remains uncertain, generally placed near the Saint-Charles and St Lawrence confluence.
simp_chinese: 夸特属于斯塔达科纳周围更广阔的圣劳伦斯河地区。未来魁北克城附近的易洛魁村落，使意为城镇的词语成为加拿大名称的来源。村落确切位置仍不确定，通常认为在圣夏尔河与圣劳伦斯河交汇处附近。

english: Kouchibouguac belongs to the wider New Brunswick region. This maritime country faces the Gulf of Saint Lawrence and Bay of Fundy, with extensive forests and Appalachian uplands in its north.
simp_chinese: 库希布瓜克属于新不伦瑞克地区。这片沿海地域面向圣劳伦斯湾与芬迪湾，北部拥有大片森林和阿巴拉契亚高地。

english: Koudougou stands on the Mossi Plateau, west of Ouagadougou, among communities of Mossi and Gurunsi people. Agriculture anchors the surrounding economy, while the town serves as a market and a place where cotton, shea butter and other local products are processed. Its prominent role in modern transport came much later than the age of the Mossi kingdoms: in 1952, a railway linked it with Ouagadougou and Abidjan. That connection helped place an inland agricultural centre on a route reaching the distant Atlantic coast.
simp_chinese: 库杜古坐落在瓦加杜古以西的莫西高原，居民中有莫西人与古伦西人。农业是周边经济的支柱，城镇则提供集市，并加工棉花、乳木果脂等地方产品。它在现代交通中的突出地位，出现于远晚于莫西诸王国的时代：1952年，铁路将这里与瓦加杜古和阿比让连接起来。这条线路使内陆的农业中心接上了一条通往遥远大西洋海岸的通道。

english: Kougouri belongs to the eastern Mossi country of Burkina Faso. Across the wider Volta basin, Mòoré-speaking Mossi communities developed royal traditions and a distinctive social order. Their origin stories recall the warrior princess Yennenga and a Mandé hunter, joining ancestry, kingship and the land.
simp_chinese: 库古里属于布基纳法索东部莫西地域。在较广的沃尔特河盆地，讲莫雷语的莫西社群发展出王权传统与独特社会秩序。其起源故事追溯女战士叶能加公主与曼德猎人，将祖源、王权与土地联系起来。

english: Koka belongs to Omi, the old Japanese province surrounding Lake Biwa. Omi formed part of the Tosando circuit and was classified as a great country near the imperial capital. Its position linked Kyoto’s approaches with routes toward the central mountains.
simp_chinese: 甲贺属于环绕琵琶湖的日本古近江国。近江是东山道一部分，被列为靠近皇都的大国。其位置将京都门户与通向中部山地的道路相连。

english: Koulikoro stands on the Niger downstream from Bamako, at a significant break in the river's navigable course. The Sotuba Rapids near Bamako prevent vessels from continuing upstream beyond this reach. Downriver, the waters connect Koulikoro with Ségou, Mopti, Timbuktu and Gao; the months after the rains, from August to November, allow goods to move along that route. The town's better-known transport institutions belong to a later age. In 1904 it became the terminus of the completed Dakar–Niger Railway, joining an Atlantic railway route to the inland waterway. This meeting of river and rail should be distinguished from the older geographical importance of the Niger and its rapids.
simp_chinese: 库利科罗坐落在巴马科下游的尼日尔河畔，处于河流通航条件发生重要变化的地段。巴马科附近的索图巴急流阻碍船只继续向上游航行。向下游，河道则连接塞古、莫普提、廷巴克图和加奥；雨季结束后的八月至十一月，货物可以沿这条线路运送。城镇较为知名的交通设施属于更晚的时代。1904年，达喀尔—尼日尔铁路建成，库利科罗成为其终点，将通往大西洋的铁路与内陆水道接合起来。河运与铁路的这一交会，应与尼日尔河及其急流更古老的地理意义区分开来。

english: Stone-built houses, narrow streets, and a congregational mosque mark Koumbi Saleh as a substantial medieval town in the southern Mauritanian Sahel. Its main urban flourishing is dated approximately to the eleventh through fourteenth centuries. The ruins are often identified with the capital of the Ghana Empire, whose wealth rested in part on trans-Saharan gold commerce, but that identification remains disputed. Al-Bakri described a Muslim merchants' town separated from the king's town; no inscription securely identifies these ruins, and the royal settlement has not been found. A broad avenue crossed the densely packed stone quarter, with the mosque centrally placed along it. Narrow rooms probably reflect the scarcity of large timber for roofing, a revealing constraint on urban life at the desert's edge.
simp_chinese: 石砌房屋、狭窄街道与一座主麻清真寺，表明昆比萨利赫曾是毛里塔尼亚南部萨赫勒地区一座规模可观的中世纪城镇。其城市繁荣期大致在11至14世纪。这里的废墟常被认作加纳帝国的都城，后者的财富部分来自跨撒哈拉黄金贸易，但这一认定仍有争议。巴克里曾描述一座穆斯林商人城镇与国王居城相互分隔；现存遗址没有可确证身份的铭文，王城也尚未发现。一条宽阔大道穿过密集的石砌街区，清真寺位于大道中部。房间普遍狭窄，很可能是因为缺乏可用作屋顶长梁的大树，生动显示了沙漠边缘城市生活所受的环境约束。

english: Kouré lies in the country east of Niamey, on the route leading toward Dallol Bosso. Its surrounding tiger bush supports West African giraffes, whose presence makes this rural landscape distinctive. Woodland cleared for cultivation reduces their habitat, while the animals themselves can damage crops, bringing the needs of farmers and wildlife into close contact. The better-documented conservation history belongs to the modern era: Niger's giraffe population had fallen to roughly fifty animals by 1984. Later local protection efforts combined assistance with wells, grain stores and farming supplies with attempts to preserve the giraffes and their remaining habitat.
simp_chinese: 库雷位于尼亚美以东的乡野，处在通往达洛尔博索的道路上。周围呈条带状分布的虎纹灌丛为西非长颈鹿提供栖息地，使这片农村景观独具特点。开垦农田减少了它们的生境，长颈鹿本身也可能损坏庄稼，农民生计与野生动物由此紧密交织。有较清楚记载的保护历史属于现代：到1984年，尼日尔的长颈鹿已减少至约五十只。后来当地的保护工作将水井、粮仓与农资援助结合起来，同时努力维持长颈鹿种群及其剩余栖息地。

english: Kouřim lies beside the Výrovka in the agricultural plains east of Prague. The royal town was probably founded under Wenceslaus I in the first half of the thirteenth century and appears in an act of Ottokar II from 1261. Its predecessor, Old Kouřim, occupied a nearby hill fortified in the ninth or tenth century. The town's early Gothic church of Saint Stephen and its long circuit of walls proclaimed the ambitions of medieval royal Bohemia. Prosperity reached a high point around 1500, but the Thirty Years' War devastated the community and reduced its population by roughly three quarters. Its privileges were restored in 1740, though the small town never recovered its former standing among Bohemia's leading centres.
simp_chinese: 考日姆位于布拉格以东的农业平原上，维罗夫卡河从城中流过。这座王室城镇很可能由瓦茨拉夫一世在十三世纪上半叶创建，并见于奥托卡二世1261年的文书。它的前身旧考日姆位于附近一座山丘上，早在九至十世纪便筑有防御设施。早期哥特式的圣斯德望教堂和绵长城墙，体现了中世纪波希米亚王室城镇的雄心。繁荣在1500年前后达到高峰，但三十年战争重创城镇，使人口减少约四分之三。1740年，考日姆恢复了城镇特权，却未能重获往昔在波希米亚主要城市中的地位。

english: Kourou stands where its namesake river reaches the Atlantic on the Guianese coast, between mangroves, forest and low hills. Kalina communities inhabited the district before French settlement, and carved rocks near the town preserve traces of Indigenous art. Jesuit missionaries farmed across the river in the early eighteenth century, but the great colonial expedition of 1763 transformed the small village into a scene of disaster. Roughly ten to twelve thousand settlers arrived; disease killed about six thousand within a year. Survivors sought refuge on the wind-swept islands offshore, helping give them the name Salvation Islands. This failed venture cast a long shadow over French schemes for mass settlement in Guiana.
simp_chinese: 库鲁位于同名河流注入大西洋的河口，红树林、密林与低丘环绕着这段圭亚那海岸。法国人定居以前，卡利纳人已生活在本地区，城镇附近的刻石仍保存着原住民艺术的痕迹。十八世纪初，耶稣会传教士在河对岸开垦土地，但1763年的大规模殖民远征使小村落变成灾难现场。约一万至一万二千名移民抵达后，一年内便有约六千人死于疾病。幸存者逃往海风吹拂的近海岛屿休养，这也促成了‘救赎群岛’之名。这次失败长期影响着法国在圭亚那推行大规模移民的计划。

english:
Kourouninkoto lies in a valley of southwestern Mali, enclosed by Sokaroba to the east, Kouroubonda to the north and Satankourou to the west. The Baoule River runs about twenty kilometres away, while smaller streams appear during the short rainy season. Most of the year's rain falls between late June and mid-September.

Agriculture anchors the settlement and its surrounding country. Millet and rice are among its crops, and the population includes a Malinke majority alongside Bambara, Kakolo, Peulh and Sarakole communities. The valley setting and strongly seasonal water supply give this farming country a distinct rhythm.
simp_chinese:
库鲁宁科托位于马里西南部的一处河谷，东有索卡罗巴山，北有库鲁邦达山，西有萨坦库鲁山。巴乌莱河从约二十公里外流过，短暂的雨季中还会出现较小的溪流。全年大部分降雨集中在6月下旬至9月中旬。

农业维系着聚落与周边地区的生活，黍类与稻米都是当地作物。居民以马林克人为主，也包括班巴拉人、卡科洛人、富尔人和萨拉科莱人等群体。河谷地形与季节分明的水源，为这片农耕地区赋予了鲜明的生活节律。

english: Kouroussa stands near the upstream limit of navigation on the Niger, where a river port could link the Guinea coast with the western Sudan and the Niger valley. It served as a trading centre from at least the age of the Mali Empire and belonged to the southern Mandé heartland. After imperial authority fragmented, the surrounding state, known at different times as Hamana or Koumara, remained a small regional power among stronger neighbours. The town’s riverbank setting also sustained cultivation: René Caillié, passing through in June 1827 on his journey toward Djenné and Timbuktu, described a mud-walled settlement whose fields benefited from the river’s floods. Kouroussa is closely associated with Hamana-Malinke culture. Its musical traditions include layered djembe rhythms accompanied by the deep dununba drum and the long kenken bell, giving this commercial crossroads a distinctive ceremonial voice.
simp_chinese: 库鲁萨位于尼日尔河上游通航范围的末端附近，河港将几内亚沿海与西苏丹及尼日尔河谷联系起来。至少在马里帝国时代，这里就已是贸易中心，属于曼德腹地的南缘。帝国权力分散后，周边曾称哈马纳或库马拉的地方政权仍作为小型地区势力，处于更强邻国之间。河岸环境也支撑着耕作：勒内·卡耶于1827年6月前往杰内和廷巴克图途中经过这里，描述了一座围有泥墙的聚落，其田地得益于河水泛滥。库鲁萨与哈马纳-马林克文化密切相连，当地音乐以层次丰富的金贝鼓节奏著称，并配以低沉的敦敦巴鼓和长形肯肯铃声，为这处商业十字路口赋予独特的仪式声响。

english: Koshi belongs to Higo within the ancient Saikaido circuit. The wider circuit embraced Kyushu’s nine provinces and the islands of Tsushima and Iki. Its administrative geography and principal road shared a name dating to Japan’s Asuka-period organization.
simp_chinese: 合志属于古代西海道之内的肥后。广义西海道包括九州九国以及对马、壹岐二岛。其行政地理区域与主要道路共用一个名称，沿袭自日本飞鸟时代的制度。

english:
Koutiala lies in Minianka country north of Sikasso, in the agricultural interior of southern Mali. Its foundation is associated with members of the Coulibaly family. The surrounding fields sustain a varied harvest of pearl millet, sorghum and maize, setting the town within a landscape shaped by cultivation.

In more recent history, cotton made Koutiala known as the capital of white gold. Cotton processing and oil production helped turn it into a major industrial centre. This later reputation grew alongside the grain farming of the surrounding country, joining a commercial crop with the food harvests on which local communities depended.
simp_chinese:
库蒂亚拉位于锡卡索以北的米尼扬卡人地区，地处马里南部的内陆农业地带。建城传统与库利巴利家族成员有关。周围田地出产珍珠粟、高粱和玉米，使这座城镇置身于长期耕作塑造的景观之中。

在较近的历史中，棉花使库蒂亚拉获得“白色黄金之都”的称号。棉花加工和制油业推动它发展为重要工业中心。这种后来的名声与周边地区的粮食种植并存，将商业作物与当地社群赖以生活的粮食收成联系起来。

english: The Kovda drains a chain of great lakes in northern Karelia and the southern Kola Peninsula. From Lake Topozero it passes through Pyaozero and Kovdozero before reaching the Kandalaksha Gulf of the White Sea.
simp_chinese: 科夫达河排泄卡累利阿北部及科拉半岛南部的一串大湖。河流从托波泽罗湖出发，经过皮亚奥泽罗湖和科夫多泽罗湖，最终注入白海坎达拉克沙湾。

english: Kovel lies on the Turiya in Volhynian Polesia and was first mentioned in 1310. Its name is linked to the Slavic word for blacksmith, a connection recalled by the horseshoe upon its arms. Sigismund I granted the town its charter in 1518, and Bona Sforza became its owner in 1547. The Muscovite exile Andrei Kurbsky later served as its starost, one of the notable figures drawn into this Volhynian town's history. From 1611 the municipal government was headed by an appointed landvogt chosen from the local Catholic and Ruthenian communities. Kovel passed to Russia in the Third Partition of Poland in 1795. Much older traces of the region's inhabitants emerged nearby in 1858, when a spearhead bearing a Gothic runic inscription was found, linking the surrounding countryside to the early third century.
simp_chinese: 科韦利坐落在沃里尼亚波列西耶的图里亚河畔，最早见于1310年的记载。城名与斯拉夫语中表示铁匠的词相联系，市徽上的马蹄铁也呼应着这一含义。齐格蒙特一世于1518年颁予城市特许状，博娜·斯福尔扎则在1547年成为其所有者。来自莫斯科的流亡者安德烈·库尔布斯基后来担任这里的长官，为这座沃里尼亚城镇的历史增添了一位知名人物。自1611年起，市政由从当地天主教与鲁塞尼亚社群成员中任命的地方执政官主持。1795年第三次瓜分波兰时，科韦利转归俄罗斯。1858年，附近发现一枚刻有哥特语卢恩铭文的矛头，让周围乡野更早的居民痕迹重新显现，将当地历史追溯至三世纪初。

english: Kovernino lies in the Nizhny Novgorod region of Russia. The modern work settlement belongs to the district that bears its name.
simp_chinese: 科韦尔尼诺位于俄罗斯下诺夫哥罗德地区。这处现代工人聚落属于沿用其名称的同名行政区。

english: Kovin stands in the western Banat beside the Danube, opposite the ancient site of Margum. The remains of the Roman fortress Contra Margum recall an earlier river frontier. Recorded as Keuee in 1071, the settlement became a county seat within the medieval Kingdom of Hungary. Serbian refugees enlarged its population from the fourteenth century as Ottoman pressure advanced through the Balkans. Lazar Branković briefly controlled the town in 1457 before Hungarian authority returned the following year. Ottoman rule in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries was followed by Habsburg possession in 1716, and in 1751 Kovin entered the Military Frontier, continuing its long association with the defense of the Danube borderlands.
simp_chinese: 科温位于巴纳特西部、多瑙河畔，与古代马尔古姆遗址隔河相望。罗马要塞孔特拉·马尔古姆的遗迹，使人想起更早时代的河流边疆。聚落于1071年以Keuee之名见于记载，后来成为中世纪匈牙利王国的一处郡治。自14世纪起，随着奥斯曼势力向巴尔干推进，塞尔维亚难民迁入并扩大了当地人口。拉扎尔·布兰科维奇曾于1457年短暂控制这里，次年匈牙利恢复统治。16至17世纪的奥斯曼统治结束后，科温于1716年归入哈布斯堡领地，1751年又纳入军事边区，延续了它与多瑙河边境防务的长久联系。

english: Kovran belongs to the wider Kamchatka Peninsula. The peninsula faces the Sea of Okhotsk to the west and the Bering Sea and Pacific waters to the east, with volcanoes forming part of the Pacific Ring of Fire.
simp_chinese: 科夫兰属于更广阔的堪察加半岛地区。半岛西临鄂霍次克海，东接白令海与太平洋水域，其火山构成环太平洋火山带的一部分。

english: Kowal belongs to Kuyavia, the historical country on the left bank of the Vistula in north-central Poland. The wider region’s name appears in the papal Bull of Gniezno issued in 1136.
simp_chinese: 科瓦尔属于波兰中北部维斯瓦河左岸的历史地区库亚维。更广阔地区的名称已见于1136年颁布的格涅兹诺教皇诏书。

english: Koy Aike belongs to the Patagonian country between the southern Andes and the Atlantic. The wider region contains dry steppes and tablelands in the east, with fjords, forests and glaciers toward the Pacific west.
simp_chinese: 科伊艾克属于南安第斯山与大西洋之间的巴塔哥尼亚地区。这片广大地域东部有干燥草原与台地，朝向太平洋的西部则多峡湾、森林及冰川。

english: Koyda belongs to the Kuloy country of the White Sea region. The wider coast’s great trading centre was Arkhangelsk at the Northern Dvina mouth, Russia’s chief seaport before Saint Petersburg rose in the early eighteenth century.
simp_chinese: 科伊达属于白海地区的库洛伊一带。整个沿海区域的重要贸易中心是北德维纳河口的阿尔汉格尔斯克，在十八世纪初圣彼得堡兴起以前，它是俄罗斯的主要海港。

english: Koyeti was one of the speech varieties of Southern Valley Yokuts in California’s Central Valley. It belonged to a wider dialect network that also included Tachi, Chunut, Wowol and Yawelmani. This linguistic diversity reflects the many related communities that shared the valley country.
simp_chinese: 科耶蒂是加利福尼亚中央谷地南谷约库特语的变体之一。它属于包括塔奇、丘努特、沃沃尔及亚韦尔马尼等在内的方言网络。这种语言多样性反映了共享河谷地域的众多相关社群。

english: Koygorodok is a village in the Komi country. It serves as a district centre and counted nearly three thousand inhabitants in 2010.
simp_chinese: 科伊戈罗多克是科米地区的一座村庄。它是当地行政中心，2010年约有3000名居民。

english: Koyoongkawi lies in the Sacramento country, long inhabited by Nisenan, Maidu and other indigenous peoples. In this valley, acorns from abundant oaks formed an important food, supplemented by salmon, deer and gathered plants. Spanish explorers named the Sacramento River in 1808.
simp_chinese: 科永卡维位于萨克拉门托地区，尼塞南、迈杜等原住民长期生活于此。在这片河谷，丰富橡树的橡实是重要食物，另有鲑鱼、鹿和采集植物补充。西班牙探险者在1808年为萨克拉门托河命名。

english: Koyu lies in Hyūga on the eastern side of Kyushu. Hyūga formed one of the nine provinces of the Saikaidō, established within the ancient system of five home provinces and seven circuits.
simp_chinese: 儿汤位于九州东侧的日向国。日向是西海道九国之一，西海道属于古代五畿七道体系。

english: The Koyukon homeland follows the Koyukuk and Yukon rivers in Alaska. These Athabascan-speaking communities supported themselves for thousands of years through hunting and trapping.
simp_chinese: 科尤康人的故土沿阿拉斯加科尤库克河与育空河分布。这些使用阿萨巴斯卡语言的社群数千年来通过狩猎和设陷捕兽维生。

english: Meneelghaadze' T'oh belongs to the Alaskan interior. The wider Alaskan region preserves a long Indigenous history and evidence connected with the settlement of North America by way of the Bering land bridge.
simp_chinese: 科尤库克属于阿拉斯加内陆。更广阔的阿拉斯加地区保存着悠久的原住民历史，以及与经白令陆桥进入北美有关的证据。

english: Koyukuk Forest belongs to the wider Alaskan country of northwestern North America. Alaska faces the Pacific to the south and Arctic seas to the north, while the Bering Strait separates it from northeastern Asia.
simp_chinese: 科尤库克森林属于北美西北部更广阔的阿拉斯加地区。阿拉斯加南临太平洋、北接北冰洋诸海，白令海峡则将它与亚洲东北部分隔。

english: Koyulhisar lies in the highland interior of Anatolia, within the modern province of Sivas. It has also been called Koyluhisar and Koyunlu Hisar. The surrounding district preserves associations with Roman Armenia and the settlement of Colonia, linking its later names to an older imperial landscape.
simp_chinese: 科尤尔希萨尔位于安纳托利亚内陆高地，今属锡瓦斯省。这里也曾称科伊卢希萨尔和科云卢希萨尔。周围地区保留着与罗马时期亚美尼亚及科洛尼亚聚落的联系，将较晚的地名与更古老的帝国地理连接起来。

english: Kozara rises in western Bosnia between the Sava, Vrbas, Sana and Una rivers. Its highest summit is Lisina, and the mountain became a major battlefield during the twentieth-century Yugoslav resistance.
simp_chinese: 科扎拉山位于波斯尼亚西部萨瓦河、弗尔巴斯河、萨纳河与乌纳河之间。最高峰为利西纳，山区在20世纪南斯拉夫抵抗战争中成为重要战场。

english: Kozelets stands on the Oster, a tributary of the Dnieper, within the broad Dnieper Lowland. It was recorded as a fortified town of Kievan Rus in 1098 and later appeared under the name Kozlohrad in the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. By the early seventeenth century it had become an important regional trading centre. Under the Cossack Hetmanate it served as a sotnia town within the Pereiaslav and Kyiv regiments, combining local administration with the military organization of Cossack society. Magdeburg rights followed in 1656, and a Cossack rada here elected Yakym Somko as hetman in 1662. Despite damage during a Tatar invasion in 1679, the town retained its regional role. The eighteenth-century Cathedral of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin, funded by the Rozumovsky brothers and built in the Ukrainian Baroque manner, gave that status a grand architectural expression.
simp_chinese: 科泽列茨位于第聂伯低地，临第聂伯河支流奥斯捷尔河。1098年的记载已将它称为基辅罗斯的一座设防城镇，后来在波兰立陶宛联邦时期又以科兹洛赫拉德之名出现。至17世纪初，它已成为重要的区域贸易中心。在哥萨克酋长国时期，城镇先后隶属佩列亚斯拉夫团与基辅团，作为百人队驻地，将地方行政与哥萨克社会的军事组织结合起来。1656年，它获得马格德堡法权；1662年，此地的哥萨克拉达选举雅基姆·索姆科为盖特曼。1679年的鞑靼入侵虽带来破坏，城镇仍维持区域中心地位。18世纪，由罗祖莫夫斯基兄弟出资、采用乌克兰巴洛克风格修建的圣母诞生主教座堂，为这种地位赋予了宏伟的建筑表达。

english: Koželj is a village in the Knjaževac area of eastern Serbia. It forms part of that municipality's dispersed rural settlements, with fewer than two hundred residents recorded in 2002.
simp_chinese: 科热利是塞尔维亚东部克尼亚热瓦茨地区的一座村落，属于当地分散乡村聚落的一部分。2002年记载居民不足两百人。

english:
Kozelsk stands on the Zhizdra, a tributary of the Oka, and appears in a chronicle of 1146 as part of the principality of Chernigov. Its enduring fame came from resistance to Batu Khan in 1238. The defenders held out for seven weeks before the town fell, earning Kozelsk the grim epithet of the 'evil town' in the story of the Mongol siege.

Later centuries placed this small river town between larger powers. It briefly came under Lithuanian rule in 1446 and was annexed by Moscow in 1494. In 1607 troops of the rebel Ivan Bolotnikov resisted the tsar's army here. Nearby Optina Pustyn provided another kind of influence, becoming renowned in the nineteenth century for its spiritual elders.
simp_chinese:
科泽利斯克坐落在奥卡河支流日兹德拉河畔，1146年的编年史已将其记为切尔尼戈夫公国的一部分。它长久流传的名声来自1238年对拔都军队的抵抗。守军坚持七周后城镇才告陷落，使科泽利斯克在蒙古围城的记述中获得“恶城”这一严酷称号。

此后数百年，这座河边小城处在更大势力之间。1446年，它一度归立陶宛统治，1494年又被莫斯科吞并。1607年，起义者伊万·博洛特尼科夫的部队曾在这里抵抗沙皇军队。附近的奥普京纳修道院带来另一种影响，在十九世纪因其灵修长老而声名远播。

english: Kozhakol is a shallow salt lake of the Nura basin, lying north of Lake Tengiz in the Kazakh steppe. It has no outward drainage, and its waters are notably salty and bitter. The deeply indented shoreline changes strikingly with the water level: floods unite the basin into a compact lake, while drought leaves a cluster of nearly separate pools. Low rocky banks mark the eastern side, contrasting with the flatter shores elsewhere. Around the water lie cultivated fields and cattle pastures, with Zhalmankulak village close to its western bank. Water, salt and seasonal contraction therefore define both the lake and the land used around it.
simp_chinese: 科扎科尔是努拉河流域的一座浅盐湖，位于哈萨克草原上、田吉兹湖北面。湖泊没有向外排水的出口，湖水咸而带苦。曲折的岸线随水位变化显著：涨水时，湖盆连成一片紧凑水面；干旱时，却会分裂成若干近乎彼此隔绝的水池。东岸是低矮的岩岸，其余各岸则较为平坦。周边分布着耕地和放牧牛群的草场，扎尔曼库拉克村靠近西岸。水分、盐分以及季节性的湖面收缩，共同塑造了这座湖及其周围土地的利用方式。

english: Kozhevnikovo stands on the Ob River in western Siberia. The rural settlement serves as a district centre within the Tomsk region.
simp_chinese: 科热夫尼科沃位于西西伯利亚鄂毕河畔。这个乡村聚落是托木斯克地区的区级行政中心。

english: Kozhikode, known overseas as Calicut, rose to prominence as the capital of the Zamorins and a great port of the Malabar Coast. Arab, Persian and Chinese merchants gathered here for the produce of southern India, above all its spices. Ibn Battuta visited repeatedly in the fourteenth century, and the Chinese treasure fleets called during the fifteenth. The port also left its name on calico, the cotton cloth exported through its markets. Vasco da Gama reached Kozhikode in 1498, bringing the Portuguese into a trading world that was already old and prosperous. Their attempts to command the spice trade provoked prolonged naval conflict with the Zamorins and their admirals, the Kunjali Marakkars. In 1604, the Dutch East India Company made an alliance with Kozhikode and obtained trading rights, adding another overseas power to the city's commercial rivalries.
simp_chinese: 科泽科德在海外以卡利卡特之名闻名，曾作为扎莫林统治者的首都与马拉巴尔海岸的大港兴起。阿拉伯、波斯和中国商人在这里汇集，交易南印度物产，尤其是香料。伊本·白图泰在14世纪多次来访，中国宝船船队则在15世纪到港。经由此地出口的棉布，还使卡利卡特之名留在了calico一词之中。1498年，瓦斯科·达·伽马抵达科泽科德，使葡萄牙人进入这个早已繁荣的贸易世界。他们控制香料贸易的企图，引发了与扎莫林及昆贾利·马拉卡尔诸海军统帅之间漫长的海上冲突。1604年，荷兰东印度公司与科泽科德结盟并获得贸易权，令这座城市的商业竞争中又添了一股海外力量。

english: At the meeting of the Kłodnica and Oder rivers, Koźle commanded a useful position in Upper Silesia. The settlement appears in the earliest Polish chronicle, written in the twelfth century, and received town rights in 1281. From that year until 1355 it was the seat of a small Piast duchy, remaining under other branches of the dynasty until 1532. Its name comes from the Polish word for a goat. The town's strategic role continued under later rulers: after Prussia acquired it in 1742, Frederick II developed it into a fortress that resisted repeated Austrian sieges during the Seven Years' War. Medieval residence and eighteenth-century stronghold thus marked successive uses of the same river junction.
simp_chinese: 科兹莱坐落在克沃德尼察河与奥得河交汇处，占据上西里西亚一处有利位置。十二世纪成书的最早波兰编年史已经提到这个聚落，1281年它获得城市权利。从这一年到1355年，科兹莱是一个皮雅斯特小公国的中心，此后仍由该王朝的其他支系统治，直至1532年。城名源自波兰语中的山羊一词。它的战略作用延续到后来的统治时期：普鲁士于1742年取得此地后，腓特烈二世将其建成要塞，在七年战争中抵挡了奥军的多次围攻。中世纪公爵驻地与十八世纪堡垒，呈现出同一河流交汇点在不同时代的用途。

english: Kozlov grew from a small forest monastery founded in 1627. Its settlement became a northern anchor of the Belgorod defensive line in 1635, with an earthen wall blocking the Nogai raiding route across the open steppe.
simp_chinese: 科兹洛夫由1627年建立的一座小型林中修道院发展而来。1635年聚落成为别尔哥罗德防线的北端支点，一道土墙横过开阔草原，阻挡诺盖人的劫掠通道。

english: Kozlov belongs to the country of Smolensk in western Russia. The wider regional centre stood on the Dnieper along the route from the Varangians to the Greeks and became the capital of a medieval principality.
simp_chinese: 科兹洛夫属于俄罗斯西部的斯摩棱斯克地区。更广阔地区的中心斯摩棱斯克位于第聂伯河畔，处在从瓦良格人通往希腊人的商路上，后来成为中世纪公国的首都。

english: Kozluk is a town in Turkey’s Batman region, also known as Hezzo or Hazzo. It serves as a district centre and had about twenty-eight thousand residents in the 2021 census.
simp_chinese: 科兹卢克是土耳其巴特曼地区的城镇，又称赫佐或哈佐。它是县级行政中心，2021年人口统计约有二万八千居民。

english: Kozmin belongs to the Greater Polish country around Pyzdry. The regional centre was recorded in 1232 and became a meeting place for nobles and bishops who supported Ladislaus the Short’s bid for the Polish crown in 1318.
simp_chinese: 科兹明属于佩兹德雷周边的大波兰地区。地区中心见于1232年的记载，1318年贵族和主教曾在此集会，支持瓦迪斯瓦夫一世争取波兰王冠。

english: Kozmodemyansk is a town in the Mari El Republic. Its name is also borne by rural settlements in the Perm and Yaroslavl regions.
simp_chinese: 科济莫杰米扬斯克是马里埃尔共和国的一座城镇。彼尔姆与雅罗斯拉夫尔地区的一些乡村聚落，也使用这一名称。

english: Kożuchów, also known as Freystadt, developed in twelfth-century Poland and received town rights in 1273. It belonged to the Duchy of Głogów, where Piast and later Jagiellonian rulers left their mark on its castle. Fieldstone walls raised around the turn of the fourteenth century enclosed the medieval town; portions reached eight metres in height and two metres in thickness. In 1632, during the Thirty Years War, Andreas Gryphius witnessed the town's pillage and burning by Swedish troops and recorded the destruction in Fewrige Freystadt. The wars of the eighteenth century subsequently brought it under Prussian rule.
simp_chinese: 科茹胡夫又名弗赖施塔特，兴起于十二世纪的波兰，并于1273年取得城市权。它属于格沃古夫公国，皮亚斯特和后来的雅盖隆统治者在当地城堡留下印记。约十四世纪之交修筑的毛石城墙围住中世纪城镇，部分墙段高达八米、厚达两米。1632年三十年战争期间，安德烈亚斯·格里菲乌斯亲眼目睹瑞典军队劫掠焚烧城镇，并在《烈火中的弗赖施塔特》中记下这场灾难。十八世纪的战争又使此地转归普鲁士统治。

english: Kozyrevsk's modern transport links included a small paved airfield about three kilometres northeast of the settlement. The airport closed in 1995 as traffic declined and maintenance became more costly. Its abandoned runway was gradually invaded by vegetation in the following decades.
simp_chinese: 科济列夫斯克的现代交通设施曾包括聚落东北约三千米处的一座小型铺装机场。随着客流下降、维护费用上升，机场于1995年关闭。随后数十年，废弃跑道逐渐被植被侵入。

english: Kpalimé lies in the upland country of what is now Togo, near Mount Kloto. Its earlier name, Agomé-Kpalimé, linked it to the Agomé communities whose migration traditions recount a flight from Notsé and a settlement on the mountain before their division among several villages. The name Mokpalipé, from which Kpalimé developed, meant crossroads. Here the Agomé encountered Hausa caravan traders traveling from Salaga toward Keta, bringing the inland settlement into wider commercial networks. Its transformation into a larger administrative and trading town came much later, under German colonial rule at the end of the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 帕利梅坐落在今多哥的高地，靠近克洛托山。它早先称阿戈梅—帕利梅，名称与阿戈梅诸社群相连；这些社群的迁徙传统讲述了他们逃离诺策、先在山上定居，随后分散到数个村庄的经历。帕利梅的名称由Mokpalipé演变而来，意为“十字路口”。阿戈梅人在此接触到从萨拉加前往凯塔的豪萨商队，将这处内陆聚落联入更广泛的商业网络。它发展成较大的行政与贸易城镇，则要等到19世纪末德国殖民统治时期。

english: The waters by Kra Buri are associated with the long estuary of the Kraburi River, beside the Tenasserim coast. Inland, the country is confined between the river and the Tenasserim Range. The old settlement of Mueang Tra was established under the kingdom of Ayutthaya as a frontier town subordinate to Chumphon, with its original centre at Pak Chan. Burmese attacks reached it in 1764 and again in 1786, illustrating the contested borderland behind these waters. The town's centre was moved to Nam Chuet only in 1884 for commercial and strategic reasons. River, narrow coastal country and mountain barrier together give this stretch of the coast its geographical character.
simp_chinese: 克拉武里附近的水域与克拉武里河狭长的河口相接，沿着德林达依海岸展开。内陆地区夹在河流与德林达依山脉之间。旧聚落孟达在阿瑜陀耶王国时期建立，作为隶属春蓬的边镇，最初中心位于巴占。缅军曾于1764年和1786年两次来袭，体现了水域背后边境地区的争夺。直到1884年，城镇中心才因商业与战略考量迁至南朱。河流、狭窄的沿海地带与山地屏障，共同构成这段海岸的地理特色。

english: The Kra Jungle occupies the narrow northern neck of the Malay Peninsula. The mountain system running from the Tenasserim Hills into the peninsula passes through the Kra Isthmus, binding this forested country to the long backbone of mainland Southeast Asia.
simp_chinese: 克拉丛林占据马来半岛北部狭窄的颈部。从德林达依山脉延入半岛的山系穿过克拉地峡，使这片林地与东南亚大陆绵长的山地骨架相连。

english:
At the mouth of the Krabi River, the western Malay Peninsula opens towards Phang Nga Bay and the Andaman Sea. Monsoon rains drench this coast for much of the year, while limestone cliffs and offshore islands give its shores a sharply broken outline.

The settlement's later growth was linked to elephants. In the early Rattanakosin era, the governor of Nakhon Si Thammarat ordered an elephant kraal established here to supply his larger town. Followers of the official sent to oversee the work formed communities at Pakasai, Khlong Pon and Pak Lao. Krabi's formal elevation to town status came in 1872, followed in 1875 by direct administrative ties to Bangkok. These nineteenth-century changes belong to the later history of an older peninsular landscape.
simp_chinese:
甲米河在马来半岛西岸注入攀牙湾，外接安达曼海。季风带来的雨水在一年中大部分时日浸润着这段海岸，石灰岩峭壁与近海岛屿又勾勒出曲折的岸线。

聚落后来的发展与大象有关。拉达那哥欣时代初期，洛坤总督下令在此设立象栏，为其治所稳定供应大象。受命管理此事的官员带来许多追随者，逐渐形成巴加赛、空蓬与巴老三个社区。甲米于1872年正式升格为城镇，1875年又改为直接向曼谷中央政府负责。这些19世纪的行政变化，是这片古老半岛景观较晚的一层历史。

english: Kra Buri occupies the narrow country between the Tenasserim Range and the Kraburi River on the western side of the Malay Peninsula.
