english: These waters lie around the broader Kūki Airani, or Cook Islands, a scattered group of fifteen islands in the South Pacific. Polynesian voyagers are thought to have settled the islands around the year 1000, arriving from the direction of Tahiti.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于更广阔的库克群岛周边，群岛由南太平洋十五座分散岛屿组成。波利尼西亚航海者被认为约在公元1000年从塔希提方向前来定居。

english: These South Pacific waters belong to the wider oceanic setting of the Cook Islands. The Polynesian group consists of fifteen islands spread across a much larger maritime expanse, with Rarotonga and its settlement of Avarua forming its principal centre.
simp_chinese: 这片南太平洋水域属于库克群岛更广阔的海洋环境。这组波利尼西亚群岛由十五个岛屿组成，散布于辽阔海域，拉罗汤加岛及其阿瓦鲁阿聚落构成主要中心。

english: The Kuki Airani High Sea lies within Polynesia’s immense central and southern Pacific world. More than a thousand islands are scattered across this oceanic region. Their peoples share related languages and many cultural traditions, linking small landfalls across distances far greater than their combined land area.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛远海处在波利尼西亚广阔的中南太平洋世界。这个海洋地区散布着一千多座岛屿。各岛居民拥有相近语言和许多共同文化传统，将面积有限的陆地跨越远大于其总面积的海洋距离联系起来。

english: The Kuki Airani High Sea forms part of the ocean surrounding the Cook Islands. This wider archipelago comprises fifteen islands scattered across a vast sea, with Rarotonga the largest; Polynesian mariners connected such distant islands by reading waves and swells.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛远海属于群岛周边的大洋。更广阔的群岛由散布于辽阔海域的十五座岛屿组成，以拉罗汤加最大；波利尼西亚航海者通过辨识波浪与涌浪联系这些遥远岛屿。

english: These Cook Islands waters form part of the wider Polynesian Pacific. Polynesia’s many islands occupy an enormous maritime space, conventionally pictured as a triangle stretching northward to Hawaii.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛这片海域是广阔波利尼西亚太平洋的一部分。波利尼西亚众多岛屿分布于辽阔海洋，通常被描绘为向北延伸至夏威夷的三角区域。

english: The Kuki Airani High Sea lies within the broad Polynesian maritime world. Polynesia contains little land across an immense expanse of the central and southern Pacific, with shared linguistic and cultural connections among its island peoples.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛远海位于广阔的波利尼西亚海洋世界。波利尼西亚在中太平洋和南太平洋的辽阔海面上只有少量陆地，各岛居民之间具有共同的语言与文化联系。

english: These waters belong to the wider Polynesian world of the central and southern Pacific. Polynesia encompasses more than a thousand islands whose Indigenous inhabitants share related languages and many cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于太平洋中部与南部的波利尼西亚地域。波利尼西亚包含一千多座岛屿，其原住民使用相关语言，并共享许多文化传统。

english: These waters belong to the southern Polynesian oceanic world. Across this wider region, more than a thousand islands are scattered through the central and southern Pacific, joined by related languages and cultural traditions.
simp_chinese: 这片海域属于波利尼西亚南部海洋世界。在更广阔的区域，千余岛屿散布于太平洋中南部，由相关语言及文化传统相连。

english: These waters open around the Cook Islands in the South Pacific. The wider archipelago consists of fifteen widely scattered islands, settled by Polynesian voyagers around the first millennium’s end, with Rarotonga later becoming the principal center.
simp_chinese: 这片水域位于南太平洋库克群岛周边。整个群岛由十五座分散岛屿组成，波利尼西亚航海者约在第一千纪末前来定居，拉罗汤加后来成为主要中心。

english: The Kuki Airani High Sea belongs to the Cook Islands world of the South Pacific. The wider archipelago consists of fifteen scattered islands, first settled by Polynesian voyagers around the beginning of the second millennium.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛远海属于南太平洋的库克群岛世界。整个群岛包括十五座散布岛屿，约在第二个千年之初由波利尼西亚航海者定居。

english: These Kuki Airani waters belong to the broad Polynesian expanse of the South Pacific. The wider region contains more than a thousand islands scattered across an immense ocean, with many volcanic islands formed above hotspots.
simp_chinese: 这片库克群岛水域属于南太平洋广阔的波利尼西亚海域。更广阔的区域有一千多座岛屿散布于浩瀚大洋，其中许多火山岛形成于热点之上。

english: These Cook Islands waters belong to the wider Polynesian Pacific. Across this immense maritime region, more than a thousand islands are linked by related languages, cultural practices and traditional beliefs.
simp_chinese: 这片库克群岛水域属于更广阔的波利尼西亚太平洋。在这片广大的海洋地区，一千多个岛屿由相关的语言、文化习俗与传统信仰联系起来。

english: These Kuki Airani high seas belong to the Polynesian Pacific. The region combines very small land areas with enormous stretches of ocean. Its island communities preserve related languages, customary practices and traditional beliefs.
simp_chinese: 这片库基艾拉尼远海属于波利尼西亚太平洋。地区由狭小陆地与辽阔海洋组合而成。岛屿社群保存相关语言、习俗及传统信仰。

english: These open waters form part of the Polynesian Pacific around the Cook Islands. The wider region contains over a thousand islands but comparatively little land, scattered across an enormous ocean. Volcanic island chains and shared linguistic traditions distinguish many of its far-separated communities.
simp_chinese: 这片外海属于库克群岛周围的波利尼西亚太平洋。更广阔的地区有一千多座岛屿，陆地却相对稀少，分散在浩瀚海洋之中。火山岛链与共同的语言传统，是许多相隔遥远社群的特色。

english: These waters belong to the broader Line Islands setting of the central Pacific. The island chain stretches about 2,350 kilometres from northwest to southeast and includes atolls, coral islands and reefs south of Hawaii.
simp_chinese: 这片海域属于太平洋中部更广阔的莱恩群岛环境。岛链从西北向东南延伸约2350公里，包含夏威夷以南的环礁、珊瑚岛与礁石。

english: These South Pacific waters surround the wider Cook Islands region of Polynesia. Polynesian voyagers settled the islands around the beginning of the second millennium, probably arriving from Tahiti.
simp_chinese: 这片南太平洋水域位于波利尼西亚库克群岛的广大周边海域。波利尼西亚航海者大约在第二个千年开始时定居这些岛屿，可能来自塔希提。

english: These waters belong to the broad Cook Islands region of the South Pacific. The wider archipelago was settled around the eleventh century by Polynesian voyagers thought to have come from Tahiti.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于南太平洋广阔的库克群岛区域。更广阔的群岛约于十一世纪由波利尼西亚航海者定居，他们被认为来自塔希提。

english: These waters belong to the wider central Pacific island world around Aono Raina. The Line Islands form a long chain of atolls and coral islands south of Hawaii, stretching from northwest to southeast.
simp_chinese: 这片水域属于阿奥诺赖纳周边广义的中太平洋岛屿世界。莱恩群岛在夏威夷以南形成漫长的环礁与珊瑚岛链，由西北向东南延伸。

english: These ocean waters bear the name Kūki Airani, the Cook Islands. Across the wider archipelago, fifteen islands punctuate an immense South Pacific expanse. Polynesian settlers are thought to have arrived around the eleventh century from Tahiti, northeast of Rarotonga.
simp_chinese: 这片洋面以库基艾拉尼，即库克群岛得名。更广阔的群岛共有十五座岛屿，散布在浩瀚的南太平洋。据认为，波利尼西亚移民约于十一世纪从拉罗汤加东北方的塔希提来到这里。

english: The Cook Islands seas were crossed by Polynesian voyagers who settled the archipelago around AD 1000, probably from Tahiti. The islands’ small land area is scattered across a vast expanse of South Pacific ocean.
simp_chinese: 波利尼西亚航海者约于公元1000年前后穿越库克群岛海域，在群岛定居，其出发地很可能是塔希提。面积不大的岛屿散布于南太平洋的广大海面。

english: The seas around Kuki Airani connect scattered Polynesian islands across the South Pacific. European records began in 1595 when Álvaro de Mendaña sighted Pukapuka, though Polynesian communities had settled the wider group centuries before.
simp_chinese: 库克群岛周边海域将南太平洋散布的波利尼西亚岛屿相连。1595年阿尔瓦罗·德·门达尼亚望见普卡普卡，开始欧洲记录，但波利尼西亚社群早数世纪便已定居更广阔的群岛。

english: Kukiya was an early royal centre in the Songhay country. By no later than the early tenth century, a ruler based there had moved to Gao Ancien on the Niger, marking a shift toward the later commercial and political centre of Gao.
simp_chinese: 库基亚是桑海地区早期的王权中心。至迟在十世纪初，一位原驻于此的统治者已迁往尼日尔河畔的古加奥，标志着重心向后来加奥的商业和政治中心转移。

english: Kukra belongs to the wider Mayangna world of the Mosquito Coast. The Mayangna inhabited much of eastern Nicaragua and Honduras, with communities preserving their languages in riverine settlements.
simp_chinese: 库克拉属于蚊子海岸更广阔的马扬纳世界。马扬纳人曾居住在尼加拉瓜与洪都拉斯东部广大地域，河流沿岸聚落中的社群保存着自身语言。

english: Kuku belongs to Kabylia, the Kabyle homeland in northern Algeria. The wider mountainous region forms part of the Tell Atlas beside the Mediterranean, with a name derived from the Arabic word for tribes.
simp_chinese: 库库属于阿尔及利亚北部卡比尔人的故土卡比利亚。更广阔的山区是地中海畔泰勒阿特拉斯山的一部分，地区名称源自阿拉伯语中表示部落的词。

english: This country belongs to the Kuku Yalanji people of Far North Queensland. Their traditional lands include rainforest areas and river headwaters around the Palmer and upper Mitchell rivers.
simp_chinese: 这片土地属于昆士兰远北部的库库雅兰吉人。其传统领地包括帕尔默河与米切尔河上游周边的雨林地区和源头地带。

english: Kukuro Kalapalo belongs to the upper Xingu cultural world of central Brazil. The Kuikuro, speakers of a Cariban language, are linked to the builders of Kuhikugu, where large Indigenous villages developed roads, palisades, bridges and formal gateways by around 1400.
simp_chinese: 库库罗卡拉帕洛属于巴西中部欣古河上游的文化地区。使用加勒比语族语言的库伊库罗人与库希库古建造者有关，约1400年时当地大型原住民村落已拥有道路、栅栏、桥梁与正式入口。

english: Kuku-ta lies in the eastern Colombian cordillera near the Venezuelan border. Its modern successor Cúcuta became an important commercial center linking the two countries.
simp_chinese: 库库塔位于哥伦比亚东科迪勒拉山地，靠近委内瑞拉边界。其现代城市库库塔成为连接两国的重要商业中心。

english: Kula belongs to the Saruhan country of western Anatolia. In the wider region, Sarukhan Bey took Thyatira in 1313 and established an independent dynasty centred on Magnesia, leaving his name to the surrounding territory.
simp_chinese: 库拉属于安纳托利亚西部的萨鲁汗地区。在更广阔的区域内，萨鲁汗贝伊于1313年攻取推雅推喇，建立以马格尼西亚为中心的独立王朝，并将其名留给周边地区。

english: Kulada belongs to the wider Odisha region on eastern India’s Bay of Bengal coast. Historically known as Utkala, this country also encompasses much of ancient Kalinga, conquered by Ashoka in the third century BCE.
simp_chinese: 库拉达属于印度东部孟加拉湾沿岸更广阔的奥里萨地区。这片也称乌特卡拉的土地涵盖了古代羯陵伽的大部分区域，后者于公元前三世纪被阿育王征服。

english: The Kulagin region lies around modern Inderbor in southwestern Kazakhstan. The town stands northwest of Inder Lake in a cold semi-arid environment, within the wider Atyrau region.
simp_chinese: 库拉金地区位于哈萨克斯坦西南部今因德尔博尔一带。城镇在因德尔湖西北，处于寒冷半干旱环境，属于广义阿特劳地区。

english: Kulan lies in Kazakhstan’s Jambyl region as the centre of Turar Ryskulov district. Its railway station stands on the route linking Taraz, Bishkek and Shu.
simp_chinese: 库兰位于哈萨克斯坦江布尔地区，是图拉尔雷斯库洛夫区的中心。铁路站位于连接塔拉兹、比什凯克与楚的线路上。

english: Kulanapan belongs to the northern Californian homeland of the Pomo peoples, whose ancestral country encompassed the Russian River valley and the Clear Lake basin. The wider Pomo-speaking region extended from the Pacific coast toward the Wintuan country of the Sacramento Valley. Its languages formed a family of seven distinct tongues rather than a single uniform speech. Northeastern Pomo communities were separated from the other Pomo-speaking groups by an intervening Wintuan-speaking area. The name Kulanapan itself was later proposed for this language family by John Wesley Powell in 1891.
simp_chinese: 库拉纳潘属于加利福尼亚北部波莫诸族的故土，他们的祖居地包括俄罗斯河谷与清湖盆地。广义的波莫语地区从太平洋沿岸向东延伸，接近萨克拉门托谷的温图诸族地域。这里的语言构成一个包含七种独立语言的语系，并非单一且一致的语言。东北波莫社群与其他波莫语群体之间，还隔着一片使用温图诸语言的地区。库拉纳潘这一名称后来由约翰·韦斯利·鲍威尔于1891年提出，用来称呼整个语系。

english: The Kulanotpes winds northwest from the Aigyrzhal range of the Kazakh Uplands to Lake Tengiz, forming one of the lake's principal tributaries. Its lower course meanders beside the western end of Lake Korgalzhyn before turning towards Tengiz's southern shores. Snowmelt and rain govern this river: in spring its water is fresh and drinkable, but summer drought can leave much of the bed dry apart from scattered pools. Villages line parts of its banks, while reeds shelter waterbirds and the remaining waters support pike, perch and carp. The changing availability of water gives this river corridor a strongly seasonal character.
simp_chinese: 库拉诺特佩斯河从哈萨克丘陵的艾格尔扎尔山岭蜿蜒向西北，流入田吉兹湖，是该湖的主要支流之一。下游沿库尔加利任湖西端曲折前进，随后转向田吉兹湖南岸。融雪与降雨支配着河流：春季河水清淡可饮，夏季干旱时，大段河床却可能只剩零散水潭。部分河岸沿线分布村落，芦苇为水鸟提供隐蔽，余下的水域养育着狗鱼、河鲈与鲤鱼。水源丰枯的变化，使这条河谷通道带有鲜明的季节节律。

english: Kulaar belongs to the Kular Range country of northern Yakutia. The wider range arches northeast for about 380 kilometres, between the Omoloy valley and the Yana country. Broad river basins cut its middle, and ice-rich yedoma deposits occur within the region.
simp_chinese: 库拉尔属于雅库特北部的库拉尔山脉地区。更广阔的山岭在奥莫洛伊河谷与亚纳河地区之间向东北弧形延伸约三百八十公里。宽阔河盆切入山地中部，区域内分布着富冰的耶多玛冻土沉积。

english: Kulawi belongs to the inland historical world of Central Sulawesi. Before Dutch administration began in 1904, Kulawi was one of eight small kingdoms in a region that also included Palu, Sigi Dolo and Banawa.
simp_chinese: 库拉维属于中苏拉威西内陆的历史区域。在一九〇四年荷兰实施行政统治之前，库拉维是当地八个小王国之一，其他王国包括帕卢、锡吉多洛和巴纳瓦。

english:
Kuldīga, known in German as Goldingen, grew where the Venta waterway met land routes between Prussia and the lower Daugava. An older Curonian settlement stood downstream, while the Livonian Order received permission to build its castle by the Venta ford in 1242. Dolomite from the riverbed supplied building stone. The town joined the Hanseatic League in 1368, and from 1439 enjoyed a privilege to hold a weekly market. After the Duchy of Courland and Semigallia was established in 1561, Gotthard Kettler made the former order castle one of his residences.

Bridge tolls on goods travelling towards Riga and Jelgava brought income, making the bridge’s destruction by a flood in 1615 a serious blow. A great fire struck the same year, and rebuilding shifted the civic centre towards a new market square. The Venta’s broad natural rapid gave Kuldīga another distinction: salmon leaping over its ledge inspired its reputation as a place where fish could be caught in the air.
simp_chinese:
库尔迪加的德文名为戈尔丁根，兴起于文塔河水路与连接普鲁士、道加瓦河下游的陆路交会之处。更早的库尔人聚落位于下游；1242年，利沃尼亚骑士团获准在文塔河渡口附近筑堡，河床中的白云岩为建筑提供了石料。城镇于1368年加入汉萨同盟，并从1439年起享有每周设集的特权。1561年库尔兰和瑟米加利亚公国建立后，戈特哈德·凯特勒将旧骑士团城堡用作一处居所。

运往里加与叶尔加瓦的货物须缴纳过桥税，为城镇带来收入，因此1615年洪水毁桥造成了沉重打击。同年又发生大火，重建时，市政中心移向新集市广场。文塔河宽阔的天然急流还赋予库尔迪加另一种声名：鲑鱼跃过石坎的景象，使这里以能够“在空中捕鱼”而闻名。

english: Kulembe, also called Kulembebe, belongs to the early political traditions of the Angolan highlands. Portuguese accounts and Mbundu genealogies remember a powerful ruler or succession of rulers bearing the name, although the kingdom's extent and capital remain uncertain. One reconstruction places its centre near the headwaters of the Longa, Kuvo and Ngango rivers; another links it with the stone-building country around Feti la Choya farther south. Its origins may reach back to the thirteenth century. Kulembe has been proposed as a predecessor of the Ovimbundu kingdoms and a source of political titles inherited by neighbouring states. The Libolo ruler's title, Hango dya Kulembe, preserved a claimed relationship to this older authority. Imbangala expansion in the late sixteenth century may have contributed to the kingdom's disappearance.
simp_chinese: 库伦贝又称库伦贝贝，属于安哥拉高地早期政治传统的一部分。葡萄牙人的记载和姆本杜人的谱系保留了关于一位强大君主或一系列同名君主的记忆，但王国的范围与都城位置仍不确定。一种重建将其中心放在隆加、库沃和恩甘戈诸河源头附近，另一种解释则将它与更南方费蒂拉绍亚周围的石建筑地区相联系。它的起源可能早至十三世纪。研究者提出，库伦贝或为奥温本杜诸王国的前身，也可能向邻近国家传下了部分政治称号。利博洛统治者的称号“汉戈·迪亚·库伦贝”，便保存着对这一古老权威的亲缘追认。十六世纪末伊姆班加拉人的扩张，可能促成了王国的消失。

english: Kulfo belongs to the southern Hausaland setting on the Sahelian fringe. Across the wider region, semi-arid steppe and acacia savanna form a transition toward the wetter savannas farther south.
simp_chinese: 库尔福属于萨赫勒边缘的豪萨南部地域。广大地区的半干旱草原与金合欢稀树草原，向更南方较湿润草原过渡。

english: Kulkul Island belongs to the wider Melanesian island world. This southwestern Pacific region extends from New Guinea towards Fiji, including the Solomon Islands, Vanuatu and New Caledonia.
simp_chinese: 库尔库尔岛属于更广阔的美拉尼西亚群岛世界。这片西南太平洋地区从新几内亚延伸至斐济，包括所罗门群岛、瓦努阿图与新喀里多尼亚。

english:
Kulmbach grew near the meeting of the White Main and Red Main, whose waters form the Main just south of the town. The Plassenburg rose above this crossing country in the twelfth century, and Kulmbach received town rights around 1231. In 1340 the Hohenzollern burgraves of Nuremberg inherited both town and castle, making them a centre of their Franconian possessions.

Roads toward Bamberg, Nuremberg, Eger, Hof and Leipzig brought trade, supporting guilds of weavers, dyers and silk embroiderers. That prosperity was repeatedly broken by war: the Hussites sacked Kulmbach in 1430, and the Second Margrave War brought its destruction in 1553. Rebuilt from 1557, the town retained its imposing castle even after the princely residence moved to Bayreuth. Its Mönchshof also preserved a brewing tradition extending back more than six centuries.
simp_chinese:
库尔姆巴赫兴起于白美因河与红美因河相会的地区，两河在城南汇合，成为美因河。12世纪，普拉森堡在这片渡河地带上方建起；库尔姆巴赫约于1231年获得城市权。1340年，霍亨索伦家族的纽伦堡城伯继承了城镇与城堡，使这里成为其弗兰肯领地的中心。

通往班贝格、纽伦堡、埃格尔、霍夫与莱比锡的道路带来贸易，支撑着织工、染工和丝绣工的行会。战争屡次打断这种繁荣：胡斯派于1430年洗劫城市，第二次边疆伯爵战争又在1553年将它摧毁。城镇自1557年起重建，即使宫廷后来迁往拜罗伊特，雄伟的城堡仍然矗立。当地的僧院庭院也保存着延续六个多世纪的酿酒传统。

english: Kulob lies on the Yakhsu in southern Tajikistan, within the historical country of Khatlon. A Greek inscription from the region, dated to about 200–195 BCE, records the dedication of an altar to Hestia for the welfare of the Bactrian kings Euthydemus and Demetrius. Much later, the Sufi teacher Mir Sayyid Ali Hamadani was buried here after his death in 1384, leaving a tomb that became a lasting landmark. Mongol conquest and Timurid rule preceded the city's incorporation into the Khanate of Bukhara in 1559. In the following centuries its rulers generally looked to Bukhara in their dealings with Kokand and Afghanistan, placing this river town within the shifting politics of Central Asia.
simp_chinese: 库洛布坐落在塔吉克斯坦南部的亚赫苏河畔，属于历史上的哈特隆地区。当地一方约公元前200至195年的希腊文铭文，记述有人向赫斯提亚奉献祭坛，为巴克特里亚国王欧西德莫斯和德米特里祈求安康。很久以后，苏菲派导师米尔·赛义德·阿里·哈马丹尼于1384年去世后葬于此地，其陵墓成为长久留存的地标。蒙古征服与帖木儿王朝统治之后，这座城市于1559年并入布哈拉汗国。其后数百年间，当地统治者在与浩罕和阿富汗周旋时通常依附布哈拉，使这座河畔城镇置身于中亚不断变化的政治关系之中。

english: Kulotino lies in the Novgorod country. The settlement belongs to Okulovsky District, distinguishing it from other villages with the same name.
simp_chinese: 库洛季诺位于诺夫哥罗德地区。它属于奥库洛夫卡区，与其他同名村庄相区别。

english: The Kuloy River runs through this part of the country near Velsk. The modern settlement bearing its name belongs to a much later age: its railway station opened in August 1942 during construction of the North Pechora Railway. Political prisoners built the line under severe conditions, and several labour camps stood at Kuloy. Even writing home required improvised materials, with newspaper scraps used as paper and coal residue mixed with kerosene as ink. Kuloy received urban-settlement status in 1945 and grew further after the war. This railway town’s origin must therefore be distinguished from the older river country represented by its name.
simp_chinese: 库洛伊河流经韦利斯克附近的这片土地。以河流命名的现代聚落属于远晚得多的时代：1942年8月，北伯朝拉铁路施工期间，库洛伊车站开通。政治犯在严酷条件下修筑铁路，当地设有数处劳改营。寄信回家也需要临时凑合材料，人们以报纸碎片作信纸，用煤渣混合煤油制成墨水。库洛伊于1945年取得城市型聚落地位，并在战后继续扩展。因此，这座铁路城镇的起源，应与其名称所代表的更早河流地区分别理解。

english: Kulp belongs to the upper Mesopotamian borderlands associated with Hasankeyf. The wider Tigris country contained Roman fortresses that guarded approaches through Tur Abdin as the frontier with Sasanian Persia shifted.
simp_chinese: 库尔普属于与哈桑凯夫相联系的上美索不达米亚边地。在广阔的底格里斯河地区，罗马堡垒守护经图尔阿卜丁的通路，边境则随与萨珊波斯的争夺变化。

english: Kulpi lies in the low country of the Ganges Delta, close to the Hooghly's eastern bank in southern Bengal. The Kulpi–Diamond Harbour Plain rises only about five or six metres above the sea, giving this rural landscape its notably low and level character. Excavations at nearby Deulpota and Harinarayanpur have revealed human occupation more than two thousand years old, showing that settlement along this reach of the river long predates the modern village. In the eighteenth century the area was troubled by Portuguese pirates, prompting the Nawab of Bengal to station troops here. That episode places Kulpi within the contested river approaches of Bengal, where the movement of vessels could bring commerce and armed raiders to the same countryside.
simp_chinese: 库尔皮位于孟加拉南部恒河三角洲的低地，靠近胡格利河东岸。库尔皮—钻石港平原仅高出海面约五至六米，使这片乡村呈现低平的地貌。附近德乌尔波塔与哈里纳拉扬普尔的发掘，发现了两千多年前人类居住的证据，表明这一段河岸的聚落远早于今天的村庄。18世纪，这片地区受到葡萄牙海盗侵扰，孟加拉纳瓦卜因而派兵驻防。这段经历体现了孟加拉河口通道的争夺：往来船只既能带来贸易，也能把武装劫掠者送到同一片乡土。

english: Kulu belongs to the Indigirka river country between the Yana and Kolyma in eastern Siberia. Russian explorers reached this system during the seventeenth century by river and mountain crossings; Zashiversk became an important early colonial outpost before its later abandonment.
simp_chinese: 库卢属于东西伯利亚雅纳河与科雷马河之间的因迪吉尔卡河地区。十七世纪，俄罗斯探险者沿河流并翻越山地抵达这一水系；扎希韦尔斯克成为早期殖民的重要据点，后来废弃。

english: Kulu belongs to central Anatolia’s plateau country. In the wider region, Aksaray served for centuries as an important stop on the Silk Road crossing Anatolia.
simp_chinese: 库卢属于安纳托利亚中部高原地区。在更广阔的区域，阿克萨赖数百年来一直是横穿安纳托利亚丝路上的重要驿站。

english: Kulun lies in northern Taiwan, the island between the East and South China Seas. Across the wider island, mountain ranges occupy the eastern two-thirds while plains spread over the western third; rising seas separated Taiwan from the Asian mainland about 10,000 years ago.
simp_chinese: 龟仑位于台湾北部，这座岛屿处于东海与南海之间。放眼全岛，东部约三分之二为山地，西部约三分之一为平原；约一万年前，海面上升使台湾与亚洲大陆分离。

english: Kulun Olbut belongs to the Indigirka river country between the Yana and Kolyma in eastern Siberia. The wider river runs for about 1,726 kilometres; Russian explorers reached its basin in the 1630s and established outposts along this remote waterway.
simp_chinese: 库伦厄尔布特属于东西伯利亚雅纳河与科雷马河之间的因迪吉尔卡河地域。这条大河全长约1726公里，俄罗斯探险者在1630年代抵达其流域，并沿这条偏远水道建立据点。

english: Lake Kulunda fills a shallow basin in the southern West Siberian Plain, on the eastern side of the Kulunda steppe. The Kulunda and Suetka rivers enter it, but its waters have no outlet to the sea; evaporation leaves salt minerals along the exposed margins. It is the largest lake in the Altai region, yet reaches only about four metres at its deepest. A channel connects it with Lake Kuchuk to the south. The saline water supports brine shrimp, while neighbouring lakes display striking differences in colour and chemistry. Across this open country, the contrast between river mouths, salt-fringed shores and dry steppe makes water the defining feature of the landscape.
simp_chinese: 库伦达湖占据西西伯利亚平原南部的一处浅盆地，位于库伦达草原东侧。库伦达河与苏耶特卡河注入湖中，湖水却没有通向海洋的出口；蒸发使盐类矿物留在裸露的湖缘。它是阿尔泰地区最大的湖泊，最深处却也只有约四米。一条水道将它与南面的库丘克湖连接起来。咸水中生活着卤虫，相邻湖泊的颜色与水化学性质则呈现出鲜明差异。在这片开阔土地上，河口、盐渍湖岸与干燥草原形成对照，水成为决定景观的要素。

english:
Kulykol takes its name from the Kazakh words for swan and lake. The water lies in the upper Tobol basin, on the river's right-bank side, and stretches along an elongated hollow from north-northeast to south-southwest. Heavy snowfall can enlarge the lake considerably in wet years, while reed beds occupy portions of its shore.

Together with nearby Taldykol, Kulykol provides nesting, migration and moulting grounds for wetland birds, including the Siberian crane. Fish also support small-scale fishing by local inhabitants. These waters and reed margins give this part of the steppe a character quite different from the surrounding open country.
simp_chinese:
库利科尔的名称来自哈萨克语中的“天鹅”与“湖”。湖泊位于托博尔河上游流域的右岸一侧，沿一道狭长洼地，从东北偏北延伸至西南偏南。积雪丰厚的年份，融雪可使湖面显著扩大，部分岸边则生长着芦苇。

库利科尔与附近的塔尔德科尔一起，为包括白鹤在内的湿地鸟类提供繁殖、迁徙与换羽场所。湖中的鱼类也供当地居民进行小规模捕捞。湖水与苇岸，使这一片草原具有迥异于周围开阔地带的面貌。

english: Kuma belongs to Higo in the old Saikaidō circuit. The wider circuit united Kyūshū’s nine provinces with Iki and Tsushima, forming a western geographical division whose name referred both to the territory and to its principal road.
simp_chinese: 球磨属于古代西海道的肥后国。更广阔的西海道将九州九国与壹岐、对马联系起来，构成日本西部的地理区划，其名称同时指这片区域及主要道路。

english: Kumage belongs to Suō, one of the ancient provinces of Japan’s San’yōdō circuit. The wider province had its capital at present-day Hōfu, where the principal Tamanooya Shrine also stood.
simp_chinese: 熊毛属于日本古代山阳道的周防国。更广阔的周防国以今防府为国府所在地，主要神社玉祖神社也位于此地。

english: Kumage formed part of Ōsumi in the Saikaidō circuit. The wider circuit combined the nine provinces of Kyūshū with the islands of Tsushima and Iki. Like other ancient Japanese circuits, Saikaidō denoted both an administrative region and the road running through it.
simp_chinese: 熊毛属于西海道的大隅国。更广阔的西海道包括九州九国以及对马、壹岐两岛。与日本其他古代道区一样，西海道既表示行政区域，也表示穿行其中的道路。

english:
Kumai is a river port on Borneo’s southern coast, where the Kumai River leads towards the Java Sea. It belonged to the Kutaringin monarchy, and its local administration passed from Pangeran Bendahara to the village leader Muhammad Cik and then Amsar. The settlement is associated with Malay migration from the Riau region in the sixteenth or seventeenth century, followed by interaction with people from Banjar and western Borneo.

Waterways remain central to the surrounding country: fertile northern plains give way to wetter land, swamps and lakes towards the coast. Fishing and river transport join Kumai to the sea, while its coastal speech bears similarities to Banjar. Malay cultural traditions include Japin dancing and Islamic Hadrah music accompanied by rebana drums, giving the port a cultural character shaped by both local life and migration.
simp_chinese:
库迈是婆罗洲南岸的河港，库迈河由此通向爪哇海。这里曾属于库塔林金君主国，地方管理权由庞格兰·本达哈拉交给村落首领穆罕默德·奇克，之后又传至阿姆萨尔。聚落的形成与十六或十七世纪来自廖内地区的马来人迁徙有关，后来又与班贾尔及婆罗洲西部来民交流融合。

水道始终是周围乡野的骨架：北部肥沃平原向海岸逐渐变为湿地、沼泽和湖泊。渔业与河运将库迈和海洋相连，当地沿海方言也与班贾尔语相似。马来文化传统包括扎宾舞，以及用雷巴纳鼓伴奏的伊斯兰哈德拉音乐，使港口的文化面貌同时带有本地生活与人口迁徙的印记。

english: Kumak belongs to the Ural country of the Kipchak steppe. The wider grasslands were associated with a confederation dominated by Cuman and Kipchak nomads between the tenth and thirteenth centuries, before the Golden Horde became the region’s greater power.
simp_chinese: 库马克属于钦察草原的乌拉尔地区。更广阔的草原在10至13世纪与库曼、钦察游牧部族主导的联盟相联系，后来金帐汗国成为区域更大的强权。

english: Kumalu is associated with the Mumeng-speaking country of Morobe in New Guinea. Its speech belongs to an Austronesian dialect chain, linking it linguistically with several neighbouring communities. Dambi and Kumalu form a close grouping, alongside another comprising Patep, Zenag and Gorakor; a degree of mutual understanding connects these varieties. The local name thus carries a cultural identity within a wider pattern of closely related speech communities in the Huon Gulf region.
simp_chinese: 库马鲁与新几内亚莫罗贝地区的穆门语群体有关。当地语言属于南岛语系的一条方言链，在语言上连接着数个邻近社群。丹比与库马鲁构成关系密切的一组，帕特普、泽纳格与戈拉科尔则组成另一组，这些语言变体之间具有一定程度的互通性。因此，这个地方名称承载着本地文化身份，也处在休恩湾地区众多近缘语言社群的联系之中。

english: Kumanovo lies northeast of Skopje in the old country of Žegligovo. A monastic charter of 1355 places this region within the domains of the Serbian noble Dejan, while the town itself emerges in Ottoman records in the early sixteenth century. By the time Evliya Çelebi visited in 1660–61, it had tiled houses, a mosque, a religious college, baths, shops and watermills, with gardens and vineyards around it. In 1689 the rebellion led by Karposh reached Kumanovo during the Habsburg advance into the Balkans. Ottoman forces subsequently retook the town and its new fortress, capturing the rebel leader. Its provincial life survived these upheavals, and agriculture, crafts and commerce expanded again in the nineteenth century.
simp_chinese: 库马诺沃位于斯科普里东北的热格利戈沃旧地。1355年的一份修道院特许状将这一地区列入塞尔维亚贵族德扬的领地，而城镇本身则在十六世纪初的奥斯曼记录中出现。1660至1661年埃夫利亚·切莱比到访时，这里已有瓦顶房屋、清真寺、宗教学校、浴场、商铺和水磨，周围散布花园与葡萄园。1689年，哈布斯堡军队向巴尔干推进之际，卡尔波什领导的起义波及库马诺沃。奥斯曼军队随后夺回城镇及其新筑堡垒，俘获了起义首领。地方生活延续于这些动荡之后，农业、手工业与贸易又在十九世纪得到发展。

english: Kumarakapay, also known as San Francisco de Yuruaní, is a Pemon-majority settlement in the Gran Sabana of present-day Venezuela. Its Indigenous name survives alongside the Spanish one, while its modern economy has drawn heavily on visitors arriving from Brazil. In February 2019, residents attempting to halt Venezuelan troops travelling toward the Brazilian border clashed with the army. The violence killed Pemon residents and drove others into nearby communities, woodland and Brazil.
simp_chinese: 库马拉卡派又名圣弗朗西斯科-德尤鲁阿尼，位于今天委内瑞拉的大萨瓦纳地区，居民以佩蒙人为主。原住民名称与西班牙语地名并存，现代当地经济则在很大程度上依靠来自巴西的游客。2019年2月，居民试图阻止前往巴西边境的委内瑞拉军队通过，与军方发生冲突。暴力造成佩蒙居民死亡，另一些人逃往邻近社区、林地和巴西。

english: Kumasi lies in the forest country of the Asante, near Lake Bosomtwe, on ridges rising above the marshes of the Nsuben rivers. Its emergence as a capital belongs to the late seventeenth century, when Osei Tutu drew together the power that would become the Asante Empire. Traditions connect the choice of site and the name, meaning beneath the kum tree, with the priest Okomfo Anokye; the accounts differ over the precise founding. Victory over Denkyira in 1701 made the new state a leading regional power, with Kumasi as the seat of the Asantehene. The capital endured an Aowin invasion in 1718–19, which Opoku Ware I repelled. Its political authority remained closely bound to the Golden Stool, regarded as embodying the soul of the Asante nation.
simp_chinese: 库马西位于阿散蒂人的森林地区，靠近博苏姆推湖，城址坐落于恩苏本诸河沼泽上方的坡地。它在十七世纪后期才崛起为都城，当时奥塞·图图正在凝聚后来构成阿散蒂帝国的力量。传统将选址及意为“库姆树下”的地名与祭司奥科姆福·阿诺基联系起来，但对具体建城经过存在不同说法。1701年击败登基拉后，这个新兴国家成为区域强权，库马西则是阿散蒂赫内的驻地。1718至1719年，阿奥温军队侵袭都城，最终被奥波库·瓦雷一世击退。这里的政治权威始终与象征阿散蒂民族灵魂的金凳紧密相连。

english: Kumawu lies in the Ashanti country of Ghana, amid a district whose livelihoods remain closely tied to farming. Yam, plantain, maize and rice are important crops, while poultry, goats and sheep form part of the rural economy. The Kumawu Traditional Area also contains Bomfobiri, where remnants of semi-deciduous forest meet savannah around waterfalls and rocky country. Monkeys, duikers and bush pigs inhabit this varied landscape, and its bird life includes the rare bareheaded rockfowl. A wildlife sanctuary was established here in 1975; the palace museum in Kumawu itself opened in 2015, both belonging to the area's modern history.
simp_chinese: 库马武位于加纳阿散蒂地区，周边居民的生计仍与农业紧密相连。山药、大蕉、玉米和稻米是重要作物，鸡、山羊和绵羊也构成乡村经济的一部分。库马武传统领地内还有博姆福比里，残存的半落叶林与稀树草原在瀑布和岩地周围相接。猴类、小羚羊和薮猪栖息于这一多样的环境，鸟类中还有珍稀的裸头岩鹛。当地于1975年设立野生动物保护区，库马武城内的王宫博物馆则在2015年开放，两者都属于这片地方的近现代历史。

english: Kumayri stands on the high Shirak plateau, where settlement reaches back to the third millennium before the common era. Its name appears in Urartian inscriptions of the eighth century BC. In the Middle Ages it flourished within the Armenian world around Ani, whose elevation to a royal capital in 961 strengthened the neighbouring district. Later conquest repeatedly changed its masters, and the settlement passed into the Safavid realm in the early sixteenth century. Russian rule brought another transformation: Armenian families from Ottoman towns arrived after the war of 1828–1829, and in 1837 Nicholas I renamed Kumayri Alexandropol in honour of his wife.
simp_chinese: 库迈里坐落在希拉克高原，定居历史可追溯至公元前第三千纪。其名称见于公元前8世纪的乌拉尔图铭文。中世纪时，它在以阿尼为中心的亚美尼亚世界中繁荣；阿尼于961年成为王国首都，也推动了邻近地区的发展。后来的征服多次改变此地的统治者，聚落于16世纪初进入萨法维王朝版图。俄国统治又带来新的变化：1828至1829年的战争后，来自奥斯曼城镇的亚美尼亚家庭迁入，1837年尼古拉一世为纪念妻子，将库迈里改名为亚历山德罗波尔。

english: Kumba lies in the wet equatorial country of southwestern Cameroon, at about 240 metres above sea level. Its long rainy season extends from February to November. Cocoa and palm oil became important goods in the town’s trading economy.
simp_chinese: 昆巴位于喀麦隆西南部多雨的赤道地域，海拔约二百四十米。漫长雨季从二月延续至十一月，可可与棕榈油成为城镇贸易经济中的重要商品。

english: Kume belongs to Mimasaka, one of the eight old provinces grouped within San’yōdō. This ancient circuit took its name from the “sunny side” of Honshū’s central mountains and was established under the Gokishichidō system during the Asuka period.
simp_chinese: 久米属于美作国，后者是古代山阳道所属八国之一。山阳道得名于本州中央山脉的“向阳面”，在飞鸟时代的五畿七道制度下确立。

english: Kume formed part of Hōki, a province of Japan's San'indō circuit. The provincial capital stood at present-day Kurayoshi. In the wider province, Mount Daisen divided eastern and western cultural regions, while ties to neighbouring Izumo included ancient ironworking and sword forging.
simp_chinese: 久米属于日本山阴道的伯耆国，国府位于今仓吉一带。在更广阔的伯耆国，大山分隔东西文化区域；当地与邻近出云的联系还包括古代冶铁与铸剑传统。

english: Kumejima lies roughly a hundred kilometres west of Okinawa's main island, on the maritime approaches to the Ryukyuan capital at Shuri. Abundant freshwater once made extensive rice cultivation possible, an important distinction among the islands. In 1506, forces of the Ryukyu Kingdom under Shō Shin invaded Kume, bringing it into the kingdom's political orbit. Chinese investiture envoys subsequently visited on their voyages to Shuri. The island is also associated with Kumejima-tsumugi textiles and awamori spirits. Castle remains survive at several sites; Uegusuku, on the mountain of the same name, occupies the highest castle site in the Okinawa islands. These strongholds recall the island's own centres of authority before and during its closer integration with Ryukyu.
simp_chinese: 久米岛位于冲绳本岛以西约一百公里，处在通往琉球王都首里的海路上。充足的淡水曾使岛上能够广泛种植水稻，这在诸岛之间是一项重要特点。1506年，尚真王麾下的琉球军队进攻久米岛，将它纳入王国的政治范围。此后，中国册封使在前往首里的航程中常造访此地。久米岛也以久米岛䌷织物与泡盛酒闻名。岛上多处保留着城迹；坐落在同名山上的宇江城，是冲绳诸岛中海拔最高的城址。这些堡垒使人想起久米岛在更紧密融入琉球前后所拥有的地方权力中心。

english: Kumeyaay country reaches across the later border between California and Baja California, joining Pacific shores, mountain valleys and eastern deserts. The Tiipai lived in the southern lands around Ensenada, Tecate and the Laguna Mountains, while related Iipai and Kamia communities occupied country farther north and east. Coastal people exchanged salt, seaweed and abalone shells for acorns, agave and other inland produce, using agave-fibre nets in their maritime economy. Cabrillo's visit in 1542 brought contact without immediate colonization. Spanish settlement followed in 1769 at San Diego, beginning a mission era that profoundly disrupted the communities and ecology of the northern part of this homeland.
simp_chinese: 库梅亚伊人的乡土跨越后来加利福尼亚与下加利福尼亚之间的边界，将太平洋海岸、山谷与东部沙漠连接起来。蒂帕伊人居住在恩塞纳达、特卡特及拉古纳山脉一带的南方土地，同族的伊帕伊人与卡米亚人则分布于更北和更东的地区。沿海居民以盐、海藻和鲍鱼壳换取内陆的橡实、龙舌兰与其他产物，并用龙舌兰纤维制网捕鱼。1542年卡布里略到访，带来了接触，但没有立即建立殖民地。西班牙人于1769年在圣迭戈定居，由此开启的传教站时代深刻扰动了这片乡土北部的社群与生态。

english: Kumilla stands beside the Gumti River in eastern Bengal, in a region whose history reaches back to Samatata and Harikela. The nearby Lalmai–Mainamati country was ruled by the Deva dynasty in the eighth century and by the Chandras in the tenth and eleventh. Archaeological remains from the seventh and eighth centuries preserve traces of this earlier world. In 1732 Kumilla became the centre of Jagat Manikya's Bengal-backed domain, tying its fortunes to the struggle over Tripura. East India Company rule followed in 1765, and in 1790 a district bearing the name Tripura was established. The modern spelling Cumilla and the older Comilla refer to the same riverine city.
simp_chinese: 库米拉坐落于孟加拉东部的古姆蒂河畔，周边地区的历史可追溯至三摩呾吒与诃利稽罗。附近的拉尔迈—迈纳马蒂地区在8世纪由提婆王朝统治，10至11世纪又归旃陀罗王朝掌握。7至8世纪的考古遗存保留了这一古老世界的痕迹。1732年，库米拉成为得到孟加拉支持的贾加特·摩尼迦领地的中心，其命运由此与争夺特里普拉的斗争相连。东印度公司于1765年开始统治，1790年又设立了名为特里普拉的行政区。现代拼法 Cumilla 与旧拼法 Comilla，指向的是同一座河畔城市。

english: Kumintang was a precolonial Tagalog polity around the Calumpang River in southern Luzon. Early Spanish chroniclers described a kingdom centred near present-day Batangas, whose name later also became associated with a musical tradition.
simp_chinese: 库明堂是吕宋南部卡伦庞河周边的一处前殖民他加禄政体。早期西班牙编年史记述了以今八打雁附近为中心的王国，其名称后来也与一种音乐传统相联系。

english: Kumkol belongs to the southern Xinjiang country associated with the Tarim Basin. High mountain ranges separate this basin from Dzungaria to the north, while the wider region formed an important passage of the historic Silk Road.
simp_chinese: 库木库勒属于新疆南部与塔里木盆地相联系的地区。高山将这一盆地与北面的准噶尔分隔开来，更广阔的新疆地区则构成历史丝绸之路的重要通道。

english: The Kumon uplands belong to the northern mountain country of mainland Southeast Asia. Across this wider region, ranges extend south from the Tibetan Plateau between lowlands drained by the Irrawaddy and other major rivers.
simp_chinese: 库蒙高地属于东南亚大陆北部的山地。广大地区的山脉从青藏高原向南延伸，山间低地由伊洛瓦底江等大河排水。

english: The Kumtag desert country adjoins the Lop Depression in the eastern Tarim Basin. Nearby Lop Nur is the remnant of a much larger ancient lake system, receiving drainage from the Tarim and Shule rivers.
simp_chinese: 库姆塔格沙漠地带邻接塔里木盆地东部的罗布洼地。附近的罗布泊是古代更大湖泊系统的遗存，塔里木河与疏勒河的水系通向这里。

english: The Kumtag desert borders the Lop Nur depression at the eastern edge of the Tarim Basin. Lop Nur was an enclosed salt-lake system fed by rivers and mountain meltwater, and its dried basin now carries a thick salt crust.
simp_chinese: 库姆塔格沙漠毗邻塔里木盆地东缘的罗布泊洼地。罗布泊曾是由河流与高山融水补给的封闭咸水湖系统，干涸湖盆如今覆有厚盐壳。

english: The Kumtag Desert borders the Lop Nur setting of the eastern Tarim Basin. Lop Nur occupies a largely dried salt-lake depression between the Kumtag and Taklamakan deserts.
simp_chinese: 库姆塔格沙漠毗邻塔里木盆地东部的罗布泊地区。罗布泊处于库姆塔格与塔克拉玛干沙漠之间，现为大体干涸的盐湖洼地。

english: The Kumtura caves overlook the Muzat River west of Kucha, beside the ancient Silk Road. Their surviving 112 cave temples date from the fifth to the eleventh centuries, making this stretch of the Tarim Basin a substantial repository of Buddhist art. Paintings of donors in Tocharian dress preserve something of the people who supported its shrines. After the complex ceased to function as a religious site, intermittent habitation damaged the caves. Foreign expeditions visited in the early twentieth century, and Albert von Le Coq removed a number of wall paintings to Berlin, dispersing part of Kumtura's artistic legacy far beyond the oasis.
simp_chinese: 库木吐喇石窟位于龟兹以西的木扎提河畔，毗邻古代丝绸之路。现存112座洞窟寺院，年代从五世纪延续至十一世纪，使塔里木盆地的这一角保存了丰富的佛教艺术。身着吐火罗服饰的供养人画像，留下了支持这些佛堂的人们的身影。石窟失去宗教用途后，间歇性的居住活动又造成损坏。二十世纪初，外国考察队来到这里，阿尔伯特·冯·勒柯克将一批壁画揭取运往柏林，使库木吐喇的部分艺术遗产流散到远离绿洲的地方。

english: The waters off Hawaiʻi belong to a long volcanic archipelago in the central Pacific. Its islands span many hundreds of miles and form part of the Polynesian cultural world.
simp_chinese: 夏威夷岸外水域属于太平洋中部长火山岛链。诸岛绵延数百英里，是波利尼西亚文化世界的一部分。

english: Kumukh lies high in Dagestan on the Kazikumukh Koysu, a tributary of the Sulak system, and has long been a political and cultural centre of the Lak people. Medieval writers knew the settlement under forms such as Gumik, while by the fourteenth century Gazi-Kumukh expressed its standing as a Muslim military and political centre. It later served as the capital of the Gazikumukh Khanate. Its market drew Lak, Avar, Dargin and Lezgin traders, and its craftsmen became especially known for weapons and copper utensils. Nineteenth-century observers still found a community whose reputation rested as much on the workshop and the market as on its mountain stronghold.
simp_chinese: 库穆赫坐落在达吉斯坦高地的卡济库穆赫科伊苏河畔，该河属于苏拉克河水系；这里长期是拉克人的政治与文化中心。中世纪作者以古米克等名称记述此地，至14世纪，“加齐库穆赫”之名体现了它作为穆斯林军事与政治中心的地位。此后，这里成为加齐库穆赫汗国的首府。市场吸引拉克、阿瓦尔、达尔金与列兹金商人，工匠则以兵器和铜器著称。19世纪的观察者仍能看到，这个山地聚落的声望既来自坚固据点，也来自作坊与集市。

english:
Kümüx takes its name from the Uyghur word for silver, a metal mined in the surrounding country. The nearby Kuruktag mountains hold deposits of several metals and building stones, while the settlement stands on the route connecting Ürümqi with Kashgar. Water and usable ground are precious here: arable land is limited, and irrigation relies on springs.

A Qing-period description counted twenty or more households at Kümüx, a modest settlement on this inland route. Its present administrative status as a town dates only from 1984. The older locality is better understood through its mineral-bearing surroundings, spring-fed cultivation and place along the road than through the boundaries of that modern township.
simp_chinese:
库米什的名称来自维吾尔语中的“银”，周边地区确实开采这种金属。附近的库鲁克塔格山地蕴藏多种金属与建筑石材，而聚落坐落在乌鲁木齐通往喀什的道路上。这里的水源与可耕地十分珍贵：农地有限，灌溉依靠泉水。

清代记述中的库米什只有二十余户，是内陆道路上的一处小聚落。今天的建制镇地位则直到1984年才确立。若要理解更早的库米什，周边矿藏、泉灌农业以及沿途位置，比现代乡镇边界更能展现其地方特征。

english: Kumylzhenskaya stands on the Kumylga near its confluence with the Khopyor in the lower Don region. It is a stanitsa and a centre for the surrounding countryside. The nearest railway connection later developed at Mikhailovka to the northeast.
simp_chinese: 库梅尔任斯卡亚坐落在顿河下游地区库梅尔加河接近汇入霍皮奥尔河之处，是一座斯坦尼察及周边乡区中心。后来最近的铁路联系位于东北方的米哈伊洛夫卡。

english: Kuna country belongs to the homeland of the Guna people of Panama and Colombia. At the time of Spanish invasion, Guna communities lived in northern Colombia and Darién, later moving farther west toward the islands and coast of Guna Yala.
simp_chinese: 库纳地区属于巴拿马与哥伦比亚古纳人的故土。西班牙入侵时期，古纳社会分布于哥伦比亚北部与达连，后来进一步西迁至古纳雅拉的岛屿和海岸。

english:
Kunashiri is the southernmost of the Kuril Islands, visible across the straits from Hokkaido. Its Ainu name is understood as Grass Island. Four active volcanic centres shape the long island, with low ground, lakes and hot springs linking heights that were once separate islands.

The Ainu were its original inhabitants. In 1754 the Matsumae clan established the Kunashiri-basho fishery and trading post, headquartered at Tomari and extending its administration to Iturup and Urup. Relations with Japanese traders and settlers erupted into the Menashi-Kunashiri uprising of 1789. The island also drew Russian navigators: Vasily Golovnin was arrested while attempting to explore it in 1811 and remained in Japanese custody for two years. Fishing, trade and contested access repeatedly brought distant powers into the islanders' world.
simp_chinese:
国后是千岛列岛最南端的岛屿，隔着海峡便可望见北海道。其阿伊努语名称通常解释为“草之岛”。四处活火山塑造了狭长的岛身，低地、湖泊与温泉连接起原先分离的火山岛。

阿伊努人是岛上的原住民。1754年，松前氏设置国后场所，以泊为据点经营渔业与贸易，并将择捉、得抚纳入管理。岛民与日本商人、移居者之间的关系，在1789年爆发为目梨—国后起义。俄国航海者也来到此地：瓦西里·戈洛夫宁于1811年勘察岛屿时被捕，在日本拘禁两年。捕鱼、贸易和围绕出入权的争端，使远方势力不断进入岛民的生活。

english: Kundal belongs to the broadly defined northwestern Australian country. The regional term covers northern Western Australia and sometimes neighbouring parts of the Northern Territory; offshore landmarks of this wider coast include Barrow Island, the Monte Bello Islands and the Dampier Archipelago.
simp_chinese: 昆达尔属于广义的澳大利亚西北地区。这一地区名称涵盖西澳北部，有时也包括邻近的北领地部分土地；更广大海岸外的地标包括巴罗岛、蒙特贝洛群岛与丹皮尔群岛。

english: Kundar’s hilltop fort gave its name to the settlement below. Built under the Chandela ruler Yashovarman in the tenth century, the stronghold later passed to Prithviraj Chauhan, who appointed Khet Singh Khangar to rule it.
simp_chinese: 昆达尔山顶的堡垒赋予山下聚落名称。城堡由十世纪昌德拉统治者耶输跋摩修建，后来归于普里特维拉杰·乔汉，后者任命凯特·辛格·坎加尔统治这里。

english: Kundgol, or Kundagola, lies in the Dharwad country of Karnataka, southwest of Hubli. Its eleventh-century Shambulingeshwara temple bears witness to the town's place within the Western Chalukya realm. Dedicated to Shiva and Parvati, the sanctuary is distinguished by polished stones joined with dovetail fittings and by richly carved pillars. Lion faces send ornamental scrolls from their mouths near the entrance, while lotus designs and sacred figures decorate the surviving exterior. After damage in earlier conflicts, a local chief repaired the temple in 1808–1809. Kundgol later belonged to the princely state of Jamkhandi, forming a detached portion of that ruler's possessions.
simp_chinese: 昆德戈尔又称昆达戈拉，位于卡纳塔克的达尔瓦德地区、胡布利西南方。镇内十一世纪的尚布林格什瓦拉神庙，见证了这里在西遮娄其王朝版图中的地位。神庙奉祀湿婆与帕尔瓦蒂，以磨光石材、燕尾榫连接方式和精雕立柱著称。入口附近的狮面口吐装饰卷纹，留存的外墙上则可见莲花纹样与神圣人物。庙宇在早期冲突中受损后，由一名当地首领于1808至1809年修复。昆德戈尔后来隶属贾姆坎迪土邦，是该邦君主领地中的一块飞地。

english: Kundi belongs to the wider Luba country of south-central Congo. Archaeology places settlements around the lakes and marshes of the Upemba Depression by the fifth century CE. Mining, smithing, pottery and woodworking became important features of Luba society.
simp_chinese: 昆迪属于刚果中南部广义卢巴地区。考古证据显示，至公元5世纪，乌彭巴洼地湖泊与沼泽周围已有聚落。采矿、锻冶、制陶和木工成为卢巴社会的重要特色。

english:
Kundjeymi, also written Kundjeyhmi or Gundjeihmi, belongs to the Bininj world of western Arnhem Land. The Mirrar clan's country lies around the site of modern Jabiru, between the East and South Alligator rivers. Kundjeyhmi is one of the closely related languages and dialects known collectively as Bininj Kunwok, linking this country linguistically with other communities across the Arnhem Plateau.

Rock paintings known as the Dynamic Figures are preserved in Mirrar country, leaving a distinctive record of Indigenous artistic life. The wider region also shared a long history of contact with seafarers from Makassar in Sulawesi, who exchanged goods for trepang. Their presence survives in loanwords and in rock art depicting the visitors. Even balanda, a word for Europeans, reached local speech through the Macassan traders' term for Hollanders, preserving the trace of one distant people in the name for another.
simp_chinese:
昆杰米亦写作Kundjeyhmi或Gundjeihmi，属于阿纳姆地西部的比宁吉人世界。米拉尔氏族的土地位于今日贾比鲁一带，处在东阿利盖特河与南阿利盖特河之间。昆杰米语是统称为Bininj Kunwok的一组近缘语言和方言之一，在语言上将这片土地与阿纳姆高原其他社群相连。

米拉尔土地上保存着被称为“动态人物”的岩画，为原住民艺术生活留下独特记录。更广阔的地区也与苏拉威西望加锡海员保持了悠久往来，来访者以各类货物交换海参。他们的踪迹留存在外来词与描绘访客的岩画之中。甚至当地称呼欧洲人的balanda，也经由望加锡商人对荷兰人的称谓传入，在一个远方族群的名称中，保存了另一个远方族群的印记。

english: Kunduz lies in historical Tokharistan, near the meeting of the Kunduz and Khanabad rivers, amid the cultivated plains of northern Afghanistan. Its name is commonly traced to the Persian kohan dež, meaning 'old fortress'; forms of the name Kuhandiz were in use during the Timurid age. The region entered the Durrani Empire in the eighteenth century, while Kunduz also became the seat of an Uzbek khanate. Under Mohammad Murad Beg, who ruled from 1815 to 1842, that khanate reached from Balkh toward the Pamirs. Its eventual defeat and incorporation into the Afghan emirate in 1859 belong to a later chapter of this contested northern frontier.
simp_chinese: 昆都士位于历史上的吐火罗斯坦，靠近昆都士河与汗阿巴德河汇流处，四周是阿富汗北部的耕作平原。其名称通常被追溯至波斯语kohan dež，意为“古老堡垒”；帖木儿时代已经使用库罕迪兹一类名称。十八世纪，当地进入杜兰尼帝国版图，昆都士也成为一个乌兹别克汗国的都城。在1815至1842年执政的穆罕默德·穆拉德伯克治下，汗国势力从巴尔赫延伸至帕米尔方向。汗国最终战败，并于1859年归入阿富汗埃米尔国，那已是这片多方争夺的北部边疆更晚的历史篇章。

english: Kundy belongs to the wider Yuktali country of the eastern Stanovoi region. The regional settlement of Yuktali lies on the Nyukzha River, northwest of Tynda.
simp_chinese: 昆迪属于东斯塔诺夫广义的尤克塔利地区。地区聚落尤克塔利位于腾达西北的纽克扎河畔。

english: The Kunene reaches the Atlantic after descending from the Angolan highlands. One of the region’s few perennial rivers, it turns west along the Angola-Namibia frontier, breaking through the outer highlands before entering the arid coast.
simp_chinese: 库内内河自安哥拉高地流下，最终抵达大西洋。作为当地少数常年河之一，它沿安哥拉与纳米比亚边界转向西流，穿过外围高地后进入干旱海岸。

english: Kuneni belongs to the Ndongo country of Angola. Ndongo was a kingdom in the highlands between the Lukala and Kwanza rivers, ruled by a king bearing the title Ngola.
simp_chinese: 库内尼属于安哥拉的恩东戈地区。恩东戈是卢卡拉河与宽扎河之间高地上的王国，其国王的称号为恩戈拉。

english: Kungara belongs to the homeland setting of the Mayi-Kutuna people of Queensland. Their country was described as extending from Augustus Downs toward the Leichhardt River, with a southern reach around Mount Cuthbert.
simp_chinese: 孔加拉属于昆士兰马伊库图纳人的故土背景。其传统土地被记述为从奥古斯都唐斯延伸至莱卡特河一带，南端接近卡斯伯特山。

english: Kungarakany country lies in the northern Australian interior around the middle Reynolds River and the headwaters of the Adelaide River, northeast of Mount Litchfield. Its traditional lands encompass the country around Adelaide River, Batchelor, Rum Jungle, the Finniss River and Berry Springs. The name belongs to the Aboriginal people of this country, also written Kungarakan and in several other forms. European settlers later called them the 'Paperbark People'. Norman Tindale estimated their territory at roughly two thousand square miles, a later attempt to describe a homeland through an external map. Here the geographical identity lies in the relationship between a people and river country, extending across places that acquired different settlement names in the colonial era.
simp_chinese: 昆加拉卡尼传统领地位于澳大利亚北部内陆、利奇菲尔德山东北方，围绕雷诺兹河中游与阿德莱德河源头展开。其范围包括阿德莱德河、巴彻勒、拉姆詹格尔、芬尼斯河与贝里泉周边地区。这个名称属于生活于此的原住民族，也有昆加拉坎等多种拼写。后来的欧洲移民称他们为“白千层树皮之民”。诺曼·廷代尔曾估计其领土约有两千平方英里，这是后世以外来地图描述这片家园的一次尝试。此地的地理身份存在于族群与河流土地的联系之中，横跨那些在殖民时代获得不同聚落名称的地方。

english:
Kungsbacka first appears as a town in fifteenth-century records, when Halland belonged to Denmark. A river through the settlement carried goods toward the coast, giving this modest town a place in local maritime commerce. Its fortunes depended in part on keeping that waterway open.

By the time Kungsbacka was recognised as Swedish in 1658, the river was already heavily overgrown. Appeals to restore its usefulness went unanswered, and although coastal trade continued, the town's importance in shipping declined. Much of the older centre was later lost to a devastating fire in 1846, from which a small red wooden cabin survived. Kungsbacka's history joins a changing Scandinavian frontier to the quieter struggle of a small trading town against a failing river route.
simp_chinese:
15世纪的记录首次以城镇称呼孔斯巴卡，当时哈兰仍属丹麦。穿镇而过的河流把货物运向海岸，使这座小城参与了当地海上贸易。保持水道畅通，是其兴衰的重要条件之一。

到1658年孔斯巴卡被确认为瑞典领土时，河道已经严重淤塞、草木丛生。恢复水道功能的请求没有得到落实；沿海贸易虽仍延续，城镇在航运中的地位却逐渐衰落。1846年的大火又毁去了大部分老城中心，一间红色木屋幸存下来。孔斯巴卡的历史既涉及斯堪的纳维亚边界的变化，也包含一座小商镇应对河流运输衰退的漫长经历。

english: Kungur occupies a meeting place of rivers in the western Urals, where the Iren and Shakva join the Sylva in the Kama basin. The Russian settlement began in 1648 above the Iren's mouth, was burned in 1662, and was rebuilt the following year as a fortress at Mysovskoye. Leatherworking became a foundation of its prosperity: a tannery opened in 1724, and by the end of the century Kungur combined manufacture with transit trade along the Siberian road. Rope and linseed oil also carried its name beyond the town. In 1774 it resisted a siege by Pugachev's Cossack forces. Beneath the nearby right bank of the Sylva, the great ice cave adds another distinctive feature to the landscape, with branching passages, underground lakes and formations of ice hidden below the river country.
simp_chinese: 昆古尔位于乌拉尔山脉西部诸河交汇之处，伊连河与沙克瓦河在这里汇入卡马河流域的瑟尔瓦河。俄罗斯聚落于1648年在伊连河口上游建立，1662年遭焚毁，次年在梅索夫斯科耶重建为堡垒。皮革加工成为当地繁荣的基础：1724年建起制革厂，到该世纪末，昆古尔已将制造业与西伯利亚大道上的转运贸易结合起来。绳索与亚麻籽油也使城名传播到远方。1774年，它抵御了普加乔夫哥萨克军的围攻。附近瑟尔瓦河右岸下方的巨大冰洞，则为景观增添了另一重特征：分岔洞道、地下湖与冰体造型隐匿在河谷地面之下。

english: Kungwini is an isiNdebele name meaning 'mist'. The name was applied to the misty country around Bronkhorstspruit in Gauteng, later incorporated into the Tshwane metropolitan area.
simp_chinese: 孔格维尼是恩德贝莱语地名，意为“雾”。这一名称用于豪登省布朗克霍斯特斯普雷特周边多雾的地区，后来该地区并入茨瓦内都会区。

english: Kunisaki occupies the eastern side of its namesake peninsula in northeastern Kyushu, facing the Iyo waters of the Seto Inland Sea. Settlements cluster near the shore, while the interior rises towards mountains including Futago, the peninsula’s highest summit at 720 metres. This was part of Bungo Province. During the Edo period much of the country belonged to Kitsuki Domain under a branch of the Matsudaira family, alongside smaller territories directly administered by the Tokugawa shogunate. Farming and fishing draw on the peninsula’s contrasting mountain and maritime surroundings; the scholar Miura Baien was among its notable sons.
simp_chinese: 国东位于九州东北部同名半岛的东侧，面向濑户内海的伊予滩。聚落集中在沿海地带，内陆则升为山地，其中二子山海拔720米，是半岛最高峰。这里原属丰后国。江户时代，大部分土地属于松平氏支系统治的杵筑藩，另有较小区域作为天领，由德川幕府直接管理。半岛的山地与海洋环境共同支撑着农业和渔业；学者三浦梅园也是这里的著名人物。

english: Kunjabangarh belongs to the Garjat country of Odisha. In the wider region, the Odia-speaking lands face the Bay of Bengal and preserve the historical name Utkala.
simp_chinese: 昆贾班加尔属于奥迪沙的加尔贾特地区。从更广阔的地理文化背景看，奥里亚语地区面向孟加拉湾，并保留着乌特卡拉这一历史名称。

english: Kunjen belongs to the Aboriginal country of Cape York Peninsula in northeastern Australia. The name is associated with a group of related Paman speech varieties used by the Uw Oykangand, Olkola and neighbouring peoples. Uw Oykangand and Uw Olkola are especially close, sharing almost all of their basic vocabulary, while other varieties preserve greater differences. Language also marks obligations between relatives: a special respect register, Olkel-Ilmbanhthi, is used when speaking with a potential mother-in-law. Much of the ordinary vocabulary is replaced while grammatical elements remain. Another striking feature is the prevalence of words beginning with vowels, with kinship terms and borrowed words among the exceptions. These linguistic practices give a glimpse of the social distinctions carried within the peninsula's local communities.
simp_chinese: 昆真属于澳大利亚东北部约克角半岛的原住民地区。这个名称与乌伊坎甘德人、奥尔科拉人及邻近族群使用的一组帕马语支近缘语言变体有关。乌伊坎甘德语与乌奥尔科拉语尤其接近，基本词汇几乎全部相通，其他变体则保留着更大的差异。语言也体现亲属之间的义务：与潜在的岳母交谈时，使用名为Olkel-Ilmbanhthi的特殊敬语语体，大量日常词汇会被替换，而语法成分保持不变。另一项鲜明特点是绝大多数词以元音开头，亲属称谓与借词属于少数例外。这些语言习惯，让人得以一窥半岛地方社会内部的关系与区分。

english:
The Kunlun is a great mountain belt along the northern Tibetan Plateau, stretching eastward into Qinghai. Its eastern heights include Yuzhu Peak and Amne Machin, while the Bayan Har branch separates the drainage basins of the Yellow River and the Yangtze. The name thus embraces a vast, varied highland rather than a single isolated summit.

Kunlun also held a place in Chinese imagination long before its geographical limits were settled. The Classic of Mountains and Seas described a sacred mountain, and traditions associated it with the Queen Mother of the West and the legendary journey of King Mu. Sima Qian recorded that Emperor Wu of Han gave the name to mountains thought to stand at the Yellow River's source, linking exploration of the western highlands with an older mythical landscape.
simp_chinese:
昆仑是沿青藏高原北缘延展、向东进入青海的一条巨大山系。其东部高峰包括玉珠峰与阿尼玛卿山，巴颜喀拉支脉则构成黄河与长江流域的分水岭。因此，这个名称涵盖着广阔多样的高地，并非一座孤立山峰。

早在地理范围确定以前，昆仑便已存在于中国人的想象中。《山海经》记述了神圣的昆仑山，传统又将它与西王母和周穆王的传奇西行联系起来。司马迁记载，汉武帝将昆仑之名赋予被认为位于黄河源头的群山，使对西部高地的探索与更古老的神话世界相接。

english: The western Kunlun forms a high barrier along the southern side of the Tarim Basin, separating its desert country from the Tibetan Plateau. From the wider range descend the Karakash and Yurungkash, the Black Jade and White Jade rivers, which pass through the Khotan oasis towards the Taklamakan. Such rivers give the mountains a direct connection with the cultivated settlements below. The name Kunlun has carried more than a geographical meaning: ancient Chinese texts placed a realm of gods in these remote heights, and later tradition associated them with the Queen Mother of the West. The extent assigned to the real mountain chain has itself changed over time.
simp_chinese: 西昆仑沿塔里木盆地南缘构成高耸的屏障，将荒漠地带与青藏高原分隔。喀拉喀什河与玉龙喀什河，也就是墨玉河和白玉河，从这条广大山系流出，穿过和田绿洲，向塔克拉玛干沙漠延伸。这些河流让高山与山下的农耕聚落紧密相连。“昆仑”也始终带有超越地理的含义：古代中国典籍把神灵的居所安置在遥远的高山之中，后来的传说又将这里与西王母联系起来。至于现实中哪些山岭属于昆仑，其范围本身也曾随时代而变化。

english: The Kunlun rises along the northern edge of the Tibetan Plateau, above the southern side of the Tarim Basin. In its broadest definition this mountain belt extends for more than three thousand kilometres, separating the desert basin from the sparsely inhabited Changtang to the south. Rivers descending from its western reaches, including the Black Jade and White Jade rivers, sustain the oasis of Khotan before flowing into the Taklamakan. The name carried an older life in Chinese tradition: classical writings placed a semi-mythical Kunlun in the distant west, associated with the Queen Mother of the West. Later geographical usage attached the name to this immense physical range. Across the Kumkol country, the heights form part of the mountain barrier between the Tarim world and the Tibetan uplands.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山脉沿青藏高原北缘隆起，俯临塔里木盆地南侧。按最广泛的定义，这条山带延伸超过三千公里，将沙漠盆地与南方人烟稀少的羌塘隔开。从其西段流下的河流，包括喀拉喀什河与玉龙喀什河，在流入塔克拉玛干之前滋养着和田绿洲。昆仑之名在中国传统中还有更古老的含义：古典文献将一座半属神话的昆仑置于遥远西方，并使之与西王母相联系。后来的地理用法，才把这一名称用于眼前庞大的真实山系。在库木库勒一带，这些高峰构成了分隔塔里木世界与西藏高地的山地屏障之一。

english: Above the oasis of Khotan, the Kunlun separates the Tarim Basin from the high country of the Tibetan Plateau. The Karakash, or Black Jade River, and Yurungkash, or White Jade River, descend from this mountain system, pass through Khotan and continue towards the Taklamakan. These rivers link the stark mountain barrier to the life of the oasis below. The name Kunlun also has a long and shifting history in Chinese geographical thought: ancient writings placed a semi-mythical mountain of that name in the far west, while later authors applied it to different mountain belts. Legends of the Queen Mother of the West belong to that imagined sacred landscape, rather than to a precise modern boundary of the range.
simp_chinese: 在和田绿洲上方，昆仑山将塔里木盆地与青藏高原的高地分隔开来。喀拉喀什河即墨玉河、玉龙喀什河即白玉河，都从这一山系发源，流经和田并继续进入塔克拉玛干。两条河流将险峻的山地屏障与山下绿洲的生活相连。“昆仑”在中国地理观念中也有漫长而变化的历史：古代文献把这一名称赋予遥远西方一座带有神话色彩的山，后世作者又用它指称不同山带。西王母的传说属于那片想象中的神圣地景，并不对应现代山脉一条精确的边界。

english:
The Kunlun mountains form a great highland margin between the Tarim Basin and the Tibetan Plateau. Their central ranges rise above the desert country to the north and the sparsely inhabited Changtang to the south, with the Altyn Tagh forming an important northern branch. The chain extends eastward toward Qinghai, while its exact boundaries have varied in geographical usage.

The name also belongs to a much older imagined landscape. In Chinese writings, Kunlun became a sacred western mountain associated with the Queen Mother of the West and the legendary journey of King Mu of Zhou. These stories gave distant heights a place in Chinese religious geography long before their ridges could be surveyed in detail.
simp_chinese:
昆仑山脉构成塔里木盆地与青藏高原之间宏大的高地边缘。中部山岭北临荒漠，南接人烟稀少的羌塘，阿尔金山则是重要的北部支脉。山系向东延伸至青海，而地理记述中对于昆仑具体范围的界定，历来并不完全一致。

这个名称也属于更古老的想象世界。在中国文献中，昆仑是西方的神圣山岳，与西王母以及周穆王西行的传说相连。在山岭能够得到详细测绘之前，这些故事已使遥远高山进入中国的宗教地理观念。

english: The Kunlun forms a vast mountain belt along the northern side of the Tibetan Plateau. In its eastern reaches, the Bayan Har branch divides waters flowing toward the Yellow River from those draining into the Yangtze, linking this high country to two of China's greatest river systems. The name carries a history broader than any single ridge: ancient writers used Kunlun for a partly mythical western mountain country, and its geographical extent changed between accounts. Sima Qian connected its naming with Han imperial searches for the Yellow River's source. Chinese tradition also placed the Queen Mother of the West in a Kunlun paradise. Such stories belong to the cultural memory of the mountains, while their steep, high terrain presents a very physical barrier across the plateau.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山脉沿青藏高原北侧构成一道绵延广阔的山地带。在东部，巴颜喀拉支脉分隔了流向黄河与长江的水系，使这片高地与中国两条最大的河流相连。昆仑这一名称承载的历史远超任何单独山岭：古代作者用它指称带有神话色彩的西方山国，不同记述中的地理范围也不断变化。司马迁将这一命名与汉朝寻访黄河源头的活动联系起来。中国传统还将西王母的仙境安置在昆仑。这些故事属于山脉的文化记忆，而高峻陡峭的地形则在高原上形成实实在在的阻隔。

english: Across the high country of Amdo, the eastern Kunlun belongs to the immense mountain belt marking the northern side of the Tibetan Plateau. Its branches include the Bayan Har Mountains, which divide the catchments of the Yellow River and the Yangtze. The eastern peaks include Amne Machin, rising above 6,000 metres. The name Kunlun also carries a separate, ancient geography of belief: Chinese texts associated it with a mountain paradise and the Queen Mother of the West. Accounts of the Han emperor Wu's search for the Yellow River's source helped connect that storied name with the mountains of the far western interior.
simp_chinese: 在安多的高原山地，东昆仑属于标示青藏高原北缘的庞大山系。其支脉巴颜喀拉山分隔黄河与长江的集水区，东部高峰还包括海拔超过六千米的阿尼玛卿山。昆仑之名也承载着另一重古老的信仰地理：中国典籍将它与山中仙境及西王母相联系。关于汉武帝派人探寻黄河源头的记载，则使这个富于传说色彩的名字与遥远西部内陆的山脉联系起来。

english:
The eastern Kunlun rises along the northern margin of the Tibetan Plateau, extending into Qinghai near the great inland basins. The mountain chain stretches for more than three thousand kilometres, though the limits attached to its name have changed between geographical traditions. Eastern summits such as Yuzhu and Amne Machin exceed six thousand metres, while the southern Bayan Har branch divides waters flowing towards the Yangtze and Yellow rivers.

Kunlun also occupies a place in Chinese historical imagination far larger than any single ridge. The name appears in early accounts of a sacred western mountain and became associated with the Queen Mother of the West. Sima Qian records that Emperor Wu of Han applied the name to mountains identified with the Yellow River's source. Such traditions should be understood as changing attempts to place a storied landscape within the distant highlands, rather than a precise ancient survey of these peaks.
simp_chinese:
东昆仑沿青藏高原北缘隆起，向东伸入青海，邻近广阔的内陆盆地。整个昆仑山系延绵三千余公里，但不同地理传统对其范围的界定历来有所变化。东段的玉珠峰、阿尼玛卿等山峰超过六千米，南支巴颜喀拉山则分隔长江与黄河两大水系。

昆仑在中国历史想象中所占的地位，远超任何一条具体山脊。早期记述将其视为西方圣山，并与西王母联系起来。司马迁记载，汉武帝将昆仑之名赋予被认作黄河源头所在地的山岭。这些传统反映了人们不断尝试将传说中的景观安置于遥远高地的过程，不能当作对眼前山峰的精确古代测绘。

english: The Kunlun chain marks much of the northern rim of the Tibetan Plateau, continuing east towards Qinghai beyond the mountains south of the Tarim Basin. Its branches divide great drainage systems: the Bayan Har Mountains separate the headwaters of the Yellow River and the Yangtze. In the Tsaidam country, this vast belt of high ground belongs to a mountain world whose names and boundaries have shifted in Chinese geography. Sima Qian recorded that Emperor Wu of Han sent men to seek the Yellow River's source and bestowed the name Kunlun upon mountains there. The same name already belonged to a mountain of myth. Stories placed the Queen Mother of the West in a remote paradise on Kunlun, linking an immense physical barrier with an enduring sacred landscape.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山系构成青藏高原北缘的大部分边界，从塔里木盆地以南的群山继续向东延入青海。它的支脉分隔着大河水系，巴颜喀拉山便是黄河与长江源头流域的分水岭。在柴达木一带，这片辽阔高地属于一个在中国地理记述中名称与范围屡有变化的山地世界。司马迁记载，汉武帝派人寻找黄河源头，并将昆仑之名赋予那里的山脉。这个名字此前已属于神话中的山岳。传说把西王母安置在昆仑遥远的仙境之中，使宏大的天然屏障与长久流传的神圣山川相互交织。

english: The Kunlun form the great mountain rim south of the Tarim Basin and north of the Tibetan Plateau. The chain stretches eastward across southern Xinjiang toward Qinghai; its central heights include the Arka Tagh, crowned by Ulugh Muztagh and Bukadaban Feng. Beyond the ridges to the south lies the sparsely populated Changtang. The name Kunlun carried meanings long before its modern geographical limits were fixed. Chinese tradition placed divine palaces and the Queen Mother of the West on a mythical Kunlun, while Sima Qian associated the name with Han expeditions seeking the source of the Yellow River. Those stories belong to the cultural history of the mountain name, rather than to a single identified summit.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山构成塔里木盆地南侧、青藏高原北缘的巨大山地屏障。山系自新疆南部向东延伸至青海，中段包括阿尔喀山，拥有乌鲁木孜塔格与布喀达坂峰等高峰。山岭以南是人烟稀少的羌塘。在现代地理范围确定以前，昆仑之名早已有丰富的含义。中国传统将神灵宫阙与西王母置于神话中的昆仑，司马迁则将这一名称同汉代探寻黄河源头的活动相联系。这些故事属于山名的文化历史，不能简单对应到某一座已确定的山峰。

english: The Kunlun forms the great mountain rampart south of the Tarim Basin, with the desert country to the north and the high, sparsely inhabited Changtang beyond its southern slopes. In its broadest definition the chain extends for more than three thousand kilometres along the northern edge of the Tibetan Plateau, although the mountains included under its name have changed between geographical traditions. The name itself carries an older imaginative geography. The Classic of Mountains and Seas describes a sacred Kunlun, and Sima Qian relates that Emperor Wu of Han applied the name to mountains identified with the Yellow River's source. Legends of the Queen Mother of the West belong to this cultural landscape; they should be distinguished from the actual ridges overlooking the Tarim oases.
simp_chinese: 昆仑山构成塔里木盆地以南的巨大山地屏障，北面是荒漠，南坡之外则是地高人稀的羌塘。按最宽泛的范围划分，这一山系沿青藏高原北缘延伸三千余公里，但不同地理传统纳入“昆仑”之名的山脉并不完全相同。这个名称本身也承载着更古老的想象地理。《山海经》描绘了神圣的昆仑，司马迁则记载，汉武帝将这个名字赋予当时被认作黄河源头的山地。西王母的传说属于这一文化景观，应当与俯临塔里木绿洲的真实山岭加以区分。

english: Kunming occupies a fertile basin on the northern shore of Dian Lake, high on the Yunnan–Guizhou Plateau. Nanzhao founded Tuodong here in 765, and the settlement subsequently belonged to the Dali kingdom before the Mongol conquest of 1252–1253. Under the Yuan governor Sayyid Ajall Shams al-Din, the city gained Buddhist and Confucian temples as well as mosques; its Confucian school drew students from different peoples of Yunnan. Ming rulers later enclosed it with walls. Trade routes reached west through Dali and Tengchong towards Burma and south through Mengzi towards the Red River, making this highland basin a meeting place between inland China and the lands beyond its southwestern mountains.
simp_chinese: 昆明坐落于云贵高原的滇池北岸，周围是一片肥沃盆地。765年，南诏在此建立拓东城；此后聚落归属大理国，直到1252至1253年的蒙古征服。元代行省长官赛典赤·赡思丁治理期间，城中兴建佛寺、孔庙与清真寺，孔庙兼办的学校吸引云南不同族群的学生。明朝后来筑起环城城墙。商路向西经大理、腾冲通往缅甸，向南经蒙自抵达红河，使这处高原盆地成为中国内地与西南群山之外各地交汇的场所。

english: Kunovat belongs to the wider northwestern Siberian trade world associated with Mangazeya. Before the Russian town was founded in 1601, private hunting and trading expeditions already travelled toward the lower Ob and Taz country.
simp_chinese: 库诺瓦特属于与曼加泽亚有关的西伯利亚西北部广阔贸易世界。俄国城镇于1601年建立以前，私人狩猎和贸易远征已经前往鄂毕河下游与塔兹河地区。

english: Kunozh is a rural settlement in the Vologda country of northern Russia. The village is listed among the localities of Babushkinsky District, with 360 inhabitants recorded in 2002.
simp_chinese: 库诺日是俄罗斯北部沃洛格达地区的一处乡村聚落。它被列为巴布什金斯基地区下辖村庄，2002年记录有三百六十名居民。

sources.title: List of rural localities in Vologda Oblast

english:
Kunshan lies in the watery country between Suzhou and the lower Yangtze coast, crossed by the Wusong River and a dense mesh of lesser streams. Its low fields depended on embankments and drainage. Medieval reclamation around Dianshan Lake brought more land under cultivation, but could also obstruct the waterways and worsen flooding when the Wusong's current weakened.

The Yuan period tied the district to maritime grain transport and brought wealthy patrons into its cultural life. At Gu Ying's Yushan Grass Hall, painters and scholars found a gathering place. Kunshan later gave its name to one of China's great theatrical traditions: in the sixteenth century Wei Liangfu refined the local songs, and Liang Chenyu wrote Washing Silk for the new style. Kunqu became a leading form of elite theatre, carrying the name of this river country far beyond its fields and market towns.
simp_chinese:
昆山位于苏州与长江下游海岸之间的水乡，吴淞江横贯其间，支流密布。低洼田地仰赖圩堤和排水；中世纪淀山湖周边的围垦增加了耕地，却也可能阻塞水道，在吴淞江水流减弱时加剧洪涝。

元代海运漕粮的发展加强了本区的地位，富裕的赞助者也活跃于文化生活。顾瑛的玉山草堂成为画家、文士聚会之所。后来，昆山又将地名赋予中国一种重要戏曲传统：16世纪，魏良辅改进当地曲调，梁辰鱼则为新声创作《浣纱记》。昆曲逐渐成为士人阶层喜爱的主要戏曲形式，让这片河湖田市的名字远播各地。

english: Kunto belongs to the Rokan river country of Sumatra. Rising in the Barisan Mountains, the Rokan drains northeast toward the Strait of Malacca near Bagansiapiapi, gathering the Rokan Kiri, Rokan Kanan and other tributaries through a rainy tropical landscape.
simp_chinese: 昆托属于苏门答腊的洛江地域。洛江发源于巴里桑山脉，向东北流至巴眼亚比附近的马六甲海峡，沿途汇集左洛江、右洛江等支流，穿过多雨的热带地域。

english: Kuntokling belongs to the Tibetan borderland country of Taozhou. In the wider Tao River valley, Chone Monastery stands near Liulin among wooded mountains. Founded in 1269 under Sakya influence and Mongol patronage, it later adopted the Gelug tradition in 1459, illustrating the region’s changing religious connections.
simp_chinese: 贡多林属于洮州的藏地边疆地区。在更广阔的洮河谷地，卓尼寺位于柳林附近林木覆盖的群山之间。它于1269年在萨迦派影响和蒙古支持下建立，1459年转属格鲁派，体现了地区宗教联系的变迁。

english: The Kunturi Mountains form part of the Andes, the immense highland system along western South America. In this wider mountain world, parallel ranges enclose high plateaus and deep valleys; the tropical, dry and wet sections of the Andes support markedly different environments.
simp_chinese: 昆图里山脉属于安第斯山系，这一庞大高地沿南美洲西缘延伸。在更广的山地世界中，平行山岭夹着高原与深谷；热带、干旱及湿润安第斯各段具有差异鲜明的自然环境。

english: Kunyang belongs to the Jinning region at the southern end of Dian Lake. The area is remembered as the birthplace of the navigator Zheng He.
simp_chinese: 昆阳属于滇池南端的晋宁地区。当地因航海家郑和的出生地而闻名。

english: Kuogastaax belongs to the northern Yakut country of eastern Siberia. The wider region extends across plateau and tundra landscapes between the Yenisei and the eastern drainage divides, with the Arctic-facing lands forming its northern edge.
simp_chinese: 库奥加斯塔赫属于东西伯利亚北部雅库特地域。整个大区域在叶尼塞河与东侧分水岭之间铺展高原和苔原景观，面向北极的土地构成其北缘。

english: Kuolay belongs to the wider eastern Siberian lands of Yakutia. Northern tundra forms an important part of this immense region, alongside the Central Siberian Plateau farther inland.
simp_chinese: 库奥莱属于雅库特更广阔的东西伯利亚地域。北部苔原是这片辽阔地区的重要组成部分，与更内陆的中西伯利亚高原共同构成区域景观。

english: Kuopio lies amid the lakes and forests of Savo, its shores and islands enclosed by Lake Kallavesi. A parish church was established at Kuopionniemi in the 1550s, during the Finnish Reformation, and Governor Per Brahe founded a settlement in 1653. Its formal urban foundation followed in 1775, when Gustav III made it the seat of Savo-Karjala Province. The town thus acquired an administrative role deep within the Finnish lake country, far from the Baltic harbours. After Finland became an autonomous grand duchy under Russia in 1809, later canals and railways gradually drew this inland centre into wider commercial networks. Its local food tradition includes kalakukko, the distinctive Savonian fish pie.
simp_chinese: 库奥皮奥坐落于萨沃的湖泊与森林之间，卡拉韦西湖环绕着这里的岸线与岛屿。芬兰宗教改革期间，库奥皮翁涅米于十六世纪五十年代设立教区教堂；1653年，总督小佩尔·布拉赫又在此建立聚落。正式建城则是在1775年，古斯塔夫三世将其定为萨沃—卡累利阿省的行政中心。这使远离波罗的海港口的芬兰湖区腹地拥有了一座行政城镇。1809年芬兰成为俄罗斯治下的自治大公国后，后来修筑的运河与铁路逐步将这座内陆中心接入更广阔的商业网络。当地饮食传统还包括萨沃特色的卡拉库科鱼馅面包。

english: Kuot country occupies a small part of New Ireland, where villages on both the eastern and western coasts share an unusual language. Also called Panaras, Kuot is the island's only non-Austronesian language and is classified as a language isolate. Its communities include Panaras and Bimun on the western side, and Kama and Bol toward the east; Bol also has Nalik speakers. Linguists have suggested that some sound changes in neighbouring Austronesian languages spread under Kuot influence. The language thus preserves a distinctive thread in the island's history of contact, despite the small number of villages in which it is spoken. Modern surveys describe little dialect variation within Kuot itself.
simp_chinese: 库奥特地区占据新爱尔兰岛的一小部分，东西两岸的一些村落使用着一种独特的语言。库奥特语又称帕纳拉斯语，是岛上唯一的非南岛语系语言，被归为孤立语言。其使用者居住于西侧的帕纳拉斯、比蒙，以及东侧的卡马、博尔等村落；博尔也有纳利克语使用者。语言学者认为，周边南岛语言中的某些语音变化，可能是在库奥特语影响下扩散的。尽管使用村落不多，这种语言仍在岛屿族群接触史中保留着独特的一脉。现代调查显示，库奥特语内部没有显著的方言差异。

english: Kuozhou belongs to the wider Sichuan country between the basin and the Tibetan Plateau. Ancient Ba and Shu were incorporated into Qin around 316 BCE, and a later state of Shu arose here in the Three Kingdoms period.
simp_chinese: 阔州属于四川盆地与青藏高原之间的广义四川地区。古代巴蜀约于公元前316年被秦吞并，三国时期后来又在此出现蜀国。

english: Kupadokado belongs to the Humboldt country of the Great Basin. This wider region is noted for inland drainage, arid climate and a repeated pattern of mountains and enclosed basins.
simp_chinese: 库帕多卡多属于大盆地的洪堡地区。更广区域以内流、干旱气候以及山地和封闭盆地反复交替的格局著称。

english: Kupang occupies the southwestern end of Timor, where the Koinino River supplied fresh water and the shore offered a position from which to watch shipping. In 1613, representatives of the Dutch East India Company encountered a Helong ruler here; Portuguese influence and the Topasses nevertheless remained powerful rivals. The Dutch built Fort Concordia above the river mouth in 1653, making Kupang their base in the struggle for Timor. Refugees from allied principalities settled nearby, while Chinese traders and artisans became important to the town's economy. In 1789 William Bligh reached Kupang after a forty-one-day open-boat voyage following the mutiny on the Bounty, giving this contested port an enduring place in maritime history.
simp_chinese: 古邦位于帝汶岛西南端，科伊尼诺河提供淡水，海岸则便于监视往来船只。1613年，荷兰东印度公司代表在此接触了赫隆族统治者，但葡萄牙势力与托帕斯人仍是强劲的竞争者。荷兰人于1653年在河口上方修建康科迪亚堡，使古邦成为争夺帝汶的据点。来自盟友小邦的难民在附近定居，华人商人与工匠也逐渐成为城镇经济的重要力量。1789年，威廉·布莱在邦蒂号叛变后乘敞船航行四十一天，最终抵达古邦，让这座饱经争夺的港口在航海史上留下长久印记。

english:
Kupiansk stands on the Oskil River in the historical country of Sloboda Ukraine. The settlement was founded as Kupenka in 1655, a Cossack military community whose inhabitants combined service with agriculture, crafts and trade. Its river landscape had been inhabited much earlier: a Neolithic settlement and Bronze Age burial mounds have been found nearby.

As Crimean Tatar raids subsided in the eighteenth century, commerce expanded. The town held four annual fairs by 1767 and six by 1780, alongside markets on Mondays and Fridays. Milling and distilling became important occupations, and a coat of arms was approved in 1781. The railway junction of the later town dates from connections established in 1895, long after the Cossack settlement had become a regional trading place.
simp_chinese:
库皮扬斯克位于奥斯基尔河畔，属于历史上的斯洛博达乌克兰。聚落于1655年以库片卡之名建立，最初是哥萨克军事社群，居民在服役之外兼营耕作、手工业与贸易。这里的河流地带更早便有人居住，附近发现过新石器时代聚落与青铜时代墓冢。

十八世纪，随着克里米亚鞑靼人的袭扰平息，商业逐渐扩张。到1767年，镇上每年有四次集市，1780年增至六次，此外每周一和周五还定期开市。磨坊与酿酒业成为重要生计，城徽于1781年获准使用。后世城镇的铁路枢纽地位始于1895年建成的线路；在那之前，这个哥萨克聚落早已发展为地区贸易场所。

english: Kupka belongs to the wider Kolyma country around the Orotukan River. The river is a tributary of the Kolyma, and gold discoveries in its valleys drew geological camps and road construction during the twentieth century.
simp_chinese: 库普卡属于奥罗图坎河周围更广阔的科雷马地区。奥罗图坎河是科雷马河的支流，20世纪河谷中的黄金发现带来了地质营地与道路建设。

english: Kupuri belongs to the Amur country included in broader definitions of historical Manchuria. This northern extension of the region encompasses territories now forming parts of the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 库普里属于黑龙江地域，广义历史满洲的定义涵盖这里。这片地区向北延伸，包括如今俄罗斯远东的部分土地。

english:
Kupwara lies in Kashmir at an elevation of about 1,615 metres. Its highland setting brings a marked seasonal contrast: winter nights commonly fall below freezing, while summer days are much warmer. Rainfall is greatest in the spring, with March notably wetter than the late summer and autumn.

The settlement is connected with Sopore and Trehgam by roads through the surrounding country. In its modern administrative form, Kupwara serves as the headquarters of the district bearing its name. The Kashmiri language remains part of its civic identity, while the town's position links its surrounding settlements with the wider Kashmir Valley.
simp_chinese:
库普瓦拉位于克什米尔，海拔约1615米。高地环境带来了鲜明的季节变化：冬季夜间气温常降到冰点以下，夏日白天则温暖得多。降水在春季最为充沛，三月尤其比夏末和秋季湿润。

道路穿过周围地区，将这一聚落与索波尔、特雷赫加姆相连。在现代行政体系中，库普瓦拉是同名县的治所。克什米尔语仍是其地方身份的一部分，而城镇的位置则将周边聚落与更广阔的克什米尔谷地联系起来。

english: Kur belongs to the wider Amur world of northeastern Asia. This river country forms part of the broader historical definition of Manchuria, which extends from northeastern China into adjoining lands of the Russian Far East.
simp_chinese: 库尔属于东北亚更广阔的黑龙江世界。这片河流地区处于广义历史满洲的范围内，该范围从中国东北延伸至俄罗斯远东相邻土地。

english: Kura belongs to the upper Tapajós country of Mato Grosso. The wider region combines broad plateaus and plains with three major ecological worlds: Cerrado savanna, the Pantanal wetlands and Amazon rainforest.
simp_chinese: 库拉属于马托格罗索的塔帕若斯河上游地区。更广阔的地区兼有大片台地和平原，并有塞拉多稀树草原、潘塔纳尔湿地与亚马孙雨林三大生态环境。

english: Kurakh belongs to the wider Lezgin homeland of the eastern Caucasus. Medieval Arabic writers described the kingdom of Lakz in southern Dagestan; al-Masudi associated its people with the defense of Shirvan against northern invaders. The region remains linked by the Lezgin language.
simp_chinese: 库拉赫属于东高加索更广阔的列兹金故土。中世纪阿拉伯作者记载了达吉斯坦南部的拉克兹王国，马苏第将其居民与抵御北方入侵者、保卫希尔凡联系起来。列兹金语持续维系着这一地区。

english: Kuraanax belongs to the eastern Stanovoi country. This forms part of the broader eastern Siberian setting, whose southern mountain ranges contrast with the Central Siberian Plateau and northern tundra.
simp_chinese: 库拉纳赫属于东斯塔诺夫地区。这里处于广义的东西伯利亚背景中，其南部山脉与中西伯利亚高原、北方苔原形成不同的地理区域。

english: Kuraanax Ürex belongs to the Laptev coastal country of northeastern Siberia. At the wider regional scale, northern tundra forms one of the principal landscapes of Eastern Siberia.
simp_chinese: 库兰纳赫属于西伯利亚东北部的拉普捷夫海岸地区。从更广的区域尺度看，北部冻原是东西伯利亚主要景观之一。

english: Kurba lies in the Yaroslavl country. At the wider region’s heart, Yaroslavl grew where the Kotorosl meets the Volga, a position important for transport. An independent principality emerged there in 1218 before absorption by Moscow in the fifteenth century.
simp_chinese: 库尔巴位于雅罗斯拉夫尔地区。在更广阔地区的中心，雅罗斯拉夫尔兴起于科托罗斯尔河与伏尔加河交汇处，这一位置对运输十分重要。1218年当地形成独立公国，至十五世纪并入莫斯科。

english: Kurchum stands beside the river of the same name, with Lake Zaysan lying to the south. Estuarine plains dominate the surrounding landscape, placing this locality in a country shaped by rivers and the lake basin. The modern settlement, also called Kurshim, serves as the administrative centre of a district in eastern Kazakhstan. Its later history includes a destructive earthquake in late 1989 or early 1990, which brought down the hospital and other buildings.
simp_chinese: 库尔丘姆位于同名河流之畔，斋桑泊在其南面。周围地貌以河口平原为主，河流与湖盆共同塑造了这片土地。现代聚落又称库尔希姆，是哈萨克斯坦东部一个地区的行政中心。其晚近历史中，1989年末或1990年初发生过一次破坏性地震，医院及其他建筑随之倒塌。

english: Küre lies in a forested mountain valley in the Kastamonu region. Copper mining and forestry have been important sources of local livelihood.
simp_chinese: 屈雷位于卡斯塔莫努地区一处森林覆盖的山谷。铜矿开采与林业是当地重要的生计来源。

english: Kureinji country follows the northern bank of the Murray River in southwestern New South Wales, approximately between the sites now called Euston and Wentworth. The people, also known as the Keramin, spoke a language closely related to Yitayita and Dadi Dadi within the Lower Murray linguistic area. Scarred trees, hearths, stone artifacts, burial places and middens preserve traces of their occupation, including within the area now protected as Kemendok National Park. Charles Sturt passed through this country in 1830, though his account did not identify the Kureinji by name. The river thus connected a long-established Aboriginal homeland before European settlements rose along its banks.
simp_chinese: 库伦吉人的土地沿着新南威尔士西南部墨累河北岸展开，大致位于今天称为尤斯顿与温特沃思的两地之间。库伦吉人又称凯拉明人，他们的语言属于下墨累河语言区，与伊塔伊塔语和达迪达迪语关系密切。带有取皮痕迹的树木、炉灶遗迹、石器、墓葬与贝冢保留了他们生活的踪迹，其中一些位于今凯门多克国家公园内。查尔斯·斯特尔特于1830年经过这片土地，但记述中没有点出库伦吉人的名称。在欧洲聚落沿岸兴起之前，这条河早已串联起一片历史悠久的原住民家园。

english:
Kuressaare grew around the bishop's castle on the southern shore of Saaremaa, facing the Gulf of Riga. The fortress appears in Latin records in 1381 under the name arx aquilae, the "eagle's stronghold", echoed in the town's German name Arensburg. Its square medieval core, with four wings surrounding a courtyard, gave the episcopal settlement a formidable centre.

The Reformation and the struggle for Livonia transformed its allegiance. Bishop Johann von Münchhausen sold his lands to the Danish king in 1559, and Prince Magnus helped the town obtain its civic charter in 1563. Denmark surrendered Saaremaa to Sweden in 1645. Plague and Russian troops devastated the town during the Great Northern War; the Treaty of Nystad in 1721 confirmed the island's incorporation into the Russian Empire. The castle endured these successive changes of lordship, preserving the outline of Kuressaare's medieval origins.
simp_chinese:
库雷萨雷围绕主教城堡发展而来，位于萨雷马岛南岸，面向里加湾。1381年的拉丁文记录称这座要塞为arx aquilae，即“雄鹰的堡垒”，城镇的德语名称阿伦斯堡也呼应着这一含义。中世纪城堡的方形主体由四翼围合庭院，构成了这处主教聚落坚固的中心。

宗教改革与利沃尼亚的争夺改变了它的归属。主教约翰·冯·明希豪森于1559年将领地出售给丹麦国王，马格努斯亲王则推动城镇于1563年获得城市特许状。1645年，丹麦把萨雷马岛让给瑞典。大北方战争期间，瘟疫与俄军重创了城镇；1721年的《尼斯塔德条约》确认该岛并入俄罗斯帝国。城堡历经数度易主，仍保存着库雷萨雷中世纪起源的轮廓。

english: Kuretsk belongs to the wider historical Novgorod Land of northwestern Russia. Centered on Novgorod, this region developed republican institutions and maintained extensive trade with the Hanseatic towns and other lands of Rus’. Slavic and Finnic communities shared the northern country, which Moscow conquered in 1478.
simp_chinese: 库列茨克属于俄罗斯西北部历史上更广大的诺夫哥罗德土地。以诺夫哥罗德为中心的这一地区发展出共和制度，与汉萨城镇和罗斯其他地区保持广泛贸易。斯拉夫与芬兰语族社群共同生活在北方土地上，莫斯科于1478年征服了这里。

english: Kurgaldhzin Lake belongs to central Kazakhstan's steppe-and-wetland country, fed by the Nura and Kulanotpes river system. The wider lake district combines fresh and salt waters, with Tengiz its largest lake. These wetlands lie on major bird migration routes linking Siberia, India and eastern Africa.
simp_chinese: 库尔加尔金湖属于哈萨克斯坦中部的草原湿地地区，与努拉河、库拉诺特佩斯河水系相联系。更广阔的湖区兼有淡水与咸水湖，以田吉兹湖为最大。这些湿地位于联系西伯利亚、印度与东非的重要候鸟迁徙路线上。

english: Kuria belongs to the country around Lake Victoria, Africa’s largest lake by area. The lake occupies a broad shallow depression and is also the world’s largest tropical lake.
simp_chinese: 库里亚属于维多利亚湖周边地区，该湖是非洲面积最大的湖泊。湖泊位于广阔浅洼地之中，也是世界最大的热带湖泊。

english: Kurihara stretches from rice fields and low ridges toward Mount Kurikoma, a volcano on the meeting ground of the northern provinces. The district belonged to ancient Mutsu, and settlement reaches back to the Jōmon period. The Northern Fujiwara held the area in the later Heian age; competing samurai houses disputed it during the Sengoku wars before the Date clan incorporated it into Sendai Domain under the Tokugawa. Agriculture remained a central occupation. Lake Izunuma adds a striking seasonal rhythm to the landscape, bearing lotus flowers in summer and receiving flocks of migrating swans and geese in winter. The city established in 2005 unites several older towns and a village, so the modern name covers a varied countryside rather than a single historic urban center.
simp_chinese: 栗原从稻田与低缓山岭延伸至栗驹山，这座火山坐落在北方诸地区交界处。当地历史上属于陆奥，人类定居可追溯至绳文时代。平安时代后期，奥州藤原氏统治此地；战国时期各武家争夺，直到伊达氏在德川政权之下将其纳入仙台藩。农业始终是当地重要生计。伊豆沼为这片土地增添鲜明的季节节律：夏季荷花盛开，冬季则有迁徙的天鹅与雁群前来栖息。2005年成立的栗原市合并了多个古老城镇及一座村庄，因此现代名称涵盖的是多样的乡野，而非单独一座历史城市。

english: Kūrījān belongs to the Hamadan country of western Iran. In the wider region, the Alvand foothills surround the ancient city known to classical authors as Ecbatana. That city served the Medes and later became one of the Achaemenid Empire's capitals.
simp_chinese: 库里詹属于伊朗西部的哈马丹地区。更广阔区域的阿尔万德山麓环绕着古典作家称为埃克巴坦那的古城。该城曾为米底人服务，后来成为阿契美尼德帝国的都城之一。

english: Kurile Lake fills a volcanic caldera in southern Kamchatka, enclosed by a rugged landscape of cones and lava domes. A tremendous eruption in the seventh millennium BCE formed the present basin and spread ash far across northeastern Asia.
