Some islands are remnants of later volcanic activity, including the lava dome called the Heart of Alaid. The lake drains through the Ozernaya and sustains Asia’s largest sockeye salmon stocks. Georg Wilhelm Steller visited this region during his travels of 1740–1743, encountering a landscape whose abundant waters lie amid the traces of ancient catastrophe.
simp_chinese: 千岛湖位于堪察加半岛南部，湖水充满一座破火山口，周围环绕崎岖的火山锥与熔岩穹丘。公元前第七千纪的一次猛烈喷发形成了今日湖盆，并把火山灰散布到东北亚遥远地区。部分湖岛源于后来的火山活动，其中包括名为“阿赖德之心”的熔岩穹丘。湖水经奥泽尔纳亚河流出，湖中繁衍着亚洲规模最大的红鲑种群。格奥尔格·威廉·施特勒在1740—1743年的旅行中到访这一地区，见到丰饶水域与古老灾变遗迹并存的景观。

english: Kuripan lies in the northern part of the Barito Kuala country of southern Borneo. This region occupies the western side of the lower Barito, whose waters separate it from Banjarmasin and other lands farther east. Kuripan belongs to the more northerly group of settlements outside the modern Banjarmasin metropolitan area, together with places such as Marabahan, Bakumpai and Tabukan. The great river provides the clearest geographical boundary in this part of South Kalimantan, between the western country adjoining Central Kalimantan and the settlements on its eastern side.
simp_chinese: 库里潘位于婆罗洲南部巴里托吉隆地区的北方。这片土地处于巴里托河下游西侧，河水将其与马辰及更东面的地区分隔开来。库里潘同马拉巴汉、巴昆派和塔布坎等地一道，属于现代马辰都会区以北的聚落群。在南加里曼丹的这一带，大河构成了格外清晰的地理界线：西方土地毗邻中加里曼丹，东方则是对岸的诸多聚落。

english: Kurita lies in Ōmi, the old province surrounding Lake Biwa. Part of the Tōsandō circuit, Ōmi ranked among the great provinces and among those near the imperial capital at Kyoto.
simp_chinese: 栗太位于环绕琵琶湖的旧近江国。近江属于东山道，在古代国制中列为大国，也属于邻近京都的近国。

english: Kurki belongs to Marwar, the desert country northwest of the Aravalli Range. The region is associated with Jodhpur and the Marwari language; it also gave its name to trading communities whose migrations carried them into commercial centres across India.
simp_chinese: 库尔基属于阿拉瓦利山脉西北侧的沙漠地区马尔瓦尔。这一地区与焦特布尔及马尔瓦尔语相联系，其名称也用于当地商人群体；他们迁往印度各地的商业中心，形成广泛的经商网络。

english: Kurkijoki belongs to the Karelian country associated with Korela. The regional fortress was held by Novgorod, confirmed in the treaty of Nöteborg in 1323; its stone towers and bastions were built in 1364 after fire destroyed the earlier wooden defences.
simp_chinese: 库尔基约基属于与科列拉相联系的卡累利阿地域。区域堡垒由诺夫哥罗德掌握，1323年《涅特堡条约》确认了这一归属；早期木制防御工事毁于火灾后，1364年又建起石塔与堡垒。

english: Kurkino belongs to the Tula country of central Russia. Across this wider region, Stone Age settlements and burial mounds attest to early occupation. By the eighth century, the East Slavic Vyatichi cultivated the land, practised crafts and traded in the country around the Upa and its tributaries.
simp_chinese: 库尔基诺属于俄罗斯中部图拉地区。整个地区的石器时代聚落和墓冢见证了早期居民活动。到八世纪，东斯拉夫维亚季奇人在乌帕河及支流周边耕种、从事手工业并开展贸易。

english: Kurla stands at the southern foot of the Tian Shan on the northeastern edge of the Tarim Basin. The ancient Silk Road passed through its country, associated with the kingdom of Quli. Xuanzang travelled through in 630, and later Tang administration tied the area to Yanqi.
simp_chinese: 库尔勒位于天山南麓、塔里木盆地东北边缘。古丝绸之路经过这里，周边曾与渠犁国相联系。玄奘于630年途经此地，后来的唐朝行政将其与焉耆联系起来。

english: Kurmysh began in 1372, when Prince Boris Konstantinovich of Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal ordered a fortified settlement on the Sura River. For almost two centuries it stood at the eastern edge of Russian settlement, helping extend influence into the Volga country while enduring attacks from the east. In 1445 Vasily II of Moscow was released here after his capture by Ulugh Muhammad of Kazan and the imposition of a ransom. The conquest of Kazan in 1552 changed Kurmysh's position: new fortifications at Alatyr reduced its frontier importance. It remained an administrative centre, populated largely by service people, but their later transfer towards Simbirsk further weakened the town. In the early eighteenth century many of its remaining Cossacks and streltsy were turned into state peasants, completing a long transition away from its military role.
simp_chinese: 库尔梅什始建于1372年，当时下诺夫哥罗德—苏兹达尔的鲍里斯·康斯坦丁诺维奇亲王下令在苏拉河畔建立设防聚落。此后近两个世纪，它位于俄罗斯聚落的东缘，一面帮助扩大对伏尔加地区的影响，一面承受东方来袭。1445年，莫斯科的瓦西里二世被喀山的乌鲁·穆罕默德俘虏并被索取赎金后，在这里获释。1552年喀山被征服，改变了库尔梅什的地位：阿拉特里新建的堡垒削弱了它作为边疆据点的重要性。它仍是行政中心，居民中有大量军役人员；但这些人后来被调往辛比尔斯克方向，使城镇进一步衰落。18世纪初，许多留下的哥萨克和射击军人员转为国家农民，漫长的军事职能退化至此更为明显。

english:
The Kurnai country extends across much of Gippsland and the southern slopes of the Victorian Alps. Within it, the Braiakalung lands lie principally west of the Mitchell River and include the Avon and Latrobe rivers, reaching towards Mount Baw Baw and Mount Howitt. Five major clans belong to the Kurnai nation, speaking closely related dialects before European settlement.

Kurnai tradition tells of Borun the pelican, who travelled from the northwestern mountains carrying a canoe, and of Tuk the musk duck, whom he discovered within it. Their story connects the origins of the people with the rivers and coastal inlets of their country. During the nineteenth century, European pastoral settlement brought resistance, deadly confrontations and massacres. This later violence profoundly disrupted communities whose relationship with the land long preceded the colonial frontier.
simp_chinese:
库尔奈人的土地覆盖吉普斯兰的大部分地区和维多利亚阿尔卑斯山的南坡。其中，布赖亚卡隆的领地主要位于米切尔河以西，包括埃文河与拉特罗布河一带，并向博博山和豪伊特山延伸。库尔奈民族由五个主要氏族组成，在欧洲人定居以前使用关系密切的方言。

库尔奈传统讲述了鹈鹕博伦从西北方群山背负独木舟而来，并在舟中发现麝鸭图克的故事。这则传说将族群的起源与故土的河流及沿海水湾联系在一起。十九世纪，欧洲牧业殖民带来了抵抗、致命冲突和屠杀。这些较晚发生的暴力，深刻破坏了那些早在殖民边界出现以前就与土地相连的社区。

english:
Kurnool developed as a crossing and stopping place on the southern bank of the Tungabhadra, at the gateway to Rayalaseema. Its older name, Kandanavolu, is traditionally connected with the grease used by bullock-cart caravans to lubricate their wheels at the crossing. The settlement passed from Chalukya to Kakatiya authority before entering the domains of Vijayanagara. In the sixteenth century, Achyuta Raya built its fort, giving monumental form to a town whose river position had long drawn travellers.

During the seventeenth century, the Abyssinian commander Abdul Wahab Khan defeated the local ruler Gopal Raja and governed Kurnool for sixteen years. Mughal influence followed under Aurangzeb in 1686, and nawabs later ruled the town until the East India Company's conquest in 1839. Beyond these changes of masters, the district preserves much older traces of human life, including the rock paintings at Ketavaram and Ashokan inscriptions at Erragudi.
simp_chinese:
卡努尔在通加巴德拉河南岸发展为渡口与旅途停驻地，扼守通往拉亚拉西马的门户。其旧名坎达纳沃卢，传统上被解释为与牛车商队在渡河处为车轮涂抹润滑油有关。聚落先后受遮娄其与卡卡提亚统治，随后进入毗奢耶那伽罗版图。十六世纪，阿丘塔·拉亚在此修建堡垒，使这座长期因河道位置吸引旅人的城镇拥有了醒目的军事建筑。

十七世纪，来自阿比西尼亚的将领阿卜杜勒·瓦哈卜汗击败当地统治者戈帕尔·拉贾，统治卡努尔十六年。1686年，奥朗则布治下的莫卧儿帝国势力进入此地，后来当地由纳瓦布统治，直到东印度公司于1839年征服。政权更替之外，周围地区还保存着更古老的人类活动遗迹，包括凯塔瓦拉姆岩画和埃拉古迪的阿育王铭文。

english: Kurokawa was one of the districts included in Rikuzen Province. This northeastern Japanese province, covering much of present Miyagi and part of Iwate, was separated from the older Mutsu Province in 1869, giving a new administrative form to an established district landscape.
simp_chinese: 黑川是陆前国所辖的郡之一。这个覆盖今宫城大部与岩手一部分的日本东北国域于1869年从旧陆奥国分出，为原有郡域格局赋予了新的行政形式。

english: Kurri Kurri belongs to the Mamuju country of western Sulawesi. Across the wider island, rugged central mountains historically separated its peninsulas, making sea connections easier than overland journeys.
simp_chinese: 卡里卡里属于苏拉威西西部马穆朱地区。在更广阔的岛上，崎岖的中央山地长期将各半岛隔开，使海上联系比陆上旅行更便利。

english: Northern Queensland belongs to Australia’s monsoonal north. Its tropical coastal hinterland forms part of a much larger region extending across the Northern Territory into Western Australia.
simp_chinese: 昆士兰北部属于澳大利亚季风北方。热带沿海腹地是一片更广大地区的一部分，该地区横跨北领地并延伸至西澳大利亚。

english: Kursk stands in the country of the Kur, Tuskar and Seym rivers, on the southeastern frontier of the old Rus’ lands. First recorded in 1032, it became the seat of an appanage principality before Mongol attacks and later devastation reduced its fortunes. References to Kursk in subsequent centuries do not by themselves establish the survival of a substantial town. Its clear revival followed the construction of a new fortress in 1596. Close to routes used by Crimean raiders, this stronghold endured repeated sieges in the early seventeenth century. As the defended frontier moved outward, trade and crafts gained importance; roads toward Moscow, Kyiv and the Crimea and a major monastery fair linked Kursk with a broad commercial hinterland.
simp_chinese: 库尔斯克位于库尔河、图斯卡尔河与谢伊姆河一带，处在古罗斯地域的东南边缘。它最早见于1032年的记载，后来成为分封公国的中心，随后遭受蒙古人的进攻与进一步破坏，逐渐衰落。此后几个世纪文献中的地名记录，本身不足以证明这里始终维持着规模可观的城镇。1596年新要塞的修建，标志着明确的复兴。要塞靠近克里米亚袭掠者使用的路线，在十七世纪初屡遭围攻。随着防御边界外移，贸易和手工业日益重要；通往莫斯科、基辅与克里米亚的道路，以及重要的修道院集市，将库尔斯克与广阔商业腹地相连。

english: Kurskaya belongs to the Terek country on the southern margins of the Pontic–Caspian steppe. The wider grassland belt links the northern Black Sea with the Caspian and lower Volga, forming part of the immense Eurasian world of temperate steppe.
simp_chinese: 库尔斯卡亚属于黑海—里海草原南缘的捷列克地区。更广阔的草原带连接黑海北岸、里海与伏尔加河下游，是欧亚温带草原世界的一部分。

english: Kurşunlu, formerly Karacaviran, stands in the central Anatolian country of Çankırı. It lies more than a thousand metres above sea level and was struck by an earthquake in 1951.
simp_chinese: 库尔顺卢旧称卡拉贾维兰，位于安纳托利亚中部的昌克勒地区。城镇海拔超过一千米，1951年曾遭地震袭击。

english: Kurtamysh began as a fortification on its namesake river in 1745. By 1762 it was known as the sloboda of Kurtamyshskaya, a settled community southwest of Kurgan. It eventually received town status in 1956 and became the centre of the surrounding district.
simp_chinese: 库尔塔梅什于1745年作为同名河上的防御据点建立。到1762年，已称库尔塔梅什斯卡亚斯洛博达，是库尔干西南的聚落。1956年最终获得城市地位，成为周边地区中心。

english: The Kurtjar, also known as Kunggara or Kuritjara, belong to the southern Cape York Peninsula. Their country centres on the Staaten River and extends south toward the Smithburne River and Delta Downs, with inland reaches around Stirling and Lotus Vale. Norman Tindale estimated this territory at some nineteen hundred square miles. Its neighbours included the Maikulan and Maijabi. The local Gurdjar language had Gunggara and Rip varieties, preserving another set of names by which the people and their country have been known.
simp_chinese: 库特贾人亦称孔加拉或库里特贾拉，居于约克角半岛南部。其故土以斯塔滕河为中心，向南延伸至史密斯本河及德尔塔唐斯，内陆范围到斯特灵与洛特斯韦尔一带。诺曼·廷代尔估计，这片地域约有一千九百平方英里。相邻族群包括迈库兰人与迈贾比人。当地古尔贾尔语具有贡加拉与里普两种变体，也保存着人们认识这一族群及其土地时使用的另一组名称。

english: Kurty belongs to Jetisu, the historical region of southeastern Kazakhstan. Its name means seven rivers and evokes the waters flowing from the mountains toward Lake Balkhash, in contrast with the drier surrounding steppes.
simp_chinese: 库尔特属于哈萨克斯坦东南部的历史地域七河。七河之名指向从山地流往巴尔喀什湖的河水，与周围较干旱的草原形成对照。

english: The Kuruaya are an Indigenous people living along tributaries of the lower Xingu in Pará. Their ancestral language belongs to the Munduruku branch of the Tupian family, linking them with the wider linguistic diversity of the Amazon.
simp_chinese: 库鲁阿亚人是生活在帕拉州欣古河下游支流旁的原住民族群。祖传语言属于图皮语系蒙杜鲁库语支，使他们与亚马孙广泛的语言多样性相联系。

english: Kurudu lies east of Yapen in Cenderawasih Bay off New Guinea’s northwestern coast. Yapen is surrounded by several island passages, including the Yapen Strait towards Biak and the Mios Num Strait to the west, giving this coast a closely spaced island geography.
simp_chinese: 库鲁杜位于新几内亚西北岸外的极乐鸟湾，在亚彭岛以东。亚彭周围分布多条岛间水道，包括通向比亚克的亚彭海峡及西面的米奥斯努姆海峡，形成岛屿密集的沿海格局。

english: Kuruko, now Curicó, lies in Chile’s central valley. Its Mapudungun name means “black waters”, recalling dark lands near streams and wetlands; the area later became known for fruit growing and wine production.
simp_chinese: 库鲁科今称库里科，位于智利中央谷地。其马普切语名称意为“黑水”，使人想起溪流与湿地附近的深色土地；当地后来以水果种植和葡萄酒生产闻名。

english: Kuruktag belongs to the broader Karasahr country of the Tarim region. Karasahr was an ancient Silk Road town on the Kaidu River, known as Arsi or Agni in Tocharian traditions.
simp_chinese: 库鲁克塔格属于塔里木地区广义的焉耆地带。焉耆是开都河畔的丝绸之路古城，在吐火罗传统中称阿尔西或阿耆尼。

english: At the edge of the Kalahari, Kuruman draws its distinctive greenery from a spring emerging in a cave on the Ghaap Plateau. Known as the Eye, or Gasegonyane, it supplies water in a country where the Kuruman River otherwise runs dry except after heavy rain. The Tswana name Gasegonyane evokes a small calabash of bubbling water. In 1821 Robert Moffat established a London Missionary Society station here, beginning a new chapter in the area's history. Moffat later translated the Bible into Tswana, while David Livingstone arrived at Kuruman for his first missionary posting in 1841. The later town grew around a water source whose importance long preceded it.
simp_chinese: 在卡拉哈里边缘，库鲁曼的独特绿意来自加普高原一处洞穴中涌出的泉水。这眼泉称为“泉眼”，又称加塞戈尼亚内；周围的库鲁曼河除暴雨过后外通常干涸，泉水因而格外重要。茨瓦纳语名称加塞戈尼亚内，使人联想到盛着汩汩泉水的小葫芦。1821年，罗伯特·莫法特在此建立伦敦传教会传教站，开启了当地历史的新篇章。莫法特后来将《圣经》译成茨瓦纳语，大卫·利文斯通则于1841年来到库鲁曼，开始他的首次传教任职。后来的城镇围绕着这处水源发展，而泉水的重要性远早于城镇本身。

english: Kuruminaka belongs to Chiquitania in eastern Bolivia. This tropical savanna region was home to many peoples and languages, including Chiquitano, Ayoreo and Guarani, before Jesuit and Franciscan mission settlements spread across it.
simp_chinese: 库鲁米纳卡属于玻利维亚东部奇基塔尼亚。这片热带稀树草原曾有奇基塔诺、阿约雷奥、瓜拉尼等多种民族与语言，后来耶稣会与方济各会传教聚落分布其间。

english: Kurunegala lies on a plain dominated by isolated masses of rock, foremost among them Ethagala, whose resemblance to an elephant gave the city its older names. For roughly half a century around the turn of the fourteenth century it was a royal capital of Sri Lanka. Parakramabahu III brought back the Buddha's tooth relic from the Pandyan country, and his successors ruled from Kurunegala until the court moved elsewhere in the 1330s. Stone steps, pillars and broken walls preserve traces of the palace and the shrine that housed the relic. A large artificial reservoir, attributed to the ancient kings, forms another enduring feature of the town. The contrast between the open plain, the water and the animal-shaped crags gives this former capital a distinctive setting.
simp_chinese: 库鲁内格勒坐落在平原上，四周孤立的巨岩巍然耸立，其中最显眼的是形似大象的埃塔加拉山岩，城镇旧称也由此而来。十三至十四世纪之交，这里曾在约半个世纪里充当斯里兰卡王都。波罗迦罗摩巴忽三世从潘地亚地区迎回佛牙舍利，此后数位继承者在库鲁内格勒执政，直到十四世纪三十年代宫廷迁往别处。石阶、石柱与残墙仍留有王宫和佛牙供奉殿的痕迹。一座相传由古代国王修建的大型人工水库，也是城中延续至今的重要景观。开阔平原、水面与形似动物的岩丘相互映衬，赋予这座旧王都独特的地貌。

english: Kurung belongs to the northeastern hill country associated with Itanagar. Itanagar takes its name from Ita Fort, an irregular brick fort whose surviving masonry dates to the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries.
simp_chinese: 库隆属于与伊塔那噶相联系的东北山地。伊塔那噶因伊塔堡得名，这座形状不规则的砖堡，其现存砖砌结构可追溯至十四和十五世纪。

english: Kurunk-Yuruakh belongs to the broad eastern Siberian interior. This immense region extends between the Yenisei and the Pacific watershed. Its landscapes range from the Central Siberian Plateau to northern tundra and southern mountain chains.
simp_chinese: 库伦‑尤里亚赫属于东西伯利亚广阔内陆。这片辽阔地域分布于叶尼塞河与太平洋分水岭之间，景观包括中西伯利亚高原、北方苔原和南部山脉。

english: Cururupu is a municipality in Maranhão in northern Brazil. Its municipal territory covers roughly 936 square kilometres, giving the settlement an administrative hinterland within the wider Maranhão country.
simp_chinese: 库鲁鲁普是巴西北部马拉尼昂州的市镇。其市域面积约936平方公里，聚落在广阔的马拉尼昂地域中拥有一片行政腹地。

english: Kus'lecha belongs to the wider Central Great Plains. This largely treeless prairie belt runs from Nebraska through Kansas and Oklahoma towards Texas, between taller eastern grasses and shorter western grasslands.
simp_chinese: 库斯莱查属于更广阔的大平原中部地区。这条少树的草原带从内布拉斯加经堪萨斯与俄克拉何马延伸至得克萨斯，处于东部高草原与西部短草原之间。

english: The Tokrau country lies in Kazakhstan’s southern uplands, where the river runs south towards the Balkhash sands. Its upper course contains the Egizkoytas burial complex, with remains from the Bronze Age and Early Iron Age.
simp_chinese: 托克劳地区位于哈萨克丘陵南部，河流向南通往巴尔喀什沙地。上游分布埃吉兹科伊塔斯墓葬群，保存青铜时代及早期铁器时代遗存。

english: Kuse belongs to Yamashiro within Japan’s old Kinai. The broader Five Home Provinces surrounded Nara and Heian-kyo and formed the capital region under the system established in the Asuka period.
simp_chinese: 久世属于日本古畿内的山城国。整个五畿围绕奈良与平安京展开，是飞鸟时代确立制度下的都城地区。

english: Kushinagar, ancient Kusinara, is revered by Buddhists as the place where Gautama Buddha attained parinirvana. The Mahāparinibbāṇa Sutta describes his final journey here and the division of his remains among claimants after cremation. Centuries of worship left stupas, monasteries and images, including a reclining Buddha carved from a single block of red sandstone. At the Matha Kuar shrine, a seated image bears an inscription dated to the tenth or eleventh century. The ruins continued to attract worship when they were described in 1837; their identification and excavation by Alexander Cunningham and Archibald Carlleyle followed later in the nineteenth century. Thus the sacred landscape preserves both ancient pilgrimage traditions and a much later history of archaeological rediscovery.
simp_chinese: 拘尸那揭罗，古称拘尸那罗，被佛教徒尊为释迦牟尼入般涅槃之地。《大般涅槃经》记述了他前往此地的最后旅程，以及火化后各方分得遗骨的故事。绵延数世纪的礼拜留下了佛塔、寺院与造像，其中包括一尊以整块红砂岩雕成的卧佛。摩他库尔祠的一尊坐佛，刻有可追溯至十或十一世纪的铭文。1837年的记述表明，遗址当时仍吸引信众参拜；亚历山大·坎宁安与阿奇博尔德·卡莱尔对其身份的确认和发掘，则发生在十九世纪较晚时期。因此，这片圣地同时保留着古老的朝圣传统与晚近考古重发现的历史。

english: The Kushiro River reaches the North Pacific on the southeastern coast of Ezo, beside the place once known to Japanese traders as Kusuri-tomari. The port’s origins are associated with ships sent by Matsumae Domain in the mid-seventeenth century to trade with the Ainu living near the river mouth. Around 1799, the Tokugawa shogunate founded Itsukushima Shrine here. The open coast gave the harbor a practical advantage: its waters remain more reliably free of winter ice than those of many other Hokkaido ports. The name Kushiro was adopted only in 1869, so the later city and its industries should be understood as an expansion of an older coastal meeting place.
simp_chinese: 钏路川在虾夷东南岸流入北太平洋，河口附近曾被日本商人称为库苏里泊。港口的起源与17世纪中叶松前藩派船前来、同河口附近阿伊努人贸易的活动相联系。约1799年，德川幕府在此创建严岛神社。开敞的海岸使港湾具备实际优势：与北海道许多其他港口相比，这里的水域在冬季更能保持不冻。钏路之名直到1869年才被采用，后世的城市与工业因而应视为在一处更古老的沿海交往地点上发展而来。

english: Kushita lies in the lower Moshiko country of Angola. The wider Moxico region formerly covered nearly a fifth of Angola, before its eastern part became a separate province. Its inland position and Zambian frontier shaped a turbulent history during the country’s long civil war.
simp_chinese: 库希塔位于安哥拉的下莫希科地区。广阔莫希科在东部另设省之前，曾占安哥拉近五分之一的土地。内陆位置与赞比亚边界，塑造了该国漫长内战期间动荡的地区历史。

english: Kushka belongs to the Kolyma country of northeastern Siberia. Across this broad historical region, long subarctic winters, permafrost and tundra shape life between the East Siberian Sea and the northern shores of the Sea of Okhotsk.
simp_chinese: 库什卡属于西伯利亚东北部科雷马地区。在这片广阔历史区域，漫长的亚寒带冬季、永久冻土和苔原塑造着东西伯利亚海与鄂霍次克海北岸之间的生活环境。

english: Kushunkotan belongs to southern Sakhalin, later administered by Japan as Karafuto. Japanese settlement in this island country dates back at least to the Edo period. Control of the southern half passed to Japan after the 1905 Treaty of Portsmouth and to the Soviet Union in 1945.
simp_chinese: 久春古丹属于库页岛南部，后来由日本作为桦太管理。日本人在这一海岛地区的定居至少可追溯至江户时代。南半岛于1905年朴次茅斯条约后转入日本统治，1945年被苏联占领。

english: Kushva lies in the Ural Mountains, where the iron deposits of Mount Blagodat gave rise to a mining settlement in 1735. Its older name, Kushvinsky Zavod, recalled the industrial works around which the settlement developed. The place therefore belongs to the expansion of Russian mining in the eighteenth century, rather than to the region's earlier chain of towns. It retained its industrial name until 1926, when it received town status and became Kushva. The mountain's ore, rather than an ancient fortress or princely seat, supplied the foundation of its recorded urban history.
simp_chinese: 库什瓦坐落在乌拉尔山中，布拉戈达季山的铁矿使这里于1735年形成采矿聚落。它的旧名“库什温斯基扎沃德”保留了围绕工场发展起来的工业起源。这处聚落属于十八世纪俄国矿业扩张的历史时期，出现时间晚于当地更早的一批城镇。直到1926年获得城市地位时，它才改称库什瓦。山中的矿石，构成了这座城市有记载历史的根基。

english: Kusike belongs to the Ambundu country of Angola’s interior plateau north of the Kwanza. The wider people speak Kimbundu and established permanent farming villages during their southward migrations. Their rulers bore the title Ngola, which gave Angola its name.
simp_chinese: 库西克属于安哥拉宽扎河以北内陆高原的安本杜人地区。更广阔的族群讲金本杜语，在向南迁徙中建立永久农业村落。统治者称恩戈拉，安哥拉国名由此而来。

english: Kusk belongs to the wider historical region of Khorasan. The name covered changing territories across northeastern Iran, Afghanistan and southern Central Asia, with stricter definitions extending toward the Oxus.
simp_chinese: 库什克属于更广阔的历史地区呼罗珊。这一名称曾涵盖伊朗东北部、阿富汗与中亚南部范围不断变化的领土，较狭义的定义延伸至阿姆河一带。

english: Kushk Kohneh belongs to the country historically associated with Khorasan. The name described a changing eastern Iranian region whose wider usage could stretch from the Caspian approaches toward the Pamirs.
simp_chinese: 旧库什克属于历史上与呼罗珊有关的地区。这一名称所指的伊朗东部地域范围不断变化，广义上可由里海附近延伸至帕米尔方向。

english: Kuska belongs to the wider Mocovi country. The Mocovi, who call themselves Moqoit, speak a language of the Guaycuru group. Their traditional Chaco economy relied on hunting, fishing and gathering, with trade routes through the forest providing contacts beyond individual communities.
simp_chinese: 库斯卡属于广阔的莫科维地域。莫科维人自称Moqoit，使用瓜伊库鲁语族的语言。其传统查科经济依靠狩猎、捕鱼和采集，穿过森林的贸易路线则建立了超出单个社群的联系。

english: Kuskatan was the capital of a Nahua confederation stretching between the Paz and Lempa rivers in what is now western El Salvador. Its name is commonly interpreted as a place of jewel necklaces. The ruling centre drew tribute from a network of towns whose traditions combined Nahua and Maya influences. Cacao from the Izalco lands circulated through the isthmus and also served as currency, while cotton textiles and agricultural produce sustained exchange. Spanish descriptions record warriors protected by thick cotton armour and armed with long spears or obsidian-edged weapons. Pedro de Alvarado reached the capital in June 1524 after fighting on the coastal plain; the conquest brought enslavement and tribute demands, while resistance continued in the surrounding country.
simp_chinese: 库斯卡坦曾是一支纳瓦人邦联的中心，其势力范围延伸于帕斯河与伦帕河之间，即今日萨尔瓦多西部。这个名字通常被解释为珠宝项链之地。中心城镇从一系列属城征收贡赋，当地传统融合了纳瓦与玛雅文化的影响。伊萨尔科地区出产的可可在中美地峡流通，也充当货币；棉纺织品和农产品则支撑着其他交换活动。西班牙人的记述提到，当地战士身披厚棉甲，使用长矛或嵌有黑曜石刃的武器。佩德罗·德·阿尔瓦拉多在沿海平原作战后，于1524年6月抵达这座都城；征服带来了奴役与贡赋要求，周边地区的抵抗仍在继续。

english: Kusmuryn follows the country around Kushmurun, an elongated lake in the Turgay Basin. The Ubagan crosses it from south to north. Snowmelt causes large seasonal changes in its area and shallow depth, while the Amankaragai wooded massif rises to the southwest.
simp_chinese: 库斯穆伦沿图尔盖盆地狭长的库什穆伦湖周围地区展开。乌巴甘河从南向北穿湖而过。融雪使浅湖面积与水深发生显著季节变化，西南侧耸立阿曼卡拉盖林地高地。

english: Kustur is a rural settlement in the Eveno-Bytantaysky district of Russia’s Sakha Republic. It lies about 100 kilometres from Batagay-Alyta and had 766 inhabitants in 2010.
simp_chinese: 库斯图尔是俄罗斯萨哈共和国埃文比坦泰区的一座乡村聚落。它距巴塔盖阿雷塔约100公里，2010年人口为766人。

english: Kusu belongs to Bungo within the old Saikaido circuit. This broader western sea region embraced Kyushu’s nine provinces and the islands of Iki and Tsushima, combining territorial administration with the roads between provincial centres.
simp_chinese: 玖珠属于古西海道中的丰后国。整个西方海道地域涵盖九州九国与壹岐、对马两岛，将地区行政与国府之间道路结合起来。

english: Kusu Mangbetu belongs to the Ulindi river country of the eastern Congo. The river rises in South Kivu and flows northwest through Maniema to the Lualaba below Kindu; its upper valley supports a diverse fauna amid traditional Lega and Nyindu lands.
simp_chinese: 库苏芒贝图属于刚果东部的乌林迪河地域。河流发源于南基伍，向西北流经马涅马，在金杜下游汇入卢阿拉巴河；上游河谷位于传统莱加与宁杜地域，动物种类丰富。

english: Kut Ling belongs to the Khorat Plateau of northeastern Thailand. The wider saucer-shaped plateau is divided by the Phu Phan hills and drained by the Mun and Chi rivers toward the Mekong.
simp_chinese: 古灵属于泰国东北部的呵叻高原。广阔碟状高原由普潘山区分隔，蒙河与栖河将水流输向湄公河。

english: Kuta Watu belongs to Mindanao, the second-largest island in the Philippine archipelago. The wider island group includes neighbouring islands and the Sulu Archipelago in the southern Philippines.
simp_chinese: 库塔瓦图属于菲律宾群岛第二大岛棉兰老。广义的棉兰老群岛还包括菲律宾南部邻近岛屿与苏禄群岛。

english: On the Porsuk River, Kütahya occupies agricultural slopes beneath the mountain ridges of western Anatolia. Known in antiquity as Cotyaeum, it passed through Byzantine and Turkish rule and became a centre of the Germiyanid principality before its Ottoman incorporation in 1428. The city subsequently served as the administrative centre of the Anatolia eyalet. Its fame also travelled in more fragile forms: glazed tiles and pottery supplied mosques, churches and public buildings across the Ottoman world, with Armenian craftsmen prominent in the trade. A small blue-and-white ewer dated 1510 bears an Armenian inscription commemorating Abraham of Kütahya, preserving a personal name within this wider ceramic tradition.
simp_chinese: 屈塔希亚位于波尔苏克河畔，西安纳托利亚的山脊环绕着周围的农耕坡地。古代称科蒂埃乌姆的这座城市，先后经历拜占庭与突厥诸政权统治，成为盖尔米扬侯国的中心，1428年归入奥斯曼版图。此后，它长期担任安纳托利亚省的行政中心。城市声名也随着易碎的器物远行：釉面瓷砖与陶器供应奥斯曼世界各地的清真寺、教堂和公共建筑，亚美尼亚工匠在这一行业中尤为重要。一件署有1510年日期的小型青花执壶，留下纪念“屈塔希亚的亚伯拉罕”的亚美尼亚文铭文，使广阔的制陶传统中保存了一个具体的人名。

english: Kutai Lama belongs to the lower Mahakam country of Borneo. The wider island lies at the heart of maritime Southeast Asia, where long Indigenous histories developed within a landscape of equatorial rainforests and exceptional biodiversity.
simp_chinese: 古泰拉玛属于婆罗洲的下马哈坎地区。更广阔的岛屿位于海洋东南亚核心，悠久的原住民历史在赤道雨林与卓越生物多样性景观中展开。

english: On both banks of the Rioni, Kutaisi commands the meeting of the Colchian lowlands and the foothills of Imereti. Archaeological evidence places an important centre of ancient Colchis here, while Greek literary tradition connects the city with the destination of Jason and the Argonauts. Kutaisi later became a capital of the Abkhazian monarchy, and from 1008 to 1122 served as the capital of the united Kingdom of Georgia. Bagrat III's early eleventh-century cathedral proclaimed that royal importance in stone. From the fifteenth century until Russian annexation in 1810, the city was the capital of the Kingdom of Imereti, repeatedly contested amid Georgian and Ottoman struggles.
simp_chinese: 库塔伊西横跨里奥尼河两岸，扼守科尔基斯低地与伊梅列季山麓相接之处。考古证据表明，古代科尔基斯的重要中心曾位于此地；希腊文学传统还将这座城市与伊阿宋及阿尔戈英雄的目的地相联系。此后，库塔伊西成为阿布哈兹王国的都城，并在1008至1122年间担任统一格鲁吉亚王国的首都。巴格拉特三世于11世纪初兴建的大教堂，以石造建筑彰显了这份王都地位。从15世纪到1810年被俄国吞并，这里又是伊梅列季王国的首都，在格鲁吉亚与奥斯曼势力的争斗中屡遭争夺。

english: Kutapuskuj belongs to Newfoundland in Canada's Atlantic region. The island forms the eastern part of a broader province whose mainland section, Labrador, is separated from it by the Strait of Belle Isle.
simp_chinese: 库塔普斯库吉属于加拿大大西洋地区的纽芬兰。岛屿是这一广阔省份的东部，隔贝尔岛海峡与大陆上的拉布拉多相望。

english: Kutarka belongs to the Mari country around Yaransk in the Vyatka basin. The wider region contained an older Mari fortress before a Russian stronghold was built on the Yaran River in 1584.
simp_chinese: 库塔尔卡属于维亚特卡流域亚兰斯克周围的马里地域。整个地区原有马里堡垒，1584年俄罗斯在亚兰河畔修建新据点。

english: Kutema Museya belongs to the eastern Lunda landscape. The wider Lunda commonwealth came to span lands now divided among Congo, northeastern Angola and northwestern Zambia. Traditions of royal succession, including the office of queen mother called Rukonkesh, helped organize its political life.
simp_chinese: 库泰穆塞亚属于东隆达地域。更广阔的隆达共同体后来跨越如今分属刚果、安哥拉东北部及赞比亚西北部的土地。王位传承传统及称作Rukonkesh的王母职务，参与组织其政治生活。
